Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars TransformCollect Types Terms Envs.

Inductive item : Set :=
  | item_obj: defs -> item
  | item_fun: trm -> item.

Definition fv_item (v: item) : vars :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => (fv ds)
  | item_fun t => (fv t)
  end.

Instance ItemFreeVar : FreeVar item := fv_item.

Definition open_rec_item (n: nat) (x: var) (v: item) : item :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => item_obj (open_rec n x ds)
  | item_fun t => item_fun (open_rec (S n) x t)
  end.

Instance ItemOpenable : Openable item := open_rec_item.

Definition subst_item x y (v: item) : item :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => item_obj (subst_var x y ds)
  | item_fun t => item_fun (subst_var x y t)
  end.

Instance ItemSubstVar : SubstVar item := subst_item.

Instance ItemAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax ItemOpenable ItemFreeVar ItemSubstVar := {}.

Definition seal_rec_item (n: nat) (x: var) (v: item) : item :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => item_obj (seal_rec n x ds)
  | item_fun t => item_fun (seal_rec (S n) x t)
  end.

Instance ItemSealable : Sealable item := seal_rec_item.

Definition collect_item {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (it: item) : C :=
  match it with
  | item_obj ds => (collect df f comb ds)
  | item_fun t => (collect df f comb t)
  end.

Instance ItemCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax ItemAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_item.

Definition transform_item (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (it : item) (n : nat) : item :=
  match it with
  | item_obj ds => (item_obj (transform f ds n))
  | item_fun t => (item_fun (transform f t (S n)))
  end.

Instance ItemTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax ItemAbstractSyntax :=

- `defs_update` requires the field to be at the head of some cons: `defs_update (defs_cons ds (def_fld a t)) a x (defs_cons ds (def_fld a (avar_f x)))`. So to update field a, the `def_fld a` must be the most recently consed element (the `d` in defs_cons ds d; note ordering in `defs_has`/`defs_varkinds` cons). Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Labels TransformCollect Types.

Inductive trm : Set :=
  | trm_var  : avar -> trm
  | trm_read  : avar -> fld_label -> trm
  | trm_apply  : avar -> avar -> trm
  | trm_let  : trm -> trm -> trm
  | trm_lit  : lit -> trm -> trm
  | trm_write  : avar -> fld_label -> avar -> trm
  | trm_call: avar -> met_label -> avar -> trm

with lit : Set :=
  | lit_fun : typ -> trm -> lit
  | lit_obj  : typ -> defs -> lit

with def : Set :=
  | def_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> def
  | def_fld  : fld_label -> avar -> def
  | def_met  : met_label -> trm -> def

with defs : Set :=
  | defs_nil : defs
  | defs_cons : defs -> def -> defs.

Scheme trm_mut  := Induction for trm  Sort Prop
with   lit_mut  := Induction for lit  Sort Prop
with   def_mut  := Induction for def  Sort Prop
with   defs_mut := Induction for defs Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme trm_mutind from trm_mut, lit_mut, def_mut, defs_mut.

Fixpoint open_rec_trm (k: nat) (u: var) (t: trm): trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a      => trm_var (open_rec k u a)
  | trm_read v m    => trm_read (open_rec k u v) m
  | trm_apply f a    => trm_apply (open_rec k u f) (open_rec k u a)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (open_rec_trm k u t1) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t2)
  | trm_lit l t => trm_lit (open_rec_lit k u l) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t)
  | trm_write v m v2 => trm_write (open_rec k u v) m (open_rec k u v2)
  | trm_call v m v2 => trm_call (open_rec k u v) m (open_rec k u v2)
  end with
open_rec_lit (k: nat) (u: var) (l: lit): lit :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T t => lit_fun (open_rec k u T) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t)
  | lit_obj T ds =>
    lit_obj
      (open_rec (S k) u T)
      (open_rec_defs (S k) u ds)

  end with

Class TypingEquiv (A : Set) := typing_equiv : renv -> A -> A -> Prop.

Notation "e ⊢ a '≈' b" := (typing_equiv e a b) (at level 40, a at level 59).

Inductive tyq_var: TypingEquiv var :=
| tyq_var_refl(e: renv)(v: var):
  typing_equiv e v v
| tyq_var_binds(e: renv)(v1 v2: var):
  renv_binds v1 v2 e ->
  typing_equiv e v1 v2
| tyq_var_sym(e: renv)(v1 v2: var):
  typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
  typing_equiv e v2 v1
| tyq_var_trans(e: renv)(v1 v2 v3: var):
  typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
  typing_equiv e v2 v3 ->
  typing_equiv e v1 v3
.

Existing Instance tyq_var.

Inductive tyq_typ: TypingEquiv typ :=
| tyq_typ_nulary(e: renv) T:
  typ_nulary T ->
    typing_equiv e T T
| tyq_typ_andor T (e: renv) t11 t12 t21 t22:
  typ_andor T ->
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    typing_equiv e (T t11 t12) (T t21 t22)

| tyq_typ_fld (e: renv) a t11 t12 t21 t22:
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t11 t12)) (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t21 t22))
| tyq_typ_typ (e: renv) B t11 t12 t21 t22:
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t11) (open x t21)) ->
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t12) (open x t22)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd (dec_typ B t11 t12)) (typ_rcd (dec_typ B t21 t22))
| tyq_typ_sel_normal(e: renv)(v1 v2: var) (v3: avar)(l: typ_normal_label):
    typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_sel (avar_f v1) (typ_label_normal l) v3) (typ_sel (avar_f v2) (typ_label_normal l) v3)
| tyq_typ_sel(e: renv)(v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_label):
    typing_equiv e (typ_sel v1 l v2) (typ_sel v1 l v2)

    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t1) (open x t2)) ->

    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->

    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd (dec_met m t11 t12 t13)) (typ_rcd (dec_met m t21 t22 t23))
.

Existing Instance tyq_typ.

# 176 — roDOT with pure methods: side-effect freedom

## Task

Show that a well-typed roDOT call satisfying the side-effect-free premises leaves pre-existing heap objects unchanged while the call is still executing.

Prove this declaration in `Task.v`:

- `SefG_I`

## Input

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.
- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.
- Rocq version: 9.1.0. Local prerequisites: TLC.

The project already includes the listed dependencies; do not install anything for the proof run.

## Rules

- Edit only `Task.v` in the submitted solution. You may add helper definitions and lemmas there. Keep all supplied definitions and target names, statements, and hypotheses unchanged. Do not change support files or `_CoqProject`.
- Do not use `Admitted`, `admit`, or `Abort` in the submitted solution. Do not add axioms or new global assumptions (including via `Axiom`, `Parameter`, or `Conjecture`), disable kernel checks (such as guard, positivity, or universe checking), or use equivalent shortcuts.
- Work offline. Use only the supplied input and permitted local libraries. Do not look up, copy, or import an existing proof of any target.

## Deliverable

A completed `Task.v` that compiles with Rocq using the supplied project configuration, with every listed target proved and no open goals.

To verify, run `make` from the project root. All project dependencies are included.
=====
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping.

Require Import OperationalSemantics ConfigTyping MethodCall.

Theorem SefG_I :
  forall (typing_mode : Mode) (w1 : var) (m : met_label) (w2 : var)
         (TZv : typ) (c1 : config) (G : ctx) (c4 : config) (k : nat),
  mode_has_sef typing_mode ->
  mode_has_mutability typing_mode ->
  config_trm c1 = trm_call (avar_f w1) m (avar_f w2) ->
  (G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ w1 ∶ typ_rcd (dec_met m typ_nocap TZv typ_top) /\
   G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ w2 ∶ TZv /\
   G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ typ_nocap <: TZv) ->
  (exists T1, ty_config G c1 T1) ->
  c1 ⊣k↦* c4 ->
  (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
  subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).

Require Import LibExtra.

Inductive red : config -> config -> Prop :=

| red_read : forall yObj wObj m Sigma e Lv yVal wVal ds fs,
    fresh_in_config (wVal :: nil) (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m; fs ; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
    defs_has ds (def_fld m (avar_f yVal)) ->
    (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m; fs ; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (trm_var (avar_f wVal); fs; Sigma; e & wVal ~ yVal; fv_config (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m; fs ; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_write : forall yObj wObj m Sigma e Lv yArg wArg Sigma' fs,
    heap_update Sigma yObj m yArg Sigma' ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    binds wArg yArg e ->
    (trm_write (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (trm_var (avar_f wArg); fs ; Sigma'; e; fv_config (trm_write (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_call : forall yObj wObj m Sigma e Lv wArg t ds fs,
    binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
    defs_has ds (def_met m t) ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs ; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ ((open wArg (open_rec 1 wObj t)); fs ; Sigma; e; fv_config (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs ; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_apply : forall yFun wFun wArg Sigma e Lv t fs,
    binds yFun (item_fun t) Sigma ->
    binds wFun yFun e ->
    (trm_apply (avar_f wFun) (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open wArg t; fs; Sigma; e; fv_config (trm_apply (avar_f wFun) (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_fun : forall T t1 t2 Sigma e Lv y w fs,
    fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil) (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    y <> w ->
    (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open w t2 ; fs; Sigma & y ~ (item_fun t1); e & w ~ y ; fv_config (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_obj : forall T ds t Sigma e Lv y w fs,
    fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil) (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    w <> y ->
    (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open w t ; fs; Sigma & y ~ (item_obj (deref_defs (e & w ~ y) (open w ds))); e & w ~ y ; fv_config (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_var : forall t Sigma e Lv x fs,
    (trm_var (avar_f x); (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs); Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open x t; fs; Sigma; e ; fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x); (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs); Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_push : forall s t fs Sigma e Lv,
    (trm_let s t; fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (s; (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs); Sigma; e ; fv_config (trm_let s t; fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

where "t1 ↦ t2" := (red t1 t2).

Inductive answer: config -> Prop :=
| nf_loc: forall x Sigma e Lv, answer (trm_var (avar_f x); stack_nil; Sigma; e; Lv).

Reserved Notation "C1 ⊣ n ↦* C2"
         (at level 40, n at level 41, C2 at level 39).

Inductive red_closure :  config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=

| red_refl : forall (C : config),
    C ⊣ 0 ↦* C

| red_trans : forall (C1 C2 C3 : config) (n : nat),
    C1 ⊣ n ↦* C2 ->
    C2      ↦  C3 ->
    C1 ⊣ S n ↦* C3

where "C1 ⊣ n ↦* C2" := (red_closure C1 n C2).

Definition config_terminates_in C n :=
 (exists (Ca : config), answer Ca /\ (C ⊣n↦* Ca)).

Definition config_terminates C :=
 (exists (n : nat), config_terminates_in C n).

Fixpoint ctx_dom(G: ctx): fset var :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => \{}
| ctx_push G v vk t =>  \{ v } \u (ctx_dom G)
| ctx_stop G => ctx_dom G
| ctx_hide G => ctx_dom G
end.

Notation "x '§#' E" := (x \notin (ctx_dom E)) (at level 67) : env_scope.

Inductive ctx_ok: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_ok_empty:
  ctx_ok ctx_empty
| ctx_ok_push(G: ctx)(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ):
  ctx_ok G ->
  v §# G ->
  ctx_ok (ctx_push G v vk t)
| ctx_ok_stop(G: ctx):
  ctx_ok G -> ctx_ok (ctx_stop G)
| ctx_ok_hide(G: ctx):
  ctx_ok G -> ctx_ok (ctx_hide G)
.

Inductive ctx_weakens: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_weakens_empty: ctx_weakens ctx_empty
| ctx_weakens_push G v vk t:
  ctx_weakens G ->
  ctx_weakens (ctx_push G v vk t)
.

Inductive ctx_weakens_hide: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_weakens_hide_empty: ctx_weakens_hide ctx_empty
| ctx_weakens_hide_push G v vk t:
    ctx_weakens_hide G ->
    ctx_weakens_hide (ctx_push G v vk t)
| ctx_weakens_hide_hide G:
    ctx_weakens_hide G ->
    ctx_weakens_hide (ctx_hide G)
.

Inductive ctx_binds: var -> typ -> ctx -> Prop :=
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Types Context.

Inductive objctx: Set :=

| objctx_empty: objctx
| objctx_lit(x: var)(T: typ): objctx
| objctx_heap(y: var)(T: typ): objctx
.

Notation ctx_met G xz TZ xc TC := (G § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (open xz TC)).

Notation open_met xz xc T := (open xz (open_rec 1 xc T)) (only parsing).

Notation close_met z r T := (close z (close_rec 1 r T)) (only parsing).

Definition ctx_obj(G: ctx)(Go: objctx) :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => G
  | objctx_lit x T => G § x / v_self ~ open x T
  | objctx_heap y T => G
  end.

Notation ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC TC2 := (G § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (typ_and (open xz TC) TC2)).

Notation ctx_met_refined_heap G xz TZ xc TC y T := (ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC (typ_and (open y T) (open xc T))).

Definition subst_objctx vSrc vDst Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_var vSrc vDst T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_var vSrc vDst y) (subst_var vSrc vDst T)
  end.

Notation "G '/[§§' x '->' y ']'" :=
  (subst_objctx x y G) (x at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Definition subst_objctx_pvars xs ys Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_pvars xs ys T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_pvars xs ys y) (subst_pvars xs ys T)
  end.

Definition subst_objctx_varx vsSrc vsDst Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping EnvCorrespondence TFree ConfigVarkinds Defs RecordDefs.

Inductive defs_update : defs -> fld_label -> var -> defs -> Prop :=
| defs_update_var : forall ds a t x,
    defs_update (defs_cons ds (def_fld a t)) a x (defs_cons ds (def_fld a (avar_f x)))
| defs_update_push : forall ds d a x ds',
    defs_update ds a x ds' ->
    label_of d <> (label_fld a) ->
    defs_update (defs_cons ds d) a x (defs_cons ds' d).

Definition heap_update (s : heap) (x : var) (a : fld_label) (y : var) (s' : heap) :=
  ok s /\
  ok s' /\
  (dom s) = (dom s') /\
  (forall z v, z <> x ->
          binds z v s ->
          binds z v s') /\
  exists ds ds', binds x (item_obj ds) s /\
              defs_update ds a y ds' /\
              binds x (item_obj ds') s'.

Require Import RecordTypes InertContext HeapCorrespondence.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Types Context Envs.

Notation renv := (env var) (only parsing).

Notation renv_empty := (empty) (only parsing).

Notation renv_bind e v1 v2 := (e & v1 ~ v2) (only parsing).

Definition renv_notin (v: var) (e: renv) := v \notin (dom e \u fv_env e).

Definition renv_idempotent (e: renv) := forall x, x \in dom e -> x \notin fv_env e.

Notation renv_binds v1 v2 e := (binds v1 v2 e) (only parsing).
====ENVS
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import TransformCollect Vars.

Section EnvLemmas.

Context {A: Set}.

Context {AF: FreeVar A}.

End EnvLemmas.
====TERMS
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Labels TransformCollect Types.

Inductive trm : Set :=
  | trm_var  : avar -> trm
  | trm_read  : avar -> fld_label -> trm
  | trm_apply  : avar -> avar -> trm
  | trm_let  : trm -> trm -> trm
  | trm_lit  : lit -> trm -> trm
  | trm_write  : avar -> fld_label -> avar -> trm
  | trm_call: avar -> met_label -> avar -> trm

with lit : Set :=
  | lit_fun : typ -> trm -> lit
  | lit_obj  : typ -> defs -> lit

with def : Set :=
  | def_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> def
  | def_fld  : fld_label -> avar -> def
  | def_met  : met_label -> trm -> def

with defs : Set :=
  | defs_nil : defs
  | defs_cons : defs -> def -> defs.

Scheme trm_mut  := Induction for trm  Sort Prop
with   lit_mut  := Induction for lit  Sort Prop
with   def_mut  := Induction for def  Sort Prop
with   defs_mut := Induction for defs Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme trm_mutind from trm_mut, lit_mut, def_mut, defs_mut.

Fixpoint open_rec_trm (k: nat) (u: var) (t: trm): trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a      => trm_var (open_rec k u a)
  | trm_read v m    => trm_read (open_rec k u v) m
  | trm_apply f a    => trm_apply (open_rec k u f) (open_rec k u a)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (open_rec_trm k u t1) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t2)
  | trm_lit l t => trm_lit (open_rec_lit k u l) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t)
  | trm_write v m v2 => trm_write (open_rec k u v) m (open_rec k u v2)
  | trm_call v m v2 => trm_call (open_rec k u v) m (open_rec k u v2)
  end with
open_rec_lit (k: nat) (u: var) (l: lit): lit :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T t => lit_fun (open_rec k u T) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t)
  | lit_obj T ds =>
    lit_obj
      (open_rec (S k) u T)
      (open_rec_defs (S k) u ds)

  end with
open_rec_def (k: nat) (u: var) (d: def): def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (open_rec (S k) u T)
  | def_fld m v => def_fld m (open_rec k u v)
  | def_met m e => def_met m (open_rec_trm (S (S k)) u e)
  end with
open_rec_defs (k: nat) (u: var) (ds: defs): defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil       => defs_nil
  | defs_cons tl d => defs_cons (open_rec_defs k u tl) (open_rec_def k u d)
  end.

Instance TrmOpenable : Openable trm := open_rec_trm.

Instance LitOpenable : Openable lit := open_rec_lit.

Instance DefOpenable : Openable def := open_rec_def.

Instance DefsOpenable : Openable defs := open_rec_defs.

Fixpoint fv_trm (t: trm) : vars :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a         => (fv a)
  | trm_read x m       => (fv x)
  | trm_apply f a       => (fv f) \u (fv a)
  | trm_let t1 t2     => (fv_trm t1) \u (fv_trm t2)
  | trm_lit l t       => (fv_lit l) \u (fv_trm t)

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import Stdlib.Init.Sumbool.

Require Import LibExtra.

Generalizable Variables A B.

Declare Scope syntax_scope.

Delimit Scope syntax_scope with S.

Open Scope syntax_scope.

Class Openable (A : Set) := open_rec : nat -> var -> A -> A.

Class FreeVar (A : Set) := fv : A -> vars.

Class SubstVar (A : Set) := subst_var : var -> var -> A -> A.

Bind Scope syntax_scope with Openable FreeVar SubstVar.

Arguments open_rec _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Arguments fv _ _ !_ /.

Arguments subst_var _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Class AbstractSyntax (A : Set) `(Openable A) `(FreeVar A) `(SubstVar A).

Notation "z '/[' x '->' y ']'" :=
  (subst_var x y z) (x at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation subst_vars := (vars_zip_map subst_var) (only parsing).

Notation "z '/[' xs '-->' ys ']'" :=
  (subst_vars xs ys z) (xs at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Definition subst_pvars `{AS: SubstVar A} `{AF: FreeVar A}
  (xs ys: list var) (a: A): A :=
    let (zs, _) := (var_freshes (from_list xs \u from_list ys \u fv a) (length ys))
    in a /[xs --> zs] /[zs --> ys].

Notation "z '//[' xs '-->' ys ']'" :=
  (subst_pvars xs ys z) (xs at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation open := (open_rec 0) (only parsing).

Definition open_depth_rec `{AS : Openable A} n x a d :=
  open_rec (n + d) x a.

Notation open_depth := (open_depth_rec 0).

Arguments open_depth_rec _ _ _ _ !_ _ /.

Definition closed `{AS: Openable A} a :=
  forall n x, open_rec n x a = a.

Fixpoint open_rec_vars `{AS : Openable A} (k: nat) (ys: list var) (X: A): A :=
  match ys with
  | nil => X
  | cons y ys => open_rec_vars (S k) ys (open_rec k y X)
  end.

Notation open_vars := (open_rec_vars 0) (only parsing).

Arguments open_rec_vars _ _ _ !_ _ /.

Notation "z '/[#' n '->' y ']'" :=
  (open_rec n y z) (n at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation "z '/[->' y ']'" :=
  (open y z) (at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation "z '/[#' n '-->' ys ']'" :=
  (open_rec_vars n ys z) (n at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation "z '/[-->' ys ']'" :=
  (open_vars ys z) (at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Class Sealable (A: Set) := seal_rec: nat -> var -> A -> A.

Bind Scope syntax_scope with Sealable.

Arguments seal_rec _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Notation seal := (seal_rec 0).

Definition sealed `{AS: Sealable A} a :=
  forall x, seal x a = a.

Definition seal_depth_rec `{AS: Sealable A} n x a d := seal_rec (n+d) x a.

Arguments seal_depth_rec _ _ _ _ !_ _ /.

Notation "z '/[->>' y ']'" :=
  (seal y z) (at level 7) : syntax_scope.

Notation "z '/[#' n '->>' y ']'" :=
  (seal_rec n y z) (n at level 69, at level 7) : syntax_scope.

Class DecideFv `(AS: AbstractSyntax A) := dec_fv : var -> A -> bool.

Arguments dec_fv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Definition dec_notin_fv `{DFv: DecideFv A} x a := negb (dec_fv x a).

Arguments dec_notin_fv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Class ReflectFv `(DFv: DecideFv A) :=
  reflect_fv : forall x a,
    (x \in fv a) <-> (dec_fv x a) = true.

Class Closing `(AS: AbstractSyntax A) :=
  close_rec : nat -> var -> A -> A.

Bind Scope syntax_scope with Closing.

fix fresh (L : vars) (n : nat) (xs : list var) {struct xs} : Prop :=
  match xs with
  | nil => match n with
           | 0 => True
           | S _ => False

  | (x :: xs')%list =>
      match n with
      | 0 => False
      | S n' => x \notin L /\ fresh (L \u \{ x}) n' xs'
      end
  end
     : vars -> nat -> list var -> Prop

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping.
Require Import OperationalSemantics.HeapUpdate OperationalSemantics.OperationalSemantics.
Require Import Syntax.Heap Syntax.Env.


Definition changes_at_most (S S' : heap) (y : var) : Prop :=
  forall z v, z <> y -> binds z v S -> binds z v S'.

(* Every single reduction step changes at most one heap location. *)
Lemma red_changes_at_most :
  forall c c', red c c' ->
    exists y, changes_at_most (config_heap c) (config_heap c') y.
Proof.
  intros c c' Hred. destruct Hred.
  - (* red_read *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_write *) exists yObj. intros z v Hne Hb.
    unfold heap_update in H. destruct H as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    apply Hunch; assumption.
  - (* red_call *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_apply *) exists wFun. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_fun *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_obj *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_var *) exists x. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_push *) exists (var_gen (\{} : vars)). intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
Qed.

(* A reduction closure where every step changes at most one location,
   and no changed location belongs to a fixed set H (the initial heap). *)
Inductive red_closure_fresh_writes (H : heap) : config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=
| rcfw_refl c :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c 0 c
| rcfw_step c1 c2 c3 n y :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 n c2 ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom H ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 (S n) c3.

Lemma binds_in_dom : forall (S : heap) z v,
  binds z v S -> z \in dom S.
Proof.
  intros S z v H. exact (@get_some_inv item z v S H).
Qed.

Lemma rcfw_preserves :
  forall H c1 k c4,
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c1) ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros H c1 k c4 Hsub Hcl. induction Hcl as [c | c1 c2 c3 n y Hcl IH Hred Hch Hy].
  - exact Hsub.
  - intros z v Hz.
    apply Hch.
    + intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq. exact (@get_some_inv item z v H Hz).
    + apply IH. exact Hsub.
Qed.

(* The whole second disjunct follows from the effect-freedom invariant that
   every write performed during the run targets a location outside the
   initial heap. *)
Theorem subheap_unchanged_of_fresh_writes :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure_fresh_writes (config_heap c1) c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl.
  eapply rcfw_preserves. 2: exact Hcl.
  intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
Qed.

(* A reduction closure where every step changes at most one location,
   and no changed location belongs to a fixed set H (the initial heap). *)
Inductive red_closure_fresh_writes (H : heap) : config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=
| rcfw_refl c :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c 0 c
| rcfw_step c1 c2 c3 n y :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 n c2 ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom H ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 (S n) c3.

  forall H c1 k c4,
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c1) ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c4).

  - intros z v Hz.

  intros z v Hz. exact Hz.

(* ---------- reduction of the target theorem to a typing invariant ---------- *)
Require Import OperationalSemantics.MethodCall Coq.Arith.Arith.

Definition SefInv (c1 : config) (k : nat) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3 y,
    j < k ->
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom (config_heap c1).

Lemma red_closure_inv : forall c1 k c4,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (k = 0 /\ c4 = c1) \/
  (exists n c2, k = S n /\ red_closure c1 n c2 /\ red c2 c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 k c4 H. destruct H.
  - left. auto.
  - right. exists n, C2. auto.
Qed.

Theorem SefG_I_from_invariant :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure c1 k c4 ->
    SefInv c1 k ->
    (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl. revert c4 Hcl. induction k as [| n IH]; intros c4 Hcl Hinv.
  - (* k = 0 *)
    right. destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [[_ ->] | [n' [c2 [E _]]]].
    + intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
    + discriminate E.
  - (* k = S n *)
    destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [[E _] | [n' [c2 [E Hcln Hstep]]]].
    + discriminate E.
    + injection E as ->.
      destruct (classic (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < S n)) as [Hex | Hno].
      * left. exact Hex.
      * right.
        assert (Hinv_n : SefInv c1 n).
        { intros j c2' c3 y Hj Hclj Hnf Hred' Hch.
          apply (Hinv j c2' c3 y); auto. lia. }
        destruct (IH c2 Hcln Hinv_n) as [Hex' | Hsub].
        { exfalso. apply Hno. destruct Hex' as [j [c3 [Hfe Hlt]]].
          exists j, c3. split; auto. lia. }

        assert (Hy : y \notin dom (config_heap c1)).
        { apply (Hinv n c2 c4 y); auto. lia.
          intros c3' Hfe. apply Hno. exists n, c3'. split; auto. lia. }
        intros z v Hz.
        apply Hch.
        + intro Heq. subst z. apply Hy. exact (@get_some_inv item z v (config_heap c1) Hz).
        + apply Hsub. exact Hz.
Qed.
EOF

Require Import LibExtra.

Inductive method_call_begin: config -> Prop :=
| method_call_begin_c w1 m w2 fs S e Lv:
  method_call_begin (trm_call (avar_f w1) m (avar_f w2); fs; S; e; Lv).

Definition config_stack C := (
  match C with
  t1 ; fs1 ; S1 ; e1 ; Lv1 => fs1
  end
).

Definition config_trm C := (
  match C with
  t1 ; fs1 ; S1 ; e1 ; Lv1 => t1
  end
).

Definition frame_within C1 m := (
  forall k C4,
    k <= m ->
    C1 ⊣ k ↦* C4 ->
    stack_suffix (config_stack C1) (config_stack C4)
).

Definition frame_end_in C1 m C3 := (
  C1 ⊣ m ↦* C3 /\
  frame_within C1 m /\
  (config_stack C3) = (config_stack C1) /\
  exists w3,
    (config_trm C3) = (trm_var (avar_f w3))
).

Definition frame_end_in' C1 m C3 := (
  C1 ⊣ m ↦* C3 /\
  (config_stack C3) = (config_stack C1) /\
  exists w3,
    (config_trm C3) = (trm_var (avar_f w3))
).

  | objctx_empty => nil
  | objctx_lit x T => x::nil
  | objctx_heap y T => nil
  end.

Definition objctx_fv Go :=

  | objctx_empty => \{}

  end.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

| typ_corr_obj(T S U: typ):
  typ_refcap_corr S U ->
  typ_corr (typ_objref T S) (typ_objref T U)
| typ_corr_fun(t1 t2: typ):
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  typ_corr (typ_fun t1 t2) (typ_fun t1 t2)
.

Inductive renv_corr: ctx -> renv -> Prop :=

| renv_corr_empty(G: ctx):

.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Vars Types Context Env Equivalence.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Inductive typ_indep: avar -> typ -> Prop :=
| typ_indep_nulary v T:
  typ_nulary T -> typ_indep v T

| typ_indep_and v t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_and t1 t2)
| typ_indep_or v t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_or t1 t2)
| typ_indep_fld v a t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Labels TransformCollect.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top  : typ
  | typ_bot  : typ
  | typ_rcd  : dec -> typ
  | typ_and  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_or   : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_sel  : avar -> typ_label -> avar -> typ
  | typ_bnd  : typ -> typ
  | typ_fun  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_nocap: typ

with dec : Set :=
  | dec_typ: typ_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_fld: fld_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_met: met_label ->  typ -> typ -> typ -> dec
.

Notation typ_cap_marker C T := (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap C) typ_bot T)) (only parsing).

Notation typ_mut_marker T := (typ_cap_marker typ_refcap_mutability T) (only parsing).

Scheme typ_mut  := Induction for typ Sort Prop
with   dec_mut  := Induction for dec Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme typ_mutind from typ_mut, dec_mut.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y => typ_sel (open_rec k u x) L (open_rec k u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  end.

Instance TypTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax TypAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_typ.

Instance DecTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax DecAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_dec.

Inductive typ_nulary: typ -> Prop :=
| typ_nulary_top: typ_nulary typ_top
| typ_nulary_bot: typ_nulary typ_bot
| typ_nulary_nocap: typ_nulary typ_nocap
.

Inductive typ_andor: (typ -> typ -> typ) -> Prop :=
| typ_andor_and: typ_andor typ_and
| typ_andor_or: typ_andor typ_or
.

Notation typ_binary_rcd_typ_ctor A :=
  (fun t1 t2 => typ_rcd (dec_typ A t1 t2)).

Notation typ_binary_rcd_fld_ctor A :=
  (fun t1 t2 => typ_rcd (dec_fld A t1 t2)).

Inductive typ_binary: (typ -> typ -> typ) -> Prop :=
| typ_binary_and: typ_binary typ_and
| typ_binary_or: typ_binary typ_or
| typ_binary_fun: typ_binary typ_fun
| typ_binary_rcd_typ(A: typ_label): typ_binary (typ_binary_rcd_typ_ctor A)
| typ_binary_rcd_fld(A: fld_label): typ_binary (typ_binary_rcd_fld_ctor A)
.

Notation typ_notor B := (forall T U, B <> typ_or T U) (only parsing).

Notation typ_notand T := (forall S1 S2, T <> typ_and S1 S2) (only parsing).

Definition typ_notlog T := typ_notor T /\ typ_notand T.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping EnvCorrespondence TFree Deref.

Inductive def_varkinds: ctx -> def -> Prop :=

| def_varkinds_fld G x l:
  ctx_k G x v_loc ->
  def_varkinds G (def_fld l (avar_f x))

| def_varkinds_typ G T l:
  def_varkinds G (def_typ l T)

| def_varkinds_met G t l:
  all_tfree_k G t v_ref ->
  def_varkinds G (def_met l t)
.

Inductive defs_varkinds: ctx -> defs -> Prop :=
| defs_varkinds_nil G:
  defs_varkinds G (defs_nil)
| defs_varkinds_cons G ds d:
  defs_varkinds G ds ->
  def_varkinds G d ->
  defs_varkinds G (defs_cons ds d)
.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import TypingMode.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Notation vis_hide typing_mode G := (
  match (mode_visibility' typing_mode) with
  | mode_visibility_all => G
  | mode_visibility_hide_method => (ctx_hide G)
  end
  ) (only parsing).

Definition ctx_obj_met typing_mode (G: ctx)(Go: objctx)(xz: var)(TZ: typ)(xc: var)(TC: typ) :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => ctx_met (vis_hide typing_mode G) xz TZ xc TC
  | objctx_lit x T => ctx_met_refined (vis_hide typing_mode (G § x / v_self ~ open x T)) xz TZ xc TC (typ_and (open x T) (open xc T))
  | objctx_heap y T => ctx_met_refined_heap (vis_hide typing_mode G) xz TZ xc TC y T

  end.
====
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax GeneralTyping TypingContext.

Class Unhiding (A B: Set) (property: TypingProperty A B) :=
  unhiding G1 G2 Go e (a: A) (b: B):
    property ((ctx_hide G1) §& G2) Go e a b ->
    property (G1 §& G2) Go e a b.

Class Hiding (A B: Set) (property: TypingProperty A B) :=
  hiding G1 G2 Go e (a: A) (b: B):
    property (G1 §& G2) Go e a b ->
    property ((ctx_hide G1) §& G2) Go e a b.

Section UnhidingLemmata.

Context {A B: Set}{P: TypingProperty A B}{AW: Unhiding P}.

End UnhidingLemmata.

Section HidingLemmata.

Context {A B: Set}{P: TypingProperty A B}{AW: Hiding P}.

End HidingLemmata.

Definition UnhidingInd (A B: Set) (property: TypingProperty A B) :=
  forall G Go e (a: A) (b: B),
    property G Go e a b ->
    forall G1 G2,
      G = (ctx_hide G1) §& G2 ->
      property (G1 §& G2) Go e a b.

Definition UnhidingTInd (A: Set) (t: Typing A) := UnhidingInd obj_typing.

Definition UnhidingDInd (A: Set) (t: DecTyping A) := UnhidingInd obj_dec_typing.

Definition UnhidingIncapInd (_ : ReferenceIncapacitate) :=
  UnhidingInd obj_ref_incap.

Definition UnhidingCapbndInd (C : typ_refcap_label) (_ : CapabilityBound C) :=
  UnhidingInd obj_cap_bnd.

Definition HidingInd (A B: Set) (property: TypingProperty A B) :=
  forall G Go e (a: A) (b: B),
    property G Go e a b ->
    forall G1 G2,
      G = G1 §& G2 ->
      property ((ctx_hide G1) §& G2) Go e a b.

Definition HidingTInd (A: Set) (t: Typing A) := HidingInd obj_typing.

Definition HidingDInd (A: Set) (t: DecTyping A) := HidingInd obj_dec_typing.

Definition HidingIncapInd (_ : ReferenceIncapacitate)
  := HidingInd obj_ref_incap.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import AbstractSyntax.

Class TypingEquiv (A : Set) := typing_equiv : renv -> A -> A -> Prop.

Notation "e ⊢ a '≈' b" := (typing_equiv e a b) (at level 40, a at level 59).

Inductive tyq_var: TypingEquiv var :=
| tyq_var_refl(e: renv)(v: var):
  typing_equiv e v v
| tyq_var_binds(e: renv)(v1 v2: var):
  renv_binds v1 v2 e ->
  typing_equiv e v1 v2
| tyq_var_sym(e: renv)(v1 v2: var):
  typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
  typing_equiv e v2 v1
| tyq_var_trans(e: renv)(v1 v2 v3: var):
  typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
  typing_equiv e v2 v3 ->
  typing_equiv e v1 v3
.

Existing Instance tyq_var.

Inductive tyq_typ: TypingEquiv typ :=
| tyq_typ_nulary(e: renv) T:
  typ_nulary T ->
    typing_equiv e T T
| tyq_typ_andor T (e: renv) t11 t12 t21 t22:
  typ_andor T ->
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    typing_equiv e (T t11 t12) (T t21 t22)
| tyq_typ_fun (e: renv) t11 t12 t21 t22:
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t12) (open x t22)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_fun t11 t12) (typ_fun t21 t22)
| tyq_typ_fld (e: renv) a t11 t12 t21 t22:
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t11 t12)) (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t21 t22))
| tyq_typ_typ (e: renv) B t11 t12 t21 t22:
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t11) (open x t21)) ->
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t12) (open x t22)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd (dec_typ B t11 t12)) (typ_rcd (dec_typ B t21 t22))
| tyq_typ_sel_normal(e: renv)(v1 v2: var) (v3: avar)(l: typ_normal_label):
    typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_sel (avar_f v1) (typ_label_normal l) v3) (typ_sel (avar_f v2) (typ_label_normal l) v3)
| tyq_typ_sel(e: renv)(v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_label):
    typing_equiv e (typ_sel v1 l v2) (typ_sel v1 l v2)
| tyq_typ_bnd(e: renv)(t1 t2: typ):
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t1) (open x t2)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_bnd t1) (typ_bnd t2)
| tyq_typ_met m (e: renv) t11 t12 t13 t21 t22 t23:
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t11) (open x t21)) ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    (forall x y, typing_equiv e (open_met x y t13) (open_met x y t23)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd (dec_met m t11 t12 t13)) (typ_rcd (dec_met m t21 t22 t23))
.

Existing Instance tyq_typ.

Inductive tyq_var_alt: renv -> var -> var -> Prop :=
| tyq_var_alt_eq e v:
    tyq_var_alt e v v
| tyq_var_alt_wy e w y:
    binds w y e ->
    tyq_var_alt e w y
| tyq_var_alt_yw e w y:
    binds w y e ->
    tyq_var_alt e y w
| tyq_var_alt_ww e w1 w2 y:
    binds w1 y e ->
    binds w2 y e ->

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars TransformCollect Types Terms Envs.

Inductive item : Set :=
  | item_obj: defs -> item
  | item_fun: trm -> item.

Definition fv_item (v: item) : vars :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => (fv ds)
  | item_fun t => (fv t)
  end.

Instance ItemFreeVar : FreeVar item := fv_item.

Definition open_rec_item (n: nat) (x: var) (v: item) : item :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => item_obj (open_rec n x ds)
  | item_fun t => item_fun (open_rec (S n) x t)
  end.

Instance ItemOpenable : Openable item := open_rec_item.

Definition subst_item x y (v: item) : item :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => item_obj (subst_var x y ds)
  | item_fun t => item_fun (subst_var x y t)
  end.

Instance ItemSubstVar : SubstVar item := subst_item.

Instance ItemAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax ItemOpenable ItemFreeVar ItemSubstVar := {}.

Definition seal_rec_item (n: nat) (x: var) (v: item) : item :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => item_obj (seal_rec n x ds)
  | item_fun t => item_fun (seal_rec (S n) x t)
  end.

Instance ItemSealable : Sealable item := seal_rec_item.

Definition collect_item {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (it: item) : C :=
  match it with
  | item_obj ds => (collect df f comb ds)
  | item_fun t => (collect df f comb t)
  end.

Instance ItemCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax ItemAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_item.

Definition transform_item (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (it : item) (n : nat) : item :=
  match it with
  | item_obj ds => (item_obj (transform f ds n))
  | item_fun t => (item_fun (transform f t (S n)))
  end.

Instance ItemTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax ItemAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_item.

Notation heap := (env item).

Notation fv_heap Sigma := ((@dom item Sigma) \u (fv_env Sigma)).

Definition subst_heap x y : heap -> heap := map (subst_var x y).

Notation subheap_unchanged S1 S2 :=
  (forall y itm, binds y itm S1 -> binds y itm S2) (only parsing).

Class Fields (A: Type) :=
  fields: A -> vars.

Definition fields_def d: vars :=
  match d with
    | def_typ A T => \{}
    | def_met a t => \{}
    | def_fld a (avar_f x) => \{x}
    | def_fld a (avar_b n) => \{}
  end.

Instance FieldsDef: Fields def := fields_def.

Fixpoint fields_defs ds: vars :=
  match ds with
    | defs_nil => \{}
    | defs_cons ds d => (fields_defs ds) \u (fields d)
  end.

Instance FieldsDefs: Fields defs := fields_defs.

Fixpoint fields_item it: vars :=
  match it with
    | item_fun f => \{}
    | item_obj ds => (fields ds)
  end.

Instance FieldsItem: Fields item := fields_item.

Fixpoint fields_heap (S: heap) : vars :=
  match S with
    | nil%list => \{}
    | ((y,ds)::E)%list => (fields_heap E) \u (fields ds)
  end.

Instance FieldsHeap: Fields heap := fields_heap.

Class FieldsInFv (A: Set) {AF: Fields A}{AV: FreeVar A} :=
  fields_in_fv (a: A): fields a \c fv a.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep Equivalence.

Inductive record_dec : dec -> Prop :=
| rd_typ : forall A T, record_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T T)
| rd_typb : forall A T, record_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) typ_bot T)
| rd_fld : forall a T, record_dec (dec_fld a T T)
| rd_met : forall m TC TZ TR, record_dec (dec_met m TC TZ TR)
.

Inductive record_typ : typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
| rt_one : forall D l,
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  record_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
| rt_cons: forall T ls D l,
  record_typ T ls ->
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  l \notin ls ->
  record_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (union ls \{l}).

Definition record_type T := exists ls, record_typ T ls.

Inductive refcap_dec: dec -> Prop :=
  | refcap_dec_typb lt TU:
    refcap_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap lt) typ_bot TU).

Inductive refcap_typ: typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
  | refcap_typ_top:
      refcap_typ typ_top \{}
  | refcap_typ_one D l:
      refcap_dec D ->
      l = label_of D ->
      refcap_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
  | refcap_typ_cons T ls D l:
      refcap_typ T ls ->
      refcap_dec D ->
      l = label_of D ->
      l \notin ls ->
      refcap_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (union ls \{l}).

Definition refcap_type T := exists ls, refcap_typ T ls.

Inductive record_has: typ -> dec -> Prop :=
| rh_one : forall D,
    record_has (typ_rcd D) D
| rh_andl : forall T U D,
    record_has T D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D
| rh_andr : forall T U D,
    record_has U D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep Equivalence RecordTypes.

Notation typ_objref T S := (typ_and (typ_bnd T) S) (only parsing).

Notation typ_objref_loc typing_mode T := (
  match (mode_refcaps' typing_mode) with
  | mode_refcaps_none => (typ_objref T typ_top)
  | mode_refcaps_mutability => (typ_objref T (typ_mut_marker typ_bot))
  end)(only parsing).

Inductive refcap_inert_mutability: typ -> varkind -> Prop :=
| refacp_inert_mutability_loc: refcap_inert_mutability (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) v_loc
| refacp_inert_mutability_ref Tbnd: refcap_inert_mutability (typ_mut_marker Tbnd) v_ref
.

Definition refcap_inert_type {typing_mode: Mode} T vk :=
  match (mode_refcaps' typing_mode) with
  | mode_refcaps_none => refcap_typ T \{}
  | mode_refcaps_mutability => refcap_inert_mutability T vk
  end.

Notation obj_typ_is cond T S vk := (
      record_type T ->
      refcap_inert_type S vk ->
      typ_indep_b 0 T ->
      cond (typ_objref T S) vk) (only parsing).

Notation fun_typ_is cond S T := (
      cond (typ_fun S T)) (only parsing).

Notation fun_type U := (exists S T, fun_typ_is (eq U) S T) (only parsing).

Notation obj_type typing_mode U := (exists T S, obj_typ_is typing_mode (eq U) T S) (only parsing).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive inert_vk: varkind -> Prop :=
  | inert_vk_loc: inert_vk v_loc
  | inert_vk_ref: inert_vk v_ref.

Inductive inert_typ: typ -> varkind -> Prop :=

  | inert_typ_fun S T vk:
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    fun_typ_is inert_typ S T vk

  | inert_typ_obj T S vk:
    obj_typ_is inert_typ T S vk.

Definition inert_type T := exists vk, inert_typ T vk.

Inductive inert: ctx -> Prop :=
  | inert_empty: inert ctx_empty
  | inert_push G x vk T:
      inert G ->
      inert_vk vk ->
      inert_typ T vk ->
      x §# G ->
      x \notin ctx_fv G ->
      x \notin fv T ->
      inert (G § x / vk ~ T).

End WithTypingMode.

Arguments inert [typing_mode].

Arguments inert_typ {typing_mode}.

Arguments inert_type {typing_mode}.

Inductive fresh_telescope : ctx -> Prop :=
  | fresh_telescope_empty : fresh_telescope ctx_empty
  | fresh_telescope_push : forall G x vk T,
      fresh_telescope G ->
      x §# G ->
      x \notin ctx_fv G ->
      x \notin fv T ->
      fresh_telescope (G § x / vk ~ T).

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 1. Which constructors satisfy both mode_has_sef and mode_has_mutability? *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma sef_mut_modes :
  forall m : mode,
    mode_has_sef m ->
    mode_has_mutability m ->
    m = rodot_sef \/ m = rodot_nm_muttop \/
    m = rodot_nm_compl \/ m = rodot_nm_compl_muttop.
Proof.
  intros m HS HM.
  destruct m; cbn in *; try discriminate; auto.
Qed.

(* The four surviving modes: incap is the "nocap" discipline, functions are off,
   visibility hides method bodies. *)
Lemma sef_mut_mode_incap :
  forall m : mode,
    mode_has_sef m ->
    mode_has_mutability m ->
    mode_incap' m = mode_incap_nocap.
Proof.
  intros m HS HM. destruct m; cbn in *; try discriminate; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma sef_mut_mode_has_incap :
  forall m : mode,
    mode_has_sef m ->
    mode_has_mutability m ->
    mode_has_incap' m = true.
Proof.
  intros m HS HM. destruct m; cbn in *; try discriminate; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma sef_mut_mode_no_fun :
  forall m : mode,
    mode_has_sef m ->
    mode_has_mutability m ->
    mode_has_fun' m = false.
Proof.
  intros m HS HM. destruct m; cbn in *; try discriminate; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma sef_mut_mode_hide :
  forall m : mode,
    mode_has_sef m ->
    mode_has_mutability m ->
    mode_visibility' m = mode_visibility_hide_method.
Proof.
  intros m HS HM. destruct m; cbn in *; try discriminate; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* In the two "muttop" modes, top is a subtype of the mutable-top marker;
   in the two complement modes, top is covered by the nocap-or-mutable-bot union. *)
Lemma sef_mut_mode_mut_top_cases :
  forall m : mode,
    mode_has_sef m ->
    mode_has_mutability m ->
    mode_mut_top' m = mode_mut_top_subtype \/
    mode_top_nm' m = mode_top_nm_complement.
Proof.
  intros m HS HM. destruct m; cbn in *; try discriminate; auto.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 2. The incapability obstruction for a mutable reference marker.      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Section Incap.
Context (typing_mode : Mode).
Context (Hincap : mode_incap' typing_mode = mode_incap_nocap).

(* A ref-capability record can only be *self*-incapacitated through the
   "nocap" rule; ty_incap_cap deliberately returns typ_top. *)
Lemma incap_refcap_self_iff :
  forall G e (M : typ_refcap_label) S T,
    (G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap M) S T)
       ∶icp typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap M) S T)) <->
    (G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap M) S T)).
Proof.
  intros G e M S T. split.
  - intros H. dependent destruction H.
    + (* nocap rule *) assumption.
    + (* cap rule would need rcd = top *) discriminate.
    + (* typ rule is for normal labels *) discriminate.
    + (* structural records: fld/met *) discriminate.
    + (* and *) discriminate.
    + (* or *) discriminate.
    + (* fun *) discriminate.
    + (* rec *) discriminate.
    + (* sel *) discriminate.
    + (* top *) discriminate.
    + (* bot *) discriminate.
  - intros H. eapply ty_incap_nocap; eauto.
Qed.

End Incap.

(* Specialisation to mut_marker bot. *)
Lemma incap_mutbot_iff :
  forall typing_mode : Mode,
    mode_incap' typing_mode = mode_incap_nocap ->
    forall G e,
      (G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_mut_marker typ_bot ∶icp typ_mut_marker typ_bot) <->
      (G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_mut_marker typ_bot).
Proof.
  intros typing_mode Hincap G e.
  unfold typ_mut_marker, typ_cap_marker.
  eapply incap_refcap_self_iff; eauto.
Qed.

(* A conjunction whose first component is the mutable-bot marker: any
   self-incapacitation must again reduce to nocap <: mut_marker bot. *)
Lemma incap_and_mutbot_self :
  forall typing_mode : Mode,
    mode_incap' typing_mode = mode_incap_nocap ->
    forall G e (X : typ),
      (G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_and (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) X
         ∶icp typ_and (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) X) ->
      (G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_mut_marker typ_bot) \/
      (G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_mut_marker typ_bot ∶icp typ_mut_marker typ_bot).
Proof.
  intros typing_mode Hincap G e X H.
  dependent destruction H.
  - (* nocap rule: nocap <: and mutbot X, hence nocap <: mutbot *)
    left. eapply subtyp_trans; [ exact H | eapply subtyp_and11 ].
  - (* and rule: target must be exactly and mutbot X, so first component
       is a self-incap of mutbot *)
    right. match goal with H : _ ⊢ typ_mut_marker typ_bot ∶icp _ |- _ => exact H end.
  - (* all shape-mismatched rules *)
    all: try discriminate.
Qed.

(* The numeric code above relies on the constructor ordering of ty_incap.
   Re-derive the crucial and-case more robustly: *)
Lemma incap_and_mutbot_self' :
  forall typing_mode : Mode,
    mode_incap' typing_mode = mode_incap_nocap ->
    forall G e (X : typ),
      (G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_and (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) X
         ∶icp typ_and (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) X) ->
      (G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_mut_marker typ_bot) \/
      (G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_mut_marker typ_bot ∶icp typ_mut_marker typ_bot).
Proof.
  intros typing_mode Hincap G e X H.
  remember (typ_and (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) X) as A eqn:EA in *.
  induction H; subst; try discriminate.
  - (* nocap rule *) left. eapply subtyp_trans; [ exact H | eapply subtyp_and11 ].
  - (* and rule, target is A = and mutbot X; induction keeps target as A,
       so we must invert the hypothesis that the target shape is and. *)
    right.
    match goal with
    | H1 : _ ⊢ typ_mut_marker typ_bot ∶icp ?S2,
      H2 : _ ⊢ ?T1 ∶icp ?T2,
      E : typ_and ?S2 ?T2 = typ_and (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) X |- _ =>
      injection E as ES ET; subst; exact H1
    end.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 3. Bound self-types evade the theorem's nocap premise:              *)
(*    nocap <: typ_bnd T holds for every T, including mutable ones.    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma nocap_sub_bnd :
  forall G e (T : typ), G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_bnd T.
Proof. intros. apply subtyp_nocap_bnd. Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 4. The dependent-selection mechanism can indeed inhabit a self type  *)
(*    that mentions the argument variable -- but only when the receiver *)
(*    already has the lower-bound capability.                           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma var_sel2_intro :
  forall typing_mode : Mode,
  forall G e (x z : var) (A : typ_label) (S T : typ),
    G ⁏ e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
    G ⁏ e ⊢ z ∶ open (avar_f z) S ->
    G ⁏ e ⊢ z ∶ typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f z).
Proof.
  intros typing_mode G e x z A S T Hx Hz.
  eapply ty_var_sub; [ exact Hz | ].
  eapply subtyp_sel2; exact Hx.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 1. Which constructors satisfy both mode_has_sef and mode_has_mutability? *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma sef_mut_modes :
  forall m : mode,
    mode_has_sef m ->
    mode_has_mutability m ->
    m = rodot_sef \/ m = rodot_nm_muttop \/
    m = rodot_nm_compl \/ m = rodot_nm_compl_muttop.
Proof.
  intros m HS HM.
  destruct m; cbn in *; try discriminate; auto.
Qed.

(* The four surviving modes: incap is the "nocap" discipline, functions are off,
   visibility hides method bodies. *)
Lemma sef_mut_mode_incap :
  forall m : mode,
    mode_has_sef m ->
    mode_has_mutability m ->
    mode_incap' m = mode_incap_nocap.
Proof.
  intros m HS HM. destruct m; cbn in *; try discriminate; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma sef_mut_mode_has_incap :
  forall m : mode,
    mode_has_sef m ->
    mode_has_mutability m ->
    mode_has_incap' m = true.
Proof.
  intros m HS HM. destruct m; cbn in *; try discriminate; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma sef_mut_mode_no_fun :
  forall m : mode,
    mode_has_sef m ->
    mode_has_mutability m ->
    mode_has_fun' m = false.
Proof.
  intros m HS HM. destruct m; cbn in *; try discriminate; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma sef_mut_mode_hide :
  forall m : mode,
    mode_has_sef m ->
    mode_has_mutability m ->
    mode_visibility' m = mode_visibility_hide_method.
Proof.
  intros m HS HM. destruct m; cbn in *; try discriminate; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* In all four surviving modes the top/nocap interaction is active
   (either the boundless-subtype flavour or the complement flavour). *)
Lemma sef_mut_mode_top_nm_subtype :
  forall m : mode,
    mode_has_sef m ->
    mode_has_mutability m ->
    mode_has_top_nm_subtype' m = true.
Proof.
  intros m HS HM. destruct m; cbn in *; try discriminate; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* rodot_nm_muttop and rodot_nm_compl_muttop additionally make top a
   subtype of the mutable-top marker. *)
Lemma sef_mut_mode_mut_top_or_none :
  forall m : mode,
    mode_has_sef m ->
    mode_has_mutability m ->
    mode_mut_top' m = mode_mut_top_subtype \/
    mode_mut_top' m = mode_mut_top_none.
Proof.
  intros m HS HM. destruct m; cbn in *; try discriminate; auto.
Qed.

(* In the muttop modes, nocap does subtype mut_marker top (via top). *)
Lemma nocap_sub_muttop :
  forall (typing_mode : Mode) G e,
    mode_mut_top' typing_mode = mode_mut_top_subtype ->
    G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_mut_marker typ_top.
Proof.
  intros typing_mode G e H.
  eapply subtyp_trans.
  - apply subtyp_top.
  - apply subtyp_mut_top. exact H.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 2. The incapability obstruction for a mutable reference marker.      *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Section Incap.
Context (typing_mode : Mode).
Context (Hincap : mode_incap' typing_mode = mode_incap_nocap).

(* A ref-capability record can only be *self*-incapacitated through the
   "nocap" rule; ty_incap_cap deliberately returns typ_top. *)
Lemma incap_refcap_self_iff :
  forall G e (M : typ_refcap_label) S T,
    (G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap M) S T)
       ∶icp typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap M) S T)) <->
    (G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap M) S T)).
Proof.
  intros G e M S T. split.
  - intros H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate; try assumption.
  - intros H. eapply ty_incap_nocap; eauto.
Qed.

End Incap.

(* Specialisation to mut_marker bot. *)
Lemma incap_mutbot_iff :
  forall typing_mode : Mode,
    mode_incap' typing_mode = mode_incap_nocap ->
    forall G e,
      (G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_mut_marker typ_bot ∶icp typ_mut_marker typ_bot) <->
      (G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_mut_marker typ_bot).
Proof.
  intros typing_mode Hincap G e.
  unfold typ_mut_marker, typ_cap_marker.
  eapply incap_refcap_self_iff; eauto.
Qed.

(* A conjunction whose first component is the mutable-bot marker: any
   self-incapacitation must again reduce to nocap <: mut_marker bot. *)
Lemma incap_and_mutbot_self :
  forall typing_mode : Mode,
    mode_incap' typing_mode = mode_incap_nocap ->
    forall G e (X : typ),
      (G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_and (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) X
         ∶icp typ_and (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) X) ->
      (G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_mut_marker typ_bot) \/
      (G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_mut_marker typ_bot ∶icp typ_mut_marker typ_bot).
Proof.
  intros typing_mode Hincap G e X H.
  inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  - (* nocap rule: nocap <: and mutbot X, hence nocap <: mutbot *)
    left. eapply subtyp_trans; [ assumption | eapply subtyp_and11 ].
  - (* and rule: target must be exactly and mutbot X, so first component
       is a self-incap of mutbot *)
    right. assumption.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 3. Bound self-types evade the theorem's nocap premise:              *)
(*    nocap <: typ_bnd T holds for every T, including mutable ones.    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma nocap_sub_bnd :
  forall G e (T : typ), G ⁏ e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_bnd T.
Proof. intros. apply subtyp_nocap_bnd. Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* 4. The dependent-selection mechanism can indeed inhabit a self type  *)
(*    that mentions the argument variable -- but only when the receiver *)
(*    already has the lower-bound capability.                           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma var_sel2_intro :
  forall typing_mode : Mode,
  forall G e (x z : var) (A : typ_label) (S T : typ),
    G ⁏ e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
    G ⁏ e ⊢ z ∶ open (avar_f z) S ->
    G ⁏ e ⊢ z ∶ typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f z).
Proof.
  intros typing_mode G e x z A S T Hx Hz.
  eapply ty_var_sub; [ exact Hz | ].
  eapply subtyp_sel2; exact Hx.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Labels TransformCollect.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top  : typ
  | typ_bot  : typ
  | typ_rcd  : dec -> typ
  | typ_and  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_or   : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_sel  : avar -> typ_label -> avar -> typ
  | typ_bnd  : typ -> typ
  | typ_fun  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_nocap: typ

with dec : Set :=
  | dec_typ: typ_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_fld: fld_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_met: met_label ->  typ -> typ -> typ -> dec
.

Notation typ_cap_marker C T := (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap C) typ_bot T)) (only parsing).

Notation typ_mut_marker T := (typ_cap_marker typ_refcap_mutability T) (only parsing).

Scheme typ_mut  := Induction for typ Sort Prop
with   dec_mut  := Induction for dec Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme typ_mutind from typ_mut, dec_mut.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y => typ_sel (open_rec k u x) L (open_rec k u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
open_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
                            (open_rec_typ (S k) u U)
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (open_rec_typ k u T)
                            (open_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR =>
    dec_met m (open_rec_typ (S k) u TC) (open_rec_typ k u TZ) (open_rec_typ (S (S k)) u TR)
  end.

Instance TypOpenable : Openable typ := open_rec_typ.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping EnvCorrespondence Visibility TFree ConfigVarkinds Deref HeapInstantiate Indep RecordTypes InertContext RecordDefs Equivalence ConfigNotations.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive ty_item_s : ctx -> renv -> heap -> var -> Prop :=

| ty_item_fun_s : forall G e s x S t L T,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    ctx_binds x (typ_fun S T) G ->
    binds x (item_fun t) s ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G § x / v_par ~ S ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ open x T) ->
    all_tfree_k G t v_ref ->
    ty_item_s G e s x
| ty_item_obj_s : forall G e s x U S ds T,
    ctx_binds x T G ->
    binds x (item_obj ds) s ->
    T = typ_objref U S ->
    G §§ (objctx_heap x U) ⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ (open x U) ->
    defs_varkinds G ds ->
    ty_item_s G e s x.

Definition heap_correspond (G : ctx) (e: renv) (s : heap) : Prop :=
  ctx_ok G /\
  ctx_weakens G /\
  ok s /\
  ok e /\
  ctx_kdom v_loc G = dom s /\
  ctx_kdom v_ref G = dom e /\
  renv_corr G e /\
  (forall x,
      x \in dom s ->
      ty_item_s G e s x).

End WithTypingMode.

Arguments heap_correspond {typing_mode}.

Notation inert_G_for_item G w y T := (G § y / v_loc ~ T § w / v_ref ~ T).

Notation inert_G_for_obj G w y T S := (inert_G_for_item G w y (typ_objref T S)).

Notation heap_prefix S1 S2 := (exists S1', S2 = concat S1 S1').

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping.

Require Import OperationalSemantics ConfigTyping MethodCall.
Require Import HeapUpdate Coq.Arith.Arith.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Structural facts about how a single reduction step affects the heap *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition changes_at_most (S S' : heap) (y : var) : Prop :=
  forall z v, z <> y -> binds z v S -> binds z v S'.

Lemma red_changes_at_most :
  forall c c', red c c' ->
    exists y, changes_at_most (config_heap c) (config_heap c') y.
Proof.
  intros c c' Hred. destruct Hred.
  - (* red_read *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_write *) exists yObj. intros z v Hne Hb.
    unfold heap_update in H. destruct H as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    apply Hunch; assumption.
  - (* red_call *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_apply *) exists wFun. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_fun *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_obj *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_var *) exists x. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_push *) exists (var_gen (\{} : vars)). intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma binds_in_dom : forall (S : heap) z v,
  binds z v S -> z \in dom S.
Proof.
  intros S z v H. exact (@get_some_inv item z v S H).
Qed.

(* A run in which every heap-changing step targets a location outside H. *)
Inductive red_closure_fresh_writes (H : heap) : config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=
| rcfw_refl c :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c 0 c
| rcfw_step c1 c2 c3 n y :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 n c2 ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom H ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 (S n) c3.

Lemma rcfw_preserves :
  forall H c1 k c4,
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c1) ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros H c1 k c4 Hsub Hcl. induction Hcl as [c | c1 c2 c3 n y Hcl IH Hred Hch Hy].
  - exact Hsub.
  - intros z v Hz.
    apply Hch.
    + intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq. exact (@get_some_inv item z v H Hz).
    + apply IH. { exact Hsub. } exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma subheap_unchanged_of_fresh_writes :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure_fresh_writes (config_heap c1) c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl.
  eapply rcfw_preserves. 2: exact Hcl.
  intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma red_closure_inv : forall c1 k c4,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (k = 0 /\ c4 = c1) \/
  (exists n c2, k = S n /\ red_closure c1 n c2 /\ red c2 c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 k c4 H. destruct H.
  - left. auto.
  - right. exists n, C2. auto.
Qed.

(* The remaining effect-freedom invariant: while the call has not returned,
   every step changes at most one location, and that location is outside the
   initial heap. *)
Definition SefInv (c1 : config) (k : nat) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3 y,
    j < k ->
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom (config_heap c1).

Theorem SefG_I_from_invariant :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure c1 k c4 ->
    SefInv c1 k ->
    (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl. revert c4 Hcl. induction k as [| n IH]; intros c4 Hcl Hinv.
  - (* k = 0 *)
    right. destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E ->]. intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
    + destruct Hex as [n' [c2 Hrest]]. destruct Hrest as [E _]. discriminate E.
  - (* k = S n *)
    destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E _]. discriminate E.
    + destruct Hex as [n' [c2 Hrest]]. destruct Hrest as [E Hcln Hstep].
      injection E as ->.
      destruct (classic (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < S n)) as [Hex | Hno].
      * left. exact Hex.
      * right.
        assert (Hinv_n : SefInv c1 n).
        { intros j c2' c3 y Hj Hclj Hnf Hred' Hch.
          apply (Hinv j c2' c3 y); auto. lia. }
        destruct (IH c2 Hcln Hinv_n) as [Hex' | Hsub].
        { exfalso. apply Hno. destruct Hex' as [j [c3 [Hfe Hlt]]].
          exists j, c3. split; auto. lia. }
        destruct (red_changes_at_most Hstep) as [y Hch].
        assert (Hy : y \notin dom (config_heap c1)).
        { apply (Hinv n c2 c4 y); auto. lia.
          intros c3' Hfe. apply Hno. exists n, c3'. split; auto. lia. }
        intros z v Hz.
        apply Hch.
        + intro Heq. subst z. apply Hy. exact (@get_some_inv item z v (config_heap c1) Hz).
        + apply Hsub. exact Hz.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Target                                                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Theorem SefG_I :
  forall (typing_mode : Mode) (w1 : var) (m : met_label) (w2 : var)
         (TZv : typ) (c1 : config) (G : ctx) (c4 : config) (k : nat),
  mode_has_sef typing_mode ->
  mode_has_mutability typing_mode ->
  config_trm c1 = trm_call (avar_f w1) m (avar_f w2) ->
  (G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ w1 ∶ typ_rcd (dec_met m typ_nocap TZv typ_top) /\
   G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ w2 ∶ TZv /\
   G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ typ_nocap <: TZv) ->
  (exists T1, ty_config G c1 T1) ->
  c1 ⊣k↦* c4 ->
  (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
  subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros typing_mode w1 m w2 TZv c1 G c4 k Hsef Hmut Htrm Hhyp Hcfg Hred.
  apply SefG_I_from_invariant; [ exact Hred | ].
  (* Remaining goal: SefInv c1 k from the typing hypotheses. *)
Abort.

    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 (S n) c3.

Lemma rcfw_preserves :
  forall H c1 k c4,
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c1) ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros H c1 k c4 Hsub Hcl. induction Hcl as [c | c1 c2 c3 n y Hcl IH Hred Hch Hy].
  - exact Hsub.
  - intros z v Hz.
    apply Hch.
    + intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq. exact (@get_some_inv item z v H Hz).
    + apply IH. { exact Hsub. } exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma subheap_unchanged_of_fresh_writes :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure_fresh_writes (config_heap c1) c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl.
  eapply rcfw_preserves. 2: exact Hcl.
  intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma red_closure_inv : forall c1 k c4,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (k = 0 /\ c4 = c1) \/
  (exists n c2, k = S n /\ red_closure c1 n c2 /\ red c2 c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 k c4 H. destruct H.
  - left. auto.
  - right. exists n, C2. auto.
Qed.

(* The remaining effect-freedom invariant: while the call has not returned,
   every step changes at most one location, and that location is outside the
   initial heap. *)
Definition SefInv (c1 : config) (k : nat) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3 y,
    j < k ->
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom (config_heap c1).

Theorem SefG_I_from_invariant :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure c1 k c4 ->
    SefInv c1 k ->
    (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl. revert c4 Hcl. induction k as [| n IH]; intros c4 Hcl Hinv.
  - (* k = 0 *)
    right. destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E ->]. intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
    + destruct Hex as [n' [c2 Hrest]]. destruct Hrest as [E _]. discriminate E.
  - (* k = S n *)
    destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E _]. discriminate E.
    + destruct Hex as [n' [c2 Hrest]]. destruct Hrest as [E Hcln Hstep].
      injection E as ->.
      destruct (classic (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < S n)) as [Hex | Hno].
      * left. exact Hex.
      * right.
        assert (Hinv_n : SefInv c1 n).
        { intros j c2' c3 y Hj Hclj Hnf Hred' Hch.
          apply (Hinv j c2' c3 y); auto. lia. }
        destruct (IH c2 Hcln Hinv_n) as [Hex' | Hsub].
        { exfalso. apply Hno. destruct Hex' as [j [c3 [Hfe Hlt]]].
          exists j, c3. split; auto. lia. }
        destruct (red_changes_at_most Hstep) as [y Hch].
        assert (Hy : y \notin dom (config_heap c1)).
        { apply (Hinv n c2 c4 y); auto. lia.
          intros c3' Hfe. apply Hno. exists n, c3'. split; auto. lia. }
        intros z v Hz.
        apply Hch.
        + intro Heq. subst z. apply Hy. exact (@get_some_inv item z v (config_heap c1) Hz).
        + apply Hsub. exact Hz.
Qed.

  forall z v, z <> y -> binds z v S -> binds z v S'.

Lemma red_changes_at_most :
  forall c c', red c c' ->
    exists y, changes_at_most (config_heap c) (config_heap c') y.
Proof.
  intros c c' Hred. destruct Hred.
  - (* red_read *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_write *) exists yObj. intros z v Hne Hb.
    unfold heap_update in H. destruct H as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    apply Hunch; assumption.
  - (* red_call *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_apply *) exists wFun. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.

    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }

  binds z v S -> z \in dom S.

  intros S z v H. exact (@get_some_inv item z v S H).

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping.

Require Import OperationalSemantics ConfigTyping MethodCall.
Require Import HeapUpdate Coq.Arith.Arith.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Structural facts about how a single reduction step affects the heap *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition changes_at_most (S S' : heap) (y : var) : Prop :=
  forall z v, z <> y -> binds z v S -> binds z v S'.

Lemma red_changes_at_most :
  forall c c', red c c' ->
    exists y, changes_at_most (config_heap c) (config_heap c') y.
Proof.
  intros c c' Hred. destruct Hred.
  - (* red_read *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_write *) exists yObj. intros z v Hne Hb.
    unfold heap_update in H. destruct H as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    apply Hunch; assumption.
  - (* red_call *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_apply *) exists wFun. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_fun *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_obj *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_var *) exists x. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_push *) exists (var_gen (\{} : vars)). intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma binds_in_dom : forall (S : heap) z v,
  binds z v S -> z \in dom S.
Proof.
  intros S z v H. exact (@get_some_inv item z v S H).
Qed.

(* A run in which every heap-changing step targets a location outside H. *)
Inductive red_closure_fresh_writes (H : heap) : config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=
| rcfw_refl c :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c 0 c
| rcfw_step c1 c2 c3 n y :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 n c2 ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom H ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 (S n) c3.

Lemma rcfw_preserves :
  forall H c1 k c4,
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c1) ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros H c1 k c4 Hsub Hcl. induction Hcl as [c | c1 c2 c3 n y Hcl IH Hred Hch Hy].
  - exact Hsub.
  - intros z v Hz.
    apply Hch.
    + intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq. exact (@get_some_inv item z v H Hz).
    + apply IH. { exact Hsub. } exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma subheap_unchanged_of_fresh_writes :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure_fresh_writes (config_heap c1) c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl.
  eapply rcfw_preserves. 2: exact Hcl.
  intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma red_closure_inv : forall c1 k c4,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (k = 0 /\ c4 = c1) \/
  (exists n c2, k = S n /\ red_closure c1 n c2 /\ red c2 c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 k c4 H. destruct H.
  - left. auto.
  - right. exists n, C2. auto.
Qed.

(* The remaining effect-freedom invariant: while the call has not returned,
   every step changes at most one location, and that location is outside the
   initial heap. *)
Definition SefInv (c1 : config) (k : nat) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3 y,
    j < k ->
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom (config_heap c1).

Theorem SefG_I_from_invariant :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure c1 k c4 ->
    SefInv c1 k ->
    (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl. revert c4 Hcl. induction k as [| n IH]; intros c4 Hcl Hinv.
  - (* k = 0 *)
    right. destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E ->]. intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
    + destruct Hex as [n' [c2 Hrest]]. destruct Hrest as [E _]. discriminate E.
  - (* k = S n *)
    destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E _]. discriminate E.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E [Hcln Hstep]]]].
      injection E as Hnm. subst m.
      destruct (classic (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < S n)) as [Hex | Hno].
      * left. exact Hex.
      * right.
        assert (Hinv_n : SefInv c1 n).
        { intros j c2' c3 y Hj Hclj Hnf Hred' Hch.
          apply (Hinv j c2' c3 y); auto. lia. }
        destruct (IH c2 Hcln Hinv_n) as [Hex' | Hsub].
        { exfalso. apply Hno. destruct Hex' as [j [c3 [Hfe Hlt]]].
          exists j, c3. split; auto. lia. }
        destruct (red_changes_at_most Hstep) as [y Hch].
        assert (Hy : y \notin dom (config_heap c1)).
        { apply (Hinv n c2 c4 y); auto. lia.
          intros c3' Hfe. apply Hno. exists n, c3'. split; auto. lia. }
        intros z v Hz.
        apply Hch.
        + intro Heq. subst z. apply Hy. exact (@get_some_inv item z v (config_heap c1) Hz).
        + apply Hsub. exact Hz.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Target                                                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Theorem SefG_I :
  forall (typing_mode : Mode) (w1 : var) (m : met_label) (w2 : var)
         (TZv : typ) (c1 : config) (G : ctx) (c4 : config) (k : nat),
  mode_has_sef typing_mode ->
  mode_has_mutability typing_mode ->
  config_trm c1 = trm_call (avar_f w1) m (avar_f w2) ->
  (G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ w1 ∶ typ_rcd (dec_met m typ_nocap TZv typ_top) /\
   G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ w2 ∶ TZv /\
   G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ typ_nocap <: TZv) ->
  (exists T1, ty_config G c1 T1) ->
  c1 ⊣k↦* c4 ->
  (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
  subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros typing_mode w1 m w2 TZv c1 G c4 k Hsef Hmut Htrm Hhyp Hcfg Hred.
  apply SefG_I_from_invariant; [ exact Hred | ].
  (* Remaining goal: SefInv c1 k from the typing hypotheses. *)
Abort.

Inductive red_closure_fresh_writes (H : heap) : config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=
| rcfw_refl c :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c 0 c

    red c2 c3 ->

    apply Hch.
