Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping.

Require Import OperationalSemantics ConfigTyping MethodCall.
Require Import HeapUpdate Coq.Arith.Arith.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Structural facts about how a single reduction step affects the heap *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition changes_at_most (S S' : heap) (y : var) : Prop :=
  forall z v, z <> y -> binds z v S -> binds z v S'.

Lemma red_changes_at_most :
  forall c c', red c c' ->
    exists y, changes_at_most (config_heap c) (config_heap c') y.
Proof.
  intros c c' Hred. destruct Hred.
  - (* red_read *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_write *) exists yObj. intros z v Hne Hb.
    unfold heap_update in H. destruct H as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    apply Hunch; assumption.
  - (* red_call *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_apply *) exists wFun. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_fun *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_obj *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_var *) exists x. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_push *) exists (var_gen (\{} : vars)). intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma binds_in_dom : forall (S : heap) z v,
  binds z v S -> z \in dom S.
Proof.
  intros S z v H. exact (@get_some_inv item z v S H).
Qed.

(* A run in which every heap-changing step targets a location outside H. *)
Inductive red_closure_fresh_writes (H : heap) : config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=
| rcfw_refl c :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c 0 c
| rcfw_step c1 c2 c3 n y :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 n c2 ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom H ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 (S n) c3.

Lemma rcfw_preserves :
  forall H c1 k c4,
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c1) ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros H c1 k c4 Hsub Hcl. induction Hcl as [c | c1 c2 c3 n y Hcl IH Hred Hch Hy].
  - exact Hsub.
  - intros z v Hz.
    apply Hch.
    + intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq. exact (@get_some_inv item z v H Hz).
    + apply IH. { exact Hsub. } exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma subheap_unchanged_of_fresh_writes :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure_fresh_writes (config_heap c1) c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl.
  eapply rcfw_preserves. 2: exact Hcl.
  intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma red_closure_inv : forall c1 k c4,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (k = 0 /\ c4 = c1) \/
  (exists n c2, k = S n /\ red_closure c1 n c2 /\ red c2 c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 k c4 H. destruct H.
  - left. auto.
  - right. exists n, C2. auto.
Qed.

(* The remaining effect-freedom invariant: while the call has not returned,
   every step changes at most one location, and that location is outside the
   initial heap. *)
Definition SefInv (c1 : config) (k : nat) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3 y,
    j < k ->
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom (config_heap c1).

Theorem SefG_I_from_invariant :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure c1 k c4 ->
    SefInv c1 k ->
    (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl. revert c4 Hcl. induction k as [| n IH]; intros c4 Hcl Hinv.
  - (* k = 0 *)
    right. destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E ->]. intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
    + destruct Hex as [n' [c2 Hrest]]. destruct Hrest as [E _]. discriminate E.
  - (* k = S n *)
    destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E _]. discriminate E.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E [Hcln Hstep]]]].
      injection E as Hnm. subst m.
      destruct (classic (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < S n)) as [Hex | Hno].
      * left. exact Hex.
      * right.
        assert (Hinv_n : SefInv c1 n).
        { intros j c2' c3 y Hj Hclj Hnf Hred' Hch.
          apply (Hinv j c2' c3 y).
          - lia.
          - exact Hclj.
          - exact Hnf.
          - exact Hred'.
          - exact Hch. }
        destruct (IH c2 Hcln Hinv_n) as [Hex' | Hsub].
        { exfalso. apply Hno. destruct Hex' as [j [c3 [Hfe Hlt]]].
          exists j, c3. split.
          - exact Hfe.
          - lia. }
        destruct (red_changes_at_most Hstep) as [y Hch].
        assert (Hy : y \notin dom (config_heap c1)).
        { apply (Hinv n c2 c4 y).
          - lia.
          - exact Hcln.
          - intros c3' Hfe. apply Hno. exists n, c3'. split.
            { exact Hfe. }
            { lia. }
          - exact Hstep.
          - exact Hch. }
        intros z v Hz.
        apply Hch.
        { intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq.
          exact (@get_some_inv item z v (config_heap c1) Hz). }
        { apply Hsub. exact Hz. }
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Target                                                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Theorem SefG_I :
  forall (typing_mode : Mode) (w1 : var) (m : met_label) (w2 : var)
         (TZv : typ) (c1 : config) (G : ctx) (c4 : config) (k : nat),
  mode_has_sef typing_mode ->

(* A step preserves the initial heap provided it is not a write to a
   location of the initial heap. *)
Definition SefStep (c1 : config) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2) ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c3).

(* The single semantic obligation: during a pure call, before its frame
   ends, no write step can target a location of the initial heap. *)
Definition SefWrite (c1 : config) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 yObj a yArg Sigma',
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    config_trm c2 = trm_write (avar_f yObj) a (avar_f yArg) ->
    red c2 (trm_var (avar_f yArg) ; config_stack c2 ; Sigma' ; config_env c2 ; config_fv c2) ->
    heap_update (config_heap c2) yObj a yArg Sigma' ->
    yObj \notin dom (config_heap c1).

Lemma SefStep_of_write :
  forall c1, SefWrite c1 ->
  forall j c2 c3,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2) ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c3).
Proof.
  intros c1 Hw j c2 c3 Hcl Hnofe Hstep Hsub.
  destruct (red_nonwrite_subheap Hstep) as [Hnw | [Sigma [Sigma' [yObj [a [yArg [Heq1 [Heq2 Hup]]]]]]]].
  - apply Hnw. exact Hsub.
  - (* the step is a write *)
    intros z v Hz.
    unfold heap_update in Hup. destruct Hup as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    apply Hunch.
    + intro Heq. subst z.
      assert (Hy : yObj \notin dom (config_heap c1)).
      { eapply Hw.
        - exact Hcl.
        - exact Hnofe.
        - rewrite Heq1. reflexivity.
        - (* reconstruct the red_write configuration *)
          rewrite Heq1, Heq2. reflexivity. }
      apply Hy. exact (@get_some_inv item z v (config_heap c1) Hz).
    + apply Hsub. exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma no_frame_end_heap_sub : forall c1 c4 k,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (forall j c3, j < k -> ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3) ->
  SefStep c1 ->
  subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl. revert c4 Hcl.
  induction k as [| n IH]; intros c4 Hcl Hnofe Hstep.
  - destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E ->]. intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E _]]]. discriminate E.
  - destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E _]. discriminate E.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E [Hcln Hred]]]].
      injection E as Hnm. subst m.
      assert (Hsub2 : subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2)).
      { apply (IH c2 Hcln).
        intros j c3 Hj. apply (Hnofe j c3); lia. }
      eapply Hstep.
      * exact Hcln.
      * intros c3' Hfe. apply (Hnofe n c3'); lia.
      * exact Hred.
      * exact Hsub2.
Qed.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping.

Require Import OperationalSemantics ConfigTyping MethodCall.
Require Import HeapUpdate Coq.Arith.Arith.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Structural facts about how a single reduction step affects the heap *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition changes_at_most (S S' : heap) (y : var) : Prop :=
  forall z v, z <> y -> binds z v S -> binds z v S'.

Lemma red_changes_at_most :
  forall c c', red c c' ->
    exists y, changes_at_most (config_heap c) (config_heap c') y.
Proof.
  intros c c' Hred. destruct Hred.
  - (* red_read *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_write *) exists yObj. intros z v Hne Hb.
    unfold heap_update in H. destruct H as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    apply Hunch; assumption.
  - (* red_call *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_apply *) exists wFun. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_fun *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_obj *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_var *) exists x. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_push *) exists (var_gen (\{} : vars)). intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma binds_in_dom : forall (S : heap) z v,
  binds z v S -> z \in dom S.
Proof.
  intros S z v H. exact (@get_some_inv item z v S H).
Qed.

(* A run in which every heap-changing step targets a location outside H. *)
Inductive red_closure_fresh_writes (H : heap) : config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=
| rcfw_refl c :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c 0 c
| rcfw_step c1 c2 c3 n y :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 n c2 ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom H ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 (S n) c3.

Lemma rcfw_preserves :
  forall H c1 k c4,
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c1) ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros H c1 k c4 Hsub Hcl. induction Hcl as [c | c1 c2 c3 n y Hcl IH Hred Hch Hy].
  - exact Hsub.
  - intros z v Hz.
    apply Hch.
    + intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq. exact (@get_some_inv item z v H Hz).
    + apply IH. { exact Hsub. } exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma subheap_unchanged_of_fresh_writes :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure_fresh_writes (config_heap c1) c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl.
  eapply rcfw_preserves. 2: exact Hcl.
  intros z v Hz. exact Hz.

Definition SefInv (c1 : config) (k : nat) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3 y,
    j < k ->
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->

    + destruct H0 as [E _]. discriminate E.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E [Hcln Hstep]]]].

          - exact Hch. }

        apply Hch.

          exact (@get_some_inv item z v (config_heap c1) Hz). }

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Structural facts about how a single reduction step affects the heap *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition changes_at_most (S S' : heap) (y : var) : Prop :=
  forall z v, z <> y -> binds z v S -> binds z v S'.

Lemma red_changes_at_most :
  forall c c', red c c' ->
    exists y, changes_at_most (config_heap c) (config_heap c') y.
Proof.
  intros c c' Hred. destruct Hred.
  - (* red_read *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_write *) exists yObj. intros z v Hne Hb.
    unfold heap_update in H. destruct H as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    apply Hunch; assumption.
  - (* red_call *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_apply *) exists wFun. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_fun *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_obj *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_var *) exists x. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_push *) exists (var_gen (\{} : vars)). intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma binds_in_dom : forall (S : heap) z v,
  binds z v S -> z \in dom S.
Proof.
  intros S z v H. exact (@get_some_inv item z v S H).
Qed.

Lemma fresh_fv_config_dom : forall (y:var) (c:config),
  y \notin fv_config c -> y \notin (dom (config_heap c)).
Proof.
  intros y [t s S e Lv] H. simpl in H.
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Ht H].
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Hs H].
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Hheap H].
  simpl in Hheap. apply notin_union_r in Hheap. destruct Hheap as [Hdom _].
  exact Hdom.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_neq : forall (y z:var) (S:heap),
  z \in dom S -> y \notin dom S -> z <> y.
Proof. intros y z S Hz Hy E. subst. apply Hy. assumption. Qed.

  - right. simpl. exists Sigma, Sigma', yObj, m, yArg. auto.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping.

Require Import OperationalSemantics ConfigTyping MethodCall.
Require Import HeapUpdate Coq.Arith.Arith.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Structural facts about how a single reduction step affects the heap *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition changes_at_most (S S' : heap) (y : var) : Prop :=
  forall z v, z <> y -> binds z v S -> binds z v S'.

Lemma red_changes_at_most :
  forall c c', red c c' ->
    exists y, changes_at_most (config_heap c) (config_heap c') y.
Proof.
  intros c c' Hred. destruct Hred.
  - (* red_read *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_write *) exists yObj. intros z v Hne Hb.
    unfold heap_update in H. destruct H as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    apply Hunch; assumption.
  - (* red_call *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_apply *) exists wFun. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_fun *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_obj *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_var *) exists x. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_push *) exists (var_gen (\{} : vars)). intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma binds_in_dom : forall (S : heap) z v,
  binds z v S -> z \in dom S.
Proof.
  intros S z v H. exact (@get_some_inv item z v S H).
Qed.

Lemma fresh_fv_config_dom : forall (y:var) (c:config),
  y \notin fv_config c -> y \notin (dom (config_heap c)).
Proof.
  intros y [t s S e Lv] H. simpl in H.
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Ht H].
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Hs H].
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Hheap H].
  simpl in Hheap. apply notin_union_r in Hheap. destruct Hheap as [Hdom _].
  exact Hdom.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_neq : forall (y z:var) (S:heap),
  z \in dom S -> y \notin dom S -> z <> y.
Proof. intros y z S Hz Hy E. subst. apply Hy. assumption. Qed.

Lemma red_nonwrite_subheap : forall (c c':config),
  c ↦ c' ->
  (forall S0, subheap_unchanged S0 (config_heap c) ->
             subheap_unchanged S0 (config_heap c')) \/
  (exists (Sigma Sigma':heap) (yObj:var) (a:fld_label) (yArg:var),
      config_heap c = Sigma /\ config_heap c' = Sigma' /\
      heap_update Sigma yObj a yArg Sigma').
Proof.
  intros c c' Hred. induction Hred.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - right. simpl. exists Sigma, Sigma', yObj, m, yArg. auto.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl.
    intros z itm Hb.
    apply binds_push_neq.
    + apply Hsub; assumption.
    + apply notin_dom_neq with (S:=Sigma).
      * apply get_some_inv with (v:=itm). apply binds_get. apply Hsub; exact Hb.
      * simpl in H. destruct H as [Hy _].
        pose proof (fresh_fv_config_dom Hy) as Hd. simpl in Hd. exact Hd.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl.
    intros z itm Hb.
    apply binds_push_neq.
    + apply Hsub; assumption.
    + apply notin_dom_neq with (S:=Sigma).
      * apply get_some_inv with (v:=itm). apply binds_get. apply Hsub; exact Hb.
      * simpl in H. destruct H as [Hy _].
        pose proof (fresh_fv_config_dom Hy) as Hd. simpl in Hd. exact Hd.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
Qed.

(* A step preserves the initial heap provided it is not a write to a
   location of the initial heap. *)
Definition SefStep (c1 : config) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2) ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c3).

(* The single semantic obligation: during a pure call, before its frame
   ends, no write step can target a location of the initial heap. *)
Definition SefWrite (c1 : config) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3 Sigma Sigma' yObj a yArg,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    config_heap c2 = Sigma ->
    config_heap c3 = Sigma' ->
    heap_update Sigma yObj a yArg Sigma' ->
    yObj \notin dom (config_heap c1).

Lemma SefStep_of_write :
  forall c1, SefWrite c1 ->
  forall j c2 c3,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2) ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c3).
Proof.
  intros c1 Hw j c2 c3 Hcl Hnofe Hstep Hsub.
  destruct (red_nonwrite_subheap Hstep)
    as [Hnw | [Sigma [Sigma' [yObj [a [yArg [Heq1 [Heq2 Hup]]]]]]]].
  - apply Hnw. exact Hsub.
  - (* the step is a write *)
    assert (Hy : yObj \notin dom (config_heap c1)).
    { eapply Hw; eauto. }
    intros z v Hz.
    unfold heap_update in Hup. destruct Hup as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    apply Hunch.
    + intro Heq. subst z. apply Hy.
      exact (@get_some_inv item z v (config_heap c1) Hz).
    + apply Hsub. exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma no_frame_end_heap_sub : forall c1 c4 k,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (forall j c3, j < k -> ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3) ->
  SefStep c1 ->
  subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl. revert c4 Hcl.
  induction k as [| n IH]; intros c4 Hcl Hnofe Hstep.
  - destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E ->]. intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E _]]]. discriminate E.
  - destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E _]. discriminate E.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E [Hcln Hred]]]].
      injection E as Hnm. subst m.
      assert (Hsub2 : subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2)).
      { apply (IH c2 Hcln).
        intros j c3 Hj. apply (Hnofe j c3); lia. }
      eapply Hstep.
      * exact Hcln.
      * intros c3' Hfe. apply (Hnofe n c3'); lia.
      * exact Hred.
      * exact Hsub2.
Qed.

Lemma SefG_I_reduce :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure c1 k c4 ->
    SefStep c1 ->
    (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl Hstep.
  destruct (classic (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k)) as [Hfe | Hno].
  - left. exact Hfe.
  - right. apply no_frame_end_heap_sub with (k:=k); auto.
    intros j c3 Hj Hfe. apply Hno. exists j, c3. split; assumption.
Qed.

(* A run in which every heap-changing step targets a location outside H. *)
Inductive red_closure_fresh_writes (H : heap) : config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=
| rcfw_refl c :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c 0 c
| rcfw_step c1 c2 c3 n y :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 n c2 ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom H ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 (S n) c3.

Lemma rcfw_preserves :
  forall H c1 k c4,
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c1) ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros H c1 k c4 Hsub Hcl. induction Hcl as [c | c1 c2 c3 n y Hcl IH Hred Hch Hy].
  - exact Hsub.
  - intros z v Hz.
    apply Hch.
    + intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq. exact (@get_some_inv item z v H Hz).
    + apply IH. { exact Hsub. } exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma subheap_unchanged_of_fresh_writes :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure_fresh_writes (config_heap c1) c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl.
  eapply rcfw_preserves. 2: exact Hcl.
  intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma red_closure_inv : forall c1 k c4,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (k = 0 /\ c4 = c1) \/
  (exists n c2, k = S n /\ red_closure c1 n c2 /\ red c2 c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 k c4 H. destruct H.
  - left. auto.
  - right. exists n, C2. auto.
Qed.

(* The remaining effect-freedom invariant: while the call has not returned,
   every step changes at most one location, and that location is outside the
   initial heap. *)
Definition SefInv (c1 : config) (k : nat) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3 y,
    j < k ->
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom (config_heap c1).

Theorem SefG_I_from_invariant :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure c1 k c4 ->
    SefInv c1 k ->
    (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl. revert c4 Hcl. induction k as [| n IH]; intros c4 Hcl Hinv.
  - (* k = 0 *)
    right. destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E ->]. intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
    + destruct Hex as [n' [c2 Hrest]]. destruct Hrest as [E _]. discriminate E.
  - (* k = S n *)
    destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E _]. discriminate E.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E [Hcln Hstep]]]].
      injection E as Hnm. subst m.
      destruct (classic (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < S n)) as [Hex | Hno].
      * left. exact Hex.
      * right.
        assert (Hinv_n : SefInv c1 n).
        { intros j c2' c3 y Hj Hclj Hnf Hred' Hch.
          apply (Hinv j c2' c3 y).
          - lia.
          - exact Hclj.
          - exact Hnf.
          - exact Hred'.
          - exact Hch. }
        destruct (IH c2 Hcln Hinv_n) as [Hex' | Hsub].
        { exfalso. apply Hno. destruct Hex' as [j [c3 [Hfe Hlt]]].
          exists j, c3. split.
          - exact Hfe.
          - lia. }
        destruct (red_changes_at_most Hstep) as [y Hch].
        assert (Hy : y \notin dom (config_heap c1)).
        { apply (Hinv n c2 c4 y).
          - lia.
          - exact Hcln.
          - intros c3' Hfe. apply Hno. exists n, c3'. split.
            { exact Hfe. }
            { lia. }
          - exact Hstep.
          - exact Hch. }
        intros z v Hz.
        apply Hch.
        { intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq.
          exact (@get_some_inv item z v (config_heap c1) Hz). }
        { apply Hsub. exact Hz. }
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Target                                                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Theorem SefG_I :
  forall (typing_mode : Mode) (w1 : var) (m : met_label) (w2 : var)
         (TZv : typ) (c1 : config) (G : ctx) (c4 : config) (k : nat),
  mode_has_sef typing_mode ->
  mode_has_mutability typing_mode ->
  config_trm c1 = trm_call (avar_f w1) m (avar_f w2) ->
  (G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ w1 ∶ typ_rcd (dec_met m typ_nocap TZv typ_top) /\
   G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ w2 ∶ TZv /\
   G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ typ_nocap <: TZv) ->
  (exists T1, ty_config G c1 T1) ->
  c1 ⊣k↦* c4 ->
  (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
  subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping.

Require Import OperationalSemantics ConfigTyping MethodCall.
Require Import HeapUpdate Coq.Arith.Arith.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Structural facts about how a single reduction step affects the heap *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition changes_at_most (S S' : heap) (y : var) : Prop :=
  forall z v, z <> y -> binds z v S -> binds z v S'.

Lemma red_changes_at_most :
  forall c c', red c c' ->
    exists y, changes_at_most (config_heap c) (config_heap c') y.
Proof.
  intros c c' Hred. destruct Hred.
  - (* red_read *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_write *) exists yObj. intros z v Hne Hb.
    unfold heap_update in H. destruct H as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    apply Hunch; assumption.
  - (* red_call *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_apply *) exists wFun. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_fun *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_obj *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_var *) exists x. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_push *) exists (var_gen (\{} : vars)). intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma binds_in_dom : forall (S : heap) z v,
  binds z v S -> z \in dom S.
Proof.
  intros S z v H. exact (@get_some_inv item z v S H).
Qed.

Lemma fresh_fv_config_dom : forall (y:var) (c:config),
  y \notin fv_config c -> y \notin (dom (config_heap c)).
Proof.
  intros y [t s S e Lv] H. simpl in H.
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Ht H].
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Hs H].
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Hheap H].
  simpl in Hheap. apply notin_union_r in Hheap. destruct Hheap as [Hdom _].
  exact Hdom.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_neq : forall (y z:var) (S:heap),
  z \in dom S -> y \notin dom S -> z <> y.
Proof. intros y z S Hz Hy E. subst. apply Hy. assumption. Qed.

Lemma red_nonwrite_subheap : forall (c c':config),
  c ↦ c' ->
  (forall S0, subheap_unchanged S0 (config_heap c) ->
             subheap_unchanged S0 (config_heap c')) \/
  (exists (Sigma Sigma':heap) (yObj:var) (a:fld_label) (yArg:var),
      config_heap c = Sigma /\ config_heap c' = Sigma' /\
      heap_update Sigma yObj a yArg Sigma').
Proof.
  intros c c' Hred. induction Hred.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - right. simpl. exists Sigma, Sigma', yObj, m, yArg. auto.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl.
    intros z itm Hb.
    apply binds_push_neq.
    + apply Hsub; assumption.
    + apply notin_dom_neq with (S:=Sigma).
      * apply get_some_inv with (v:=itm). apply binds_get. apply Hsub; exact Hb.
      * simpl in H. destruct H as [Hy _].
        pose proof (fresh_fv_config_dom
          (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) Hy) as Hd.
        simpl in Hd. exact Hd.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl.
    intros z itm Hb.
    apply binds_push_neq.
    + apply Hsub; assumption.
    + apply notin_dom_neq with (S:=Sigma).
      * apply get_some_inv with (v:=itm). apply binds_get. apply Hsub; exact Hb.
      * simpl in H. destruct H as [Hy _].
        pose proof (fresh_fv_config_dom
          (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) Hy) as Hd.
        simpl in Hd. exact Hd.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
Qed.

(* A step preserves the initial heap provided it is not a write to a
   location of the initial heap. *)
Definition SefStep (c1 : config) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2) ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c3).

(* The single semantic obligation: during a pure call, before its frame
   ends, no write step can target a location of the initial heap. *)
Definition SefWrite (c1 : config) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3 Sigma Sigma' yObj a yArg,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    config_heap c2 = Sigma ->
    config_heap c3 = Sigma' ->
    heap_update Sigma yObj a yArg Sigma' ->
    yObj \notin dom (config_heap c1).

Lemma SefStep_of_write :
  forall c1, SefWrite c1 ->
  forall j c2 c3,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2) ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c3).
Proof.
  intros c1 Hw j c2 c3 Hcl Hnofe Hstep Hsub.
  destruct (red_nonwrite_subheap Hstep)
    as [Hnw | [Sigma [Sigma' [yObj [a [yArg [Heq1 [Heq2 Hup]]]]]]]].
  - apply Hnw. exact Hsub.
  - (* the step is a write *)
    assert (Hy : yObj \notin dom (config_heap c1)).
    { eapply Hw; eauto. }
    intros z v Hz.
    unfold heap_update in Hup. destruct Hup as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    apply Hunch.
    + intro Heq. subst z. apply Hy.
      exact (@get_some_inv item z v (config_heap c1) Hz).
    + apply Hsub. exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma no_frame_end_heap_sub : forall c1 c4 k,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (forall j c3, j < k -> ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3) ->
  SefStep c1 ->
  subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl. revert c4 Hcl.
  induction k as [| n IH]; intros c4 Hcl Hnofe Hstep.
  - destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E ->]. intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E _]]]. discriminate E.
  - destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E _]. discriminate E.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E [Hcln Hred]]]].
      injection E as Hnm. subst m.
      assert (Hsub2 : subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2)).
      { apply (IH c2 Hcln).
        intros j c3 Hj. apply (Hnofe j c3); lia. }
      eapply Hstep.
      * exact Hcln.
      * intros c3' Hfe. apply (Hnofe n c3'); lia.
      * exact Hred.
      * exact Hsub2.
Qed.

Lemma SefG_I_reduce :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure c1 k c4 ->
    SefStep c1 ->
    (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl Hstep.
  destruct (classic (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k)) as [Hfe | Hno].
  - left. exact Hfe.
  - right. apply no_frame_end_heap_sub with (k:=k); auto.
    intros j c3 Hj Hfe. apply Hno. exists j, c3. split; assumption.
Qed.

(* A run in which every heap-changing step targets a location outside H. *)
Inductive red_closure_fresh_writes (H : heap) : config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=
| rcfw_refl c :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c 0 c
| rcfw_step c1 c2 c3 n y :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 n c2 ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom H ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 (S n) c3.

Lemma rcfw_preserves :
  forall H c1 k c4,
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c1) ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros H c1 k c4 Hsub Hcl. induction Hcl as [c | c1 c2 c3 n y Hcl IH Hred Hch Hy].
  - exact Hsub.
  - intros z v Hz.
    apply Hch.
    + intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq. exact (@get_some_inv item z v H Hz).
    + apply IH. { exact Hsub. } exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma subheap_unchanged_of_fresh_writes :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure_fresh_writes (config_heap c1) c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl.
  eapply rcfw_preserves. 2: exact Hcl.
  intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma red_closure_inv : forall c1 k c4,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (k = 0 /\ c4 = c1) \/
  (exists n c2, k = S n /\ red_closure c1 n c2 /\ red c2 c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 k c4 H. destruct H.
  - left. auto.
  - right. exists n, C2. auto.
Qed.

(* The remaining effect-freedom invariant: while the call has not returned,
   every step changes at most one location, and that location is outside the
   initial heap. *)
Definition SefInv (c1 : config) (k : nat) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3 y,
    j < k ->
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom (config_heap c1).

Theorem SefG_I_from_invariant :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure c1 k c4 ->
    SefInv c1 k ->
    (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl. revert c4 Hcl. induction k as [| n IH]; intros c4 Hcl Hinv.
  - (* k = 0 *)
    right. destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E ->]. intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
    + destruct Hex as [n' [c2 Hrest]]. destruct Hrest as [E _]. discriminate E.
  - (* k = S n *)
    destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E _]. discriminate E.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E [Hcln Hstep]]]].
      injection E as Hnm. subst m.
      destruct (classic (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < S n)) as [Hex | Hno].
      * left. exact Hex.
      * right.
        assert (Hinv_n : SefInv c1 n).
        { intros j c2' c3 y Hj Hclj Hnf Hred' Hch.
          apply (Hinv j c2' c3 y).
          - lia.
          - exact Hclj.
          - exact Hnf.
          - exact Hred'.
          - exact Hch. }
        destruct (IH c2 Hcln Hinv_n) as [Hex' | Hsub].
        { exfalso. apply Hno. destruct Hex' as [j [c3 [Hfe Hlt]]].
          exists j, c3. split.
          - exact Hfe.
          - lia. }
        destruct (red_changes_at_most Hstep) as [y Hch].
        assert (Hy : y \notin dom (config_heap c1)).
        { apply (Hinv n c2 c4 y).
          - lia.
          - exact Hcln.
          - intros c3' Hfe. apply Hno. exists n, c3'. split.
            { exact Hfe. }
            { lia. }
          - exact Hstep.
          - exact Hch. }
        intros z v Hz.
        apply Hch.
        { intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq.
          exact (@get_some_inv item z v (config_heap c1) Hz). }
        { apply Hsub. exact Hz. }
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Target                                                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Theorem SefG_I :
  forall (typing_mode : Mode) (w1 : var) (m : met_label) (w2 : var)
         (TZv : typ) (c1 : config) (G : ctx) (c4 : config) (k : nat),

  mode_has_mutability typing_mode ->
  config_trm c1 = trm_call (avar_f w1) m (avar_f w2) ->
  (G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ w1 ∶ typ_rcd (dec_met m typ_nocap TZv typ_top) /\

  c1 ⊣k↦* c4 ->
  (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
  subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).

      heap_update Sigma yObj a yArg Sigma').

  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - right. simpl. exists Sigma, Sigma', yObj, m, yArg. auto.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl.
    intros z itm Hb.
    apply binds_push_neq.
    + apply Hsub; assumption.
    + apply notin_dom_neq with (S:=Sigma).
      * apply get_some_inv with (v:=itm). apply binds_get. apply Hsub; exact Hb.

(* A step preserves the initial heap provided it is not a write to a
   location of the initial heap. *)
Definition SefStep (c1 : config) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2) ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c3).

(* The single semantic obligation: during a pure call, before its frame
   ends, no write step can target a location of the initial heap. *)
Definition SefWrite (c1 : config) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3 Sigma Sigma' yObj a yArg,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    config_heap c2 = Sigma ->
    config_heap c3 = Sigma' ->
    heap_update Sigma yObj a yArg Sigma' ->
    yObj \notin dom (config_heap c1).

Lemma SefStep_of_write :
  forall c1, SefWrite c1 ->
  forall j c2 c3,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2) ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c3).
Proof.
  intros c1 Hw j c2 c3 Hcl Hnofe Hstep Hsub.
  destruct (red_nonwrite_subheap Hstep)
    as [Hnw | [Sigma [Sigma' [yObj [a [yArg [Heq1 [Heq2 Hup]]]]]]]].
  - apply Hnw. exact Hsub.
  - (* the step is a write *)
    assert (Hy : yObj \notin dom (config_heap c1)).
    { eapply Hw; eauto. }
    intros z v Hz.
    unfold heap_update in Hup. destruct Hup as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    assert (Hne : z <> yObj).
    { intro Heq. subst z. apply Hy.
      exact (@get_some_inv item z v (config_heap c1) Hz). }
    assert (Hz2 : binds z v Sigma).
    { rewrite <- Heq1. exact (Hsub z v Hz). }
    pose proof (Hunch z v Hne Hz2) as Hz3.
    rewrite Heq2. exact Hz3.
Qed.

Lemma no_frame_end_heap_sub : forall c1 c4 k,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (forall j c3, j < k -> ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3) ->
  SefStep c1 ->
  subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl. revert c4 Hcl.
  induction k as [| n IH]; intros c4 Hcl Hnofe Hstep.
  - destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E ->]. intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E _]]]. discriminate E.
  - destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E _]. discriminate E.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E [Hcln Hred]]]].
      injection E as Hnm. subst m.
      assert (Hsub2 : subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2)).
      { apply (IH c2 Hcln).
        intros j c3 Hj. apply (Hnofe j c3); lia. }
      eapply Hstep.
      * exact Hcln.
      * intros c3' Hfe. apply (Hnofe n c3'); lia.
      * exact Hred.
      * exact Hsub2.
Qed.

Lemma SefG_I_reduce :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure c1 k c4 ->
    SefStep c1 ->
    (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl Hstep.
  destruct (classic (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k)) as [Hfe | Hno].
  - left. exact Hfe.
  - right. apply no_frame_end_heap_sub with (k:=k); auto.
    intros j c3 Hj Hfe. apply Hno. exists j, c3. split; assumption.
Qed.

(* A run in which every heap-changing step targets a location outside H. *)
Inductive red_closure_fresh_writes (H : heap) : config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=
| rcfw_refl c :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c 0 c
| rcfw_step c1 c2 c3 n y :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 n c2 ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom H ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 (S n) c3.

Lemma rcfw_preserves :
  forall H c1 k c4,
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c1) ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros H c1 k c4 Hsub Hcl. induction Hcl as [c | c1 c2 c3 n y Hcl IH Hred Hch Hy].
  - exact Hsub.
  - intros z v Hz.
    apply Hch.
    + intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq. exact (@get_some_inv item z v H Hz).
    + apply IH. { exact Hsub. } exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma subheap_unchanged_of_fresh_writes :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure_fresh_writes (config_heap c1) c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl.
  eapply rcfw_preserves. 2: exact Hcl.
  intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma red_closure_inv : forall c1 k c4,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (k = 0 /\ c4 = c1) \/
  (exists n c2, k = S n /\ red_closure c1 n c2 /\ red c2 c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 k c4 H. destruct H.
  - left. auto.
  - right. exists n, C2. auto.
Qed.

(* The remaining effect-freedom invariant: while the call has not returned,
   every step changes at most one location, and that location is outside the
   initial heap. *)
Definition SefInv (c1 : config) (k : nat) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3 y,
    j < k ->
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom (config_heap c1).

Theorem SefG_I_from_invariant :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure c1 k c4 ->
    SefInv c1 k ->
    (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl. revert c4 Hcl. induction k as [| n IH]; intros c4 Hcl Hinv.
  - (* k = 0 *)
    right. destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E ->]. intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
    + destruct Hex as [n' [c2 Hrest]]. destruct Hrest as [E _]. discriminate E.
  - (* k = S n *)
    destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E _]. discriminate E.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E [Hcln Hstep]]]].
      injection E as Hnm. subst m.
      destruct (classic (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < S n)) as [Hex | Hno].
      * left. exact Hex.
      * right.
        assert (Hinv_n : SefInv c1 n).
        { intros j c2' c3 y Hj Hclj Hnf Hred' Hch.
          apply (Hinv j c2' c3 y).
          - lia.
          - exact Hclj.
          - exact Hnf.
          - exact Hred'.
          - exact Hch. }
        destruct (IH c2 Hcln Hinv_n) as [Hex' | Hsub].
        { exfalso. apply Hno. destruct Hex' as [j [c3 [Hfe Hlt]]].
          exists j, c3. split.
          - exact Hfe.
          - lia. }
        destruct (red_changes_at_most Hstep) as [y Hch].
        assert (Hy : y \notin dom (config_heap c1)).
        { apply (Hinv n c2 c4 y).
          - lia.
          - exact Hcln.
          - intros c3' Hfe. apply Hno. exists n, c3'. split.
            { exact Hfe. }
            { lia. }
          - exact Hstep.
          - exact Hch. }
        intros z v Hz.
        apply Hch.
        { intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq.
          exact (@get_some_inv item z v (config_heap c1) Hz). }
        { apply Hsub. exact Hz. }
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping.

Require Import OperationalSemantics ConfigTyping MethodCall.
Require Import HeapUpdate Coq.Arith.Arith.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Structural facts about how a single reduction step affects the heap *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition changes_at_most (S S' : heap) (y : var) : Prop :=
  forall z v, z <> y -> binds z v S -> binds z v S'.

Lemma red_changes_at_most :
  forall c c', red c c' ->
    exists y, changes_at_most (config_heap c) (config_heap c') y.
Proof.
  intros c c' Hred. destruct Hred.
  - (* red_read *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_write *) exists yObj. intros z v Hne Hb.
    unfold heap_update in H. destruct H as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    apply Hunch; assumption.
  - (* red_call *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_apply *) exists wFun. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_fun *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_obj *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_var *) exists x. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_push *) exists (var_gen (\{} : vars)). intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma binds_in_dom : forall (S : heap) z v,
  binds z v S -> z \in dom S.
Proof.
  intros S z v H. exact (@get_some_inv item z v S H).
Qed.

Lemma fresh_fv_config_dom : forall (y:var) (c:config),
  y \notin fv_config c -> y \notin (dom (config_heap c)).
Proof.
  intros y [t s S e Lv] H. simpl in H.
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Ht H].
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Hs H].
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Hheap H].
  simpl in Hheap. apply notin_union_r in Hheap. destruct Hheap as [Hdom _].
  exact Hdom.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_neq : forall (y z:var) (S:heap),
  z \in dom S -> y \notin dom S -> z <> y.
Proof. intros y z S Hz Hy E. subst. apply Hy. assumption. Qed.

Lemma red_nonwrite_subheap : forall (c c':config),
  c ↦ c' ->
  (forall S0, subheap_unchanged S0 (config_heap c) ->
             subheap_unchanged S0 (config_heap c')) \/
  (exists (Sigma Sigma':heap) (yObj:var) (a:fld_label) (yArg:var),
      config_heap c = Sigma /\ config_heap c' = Sigma' /\
      heap_update Sigma yObj a yArg Sigma').
Proof.
  intros c c' Hred. induction Hred.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - right. simpl. exists Sigma, Sigma', yObj, m, yArg. auto.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl.
    intros z itm Hb.
    apply binds_push_neq.
    + apply Hsub; assumption.
    + apply notin_dom_neq with (S:=Sigma).
      * apply get_some_inv with (v:=itm). apply binds_get. apply Hsub; exact Hb.
      * simpl in H. destruct H as [Hy _].
        pose proof (fresh_fv_config_dom
          (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) Hy) as Hd.
        simpl in Hd. exact Hd.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl.
    intros z itm Hb.
    apply binds_push_neq.
    + apply Hsub; assumption.
    + apply notin_dom_neq with (S:=Sigma).
      * apply get_some_inv with (v:=itm). apply binds_get. apply Hsub; exact Hb.
      * simpl in H. destruct H as [Hy _].
        pose proof (fresh_fv_config_dom
          (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) Hy) as Hd.
        simpl in Hd. exact Hd.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
Qed.

(* A step preserves the initial heap provided it is not a write to a
   location of the initial heap. *)
Definition SefStep (c1 : config) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2) ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c3).

(* The single semantic obligation: during a pure call, before its frame
   ends, no write step can target a location of the initial heap. *)
Definition SefWrite (c1 : config) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3 Sigma Sigma' yObj a yArg,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    config_heap c2 = Sigma ->
    config_heap c3 = Sigma' ->
    heap_update Sigma yObj a yArg Sigma' ->
    yObj \notin dom (config_heap c1).

Lemma SefStep_of_write :
  forall c1, SefWrite c1 ->
  forall j c2 c3,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2) ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c3).
Proof.
  intros c1 Hw j c2 c3 Hcl Hnofe Hstep Hsub.
  destruct (red_nonwrite_subheap Hstep)
    as [Hnw | [Sigma [Sigma' [yObj [a [yArg [Heq1 [Heq2 Hup]]]]]]]].
  - apply Hnw. exact Hsub.
  - (* the step is a write *)
    assert (Hy : yObj \notin dom (config_heap c1)).
    { eapply Hw; eauto. }
    intros z v Hz.
    unfold heap_update in Hup. destruct Hup as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    assert (Hne : z <> yObj).
    { intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq.
      exact (@get_some_inv item z v (config_heap c1) Hz). }
    assert (Hz2 : binds z v Sigma).
    { rewrite <- Heq1. exact (Hsub z v Hz). }
    pose proof (Hunch z v Hne Hz2) as Hz3.
    rewrite Heq2. exact Hz3.
Qed.

Lemma no_frame_end_heap_sub : forall c1 c4 k,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (forall j c3, j < k -> ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3) ->
  SefStep c1 ->
  subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl. revert c4 Hcl.
  induction k as [| n IH]; intros c4 Hcl Hnofe Hstep.
  - destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E ->]. intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E _]]]. discriminate E.
  - destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E _]. discriminate E.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E [Hcln Hred]]]].
      injection E as Hnm. subst m.
      assert (Hsub2 : subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2)).
      { apply (IH c2 Hcln).
        intros j c3 Hj. apply (Hnofe j c3); lia. }
      eapply Hstep.
      * exact Hcln.
      * intros c3' Hfe. apply (Hnofe n c3'); lia.
      * exact Hred.
      * exact Hsub2.
Qed.

Lemma SefG_I_reduce :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure c1 k c4 ->
    SefStep c1 ->
    (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl Hstep.
  destruct (classic (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k)) as [Hfe | Hno].
  - left. exact Hfe.
  - right. apply no_frame_end_heap_sub with (k:=k); auto.
    intros j c3 Hj Hfe. apply Hno. exists j, c3. split; assumption.
Qed.

(* A run in which every heap-changing step targets a location outside H. *)
Inductive red_closure_fresh_writes (H : heap) : config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=
| rcfw_refl c :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c 0 c
| rcfw_step c1 c2 c3 n y :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 n c2 ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom H ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 (S n) c3.

Lemma rcfw_preserves :
  forall H c1 k c4,
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c1) ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros H c1 k c4 Hsub Hcl. induction Hcl as [c | c1 c2 c3 n y Hcl IH Hred Hch Hy].
  - exact Hsub.
  - intros z v Hz.
    apply Hch.
    + intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq. exact (@get_some_inv item z v H Hz).
    + apply IH. { exact Hsub. } exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma subheap_unchanged_of_fresh_writes :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure_fresh_writes (config_heap c1) c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl.
  eapply rcfw_preserves. 2: exact Hcl.
  intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma red_closure_inv : forall c1 k c4,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (k = 0 /\ c4 = c1) \/
  (exists n c2, k = S n /\ red_closure c1 n c2 /\ red c2 c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 k c4 H. destruct H.
  - left. auto.
  - right. exists n, C2. auto.
Qed.

(* The remaining effect-freedom invariant: while the call has not returned,
   every step changes at most one location, and that location is outside the
   initial heap. *)
Definition SefInv (c1 : config) (k : nat) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3 y,
    j < k ->
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom (config_heap c1).

Theorem SefG_I_from_invariant :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure c1 k c4 ->
    SefInv c1 k ->
    (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl. revert c4 Hcl. induction k as [| n IH]; intros c4 Hcl Hinv.
  - (* k = 0 *)
    right. destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E ->]. intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
    + destruct Hex as [n' [c2 Hrest]]. destruct Hrest as [E _]. discriminate E.
  - (* k = S n *)
    destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E _]. discriminate E.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E [Hcln Hstep]]]].
      injection E as Hnm. subst m.
      destruct (classic (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < S n)) as [Hex | Hno].
      * left. exact Hex.
      * right.
        assert (Hinv_n : SefInv c1 n).
        { intros j c2' c3 y Hj Hclj Hnf Hred' Hch.
          apply (Hinv j c2' c3 y).
          - lia.
          - exact Hclj.
          - exact Hnf.
          - exact Hred'.
          - exact Hch. }
        destruct (IH c2 Hcln Hinv_n) as [Hex' | Hsub].
        { exfalso. apply Hno. destruct Hex' as [j [c3 [Hfe Hlt]]].
          exists j, c3. split.
          - exact Hfe.
          - lia. }
        destruct (red_changes_at_most Hstep) as [y Hch].
        assert (Hy : y \notin dom (config_heap c1)).
        { apply (Hinv n c2 c4 y).
          - lia.
          - exact Hcln.
          - intros c3' Hfe. apply Hno. exists n, c3'. split.
            { exact Hfe. }
            { lia. }
          - exact Hstep.
          - exact Hch. }
        intros z v Hz.
        apply Hch.
        { intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq.
          exact (@get_some_inv item z v (config_heap c1) Hz). }
        { apply Hsub. exact Hz. }
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Target                                                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Theorem SefG_I :
  forall (typing_mode : Mode) (w1 : var) (m : met_label) (w2 : var)
         (TZv : typ) (c1 : config) (G : ctx) (c4 : config) (k : nat),
  mode_has_sef typing_mode ->
  mode_has_mutability typing_mode ->
  config_trm c1 = trm_call (avar_f w1) m (avar_f w2) ->
  (G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ w1 ∶ typ_rcd (dec_met m typ_nocap TZv typ_top) /\
   G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ w2 ∶ TZv /\
   G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ typ_nocap <: TZv) ->
  (exists T1, ty_config G c1 T1) ->
  c1 ⊣k↦* c4 ->
  (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
  subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping.

Require Import OperationalSemantics ConfigTyping MethodCall.
Require Import HeapUpdate Coq.Arith.Arith.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Structural facts about how a single reduction step affects the heap *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition changes_at_most (S S' : heap) (y : var) : Prop :=
  forall z v, z <> y -> binds z v S -> binds z v S'.

Lemma red_changes_at_most :
  forall c c', red c c' ->
    exists y, changes_at_most (config_heap c) (config_heap c') y.
Proof.
  intros c c' Hred. destruct Hred.
  - (* red_read *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_write *) exists yObj. intros z v Hne Hb.
    unfold heap_update in H. destruct H as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    apply Hunch; assumption.
  - (* red_call *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_apply *) exists wFun. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_fun *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_obj *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_var *) exists x. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_push *) exists (var_gen (\{} : vars)). intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma binds_in_dom : forall (S : heap) z v,
  binds z v S -> z \in dom S.
Proof.
  intros S z v H. exact (@get_some_inv item z v S H).
Qed.

Lemma red_closure_inv : forall c1 k c4,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (k = 0 /\ c4 = c1) \/
  (exists n c2, k = S n /\ red_closure c1 n c2 /\ red c2 c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 k c4 H. destruct H.
  - left. auto.
  - right. exists n, C2. auto.
Qed.

Lemma fresh_fv_config_dom : forall (y:var) (c:config),
  y \notin fv_config c -> y \notin (dom (config_heap c)).
Proof.
  intros y [t s S e Lv] H. simpl in H.
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Ht H].
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Hs H].
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Hheap H].
  simpl in Hheap. apply notin_union_r in Hheap. destruct Hheap as [Hdom _].
  exact Hdom.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_neq : forall (y z:var) (S:heap),
  z \in dom S -> y \notin dom S -> z <> y.
Proof. intros y z S Hz Hy E. subst. apply Hy. assumption. Qed.

Lemma red_nonwrite_subheap : forall (c c':config),
  c ↦ c' ->
  (forall S0, subheap_unchanged S0 (config_heap c) ->
             subheap_unchanged S0 (config_heap c')) \/
  (exists (Sigma Sigma':heap) (yObj:var) (a:fld_label) (yArg:var),
      config_heap c = Sigma /\ config_heap c' = Sigma' /\
      heap_update Sigma yObj a yArg Sigma').
Proof.
  intros c c' Hred. induction Hred.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - right. simpl. exists Sigma, Sigma', yObj, m, yArg. auto.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl.
    intros z itm Hb.
    apply binds_push_neq.
    + apply Hsub; assumption.
    + apply notin_dom_neq with (S:=Sigma).
      * apply get_some_inv with (v:=itm). apply binds_get. apply Hsub; exact Hb.
      * simpl in H. destruct H as [Hy _].
        pose proof (fresh_fv_config_dom
          (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) Hy) as Hd.
        simpl in Hd. exact Hd.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl.
    intros z itm Hb.
    apply binds_push_neq.
    + apply Hsub; assumption.
    + apply notin_dom_neq with (S:=Sigma).
      * apply get_some_inv with (v:=itm). apply binds_get. apply Hsub; exact Hb.
      * simpl in H. destruct H as [Hy _].
        pose proof (fresh_fv_config_dom
          (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) Hy) as Hd.
        simpl in Hd. exact Hd.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
Qed.

(* A step preserves the initial heap provided it is not a write to a
   location of the initial heap. *)
Definition SefStep (c1 : config) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2) ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c3).

(* The single semantic obligation: during a pure call, before its frame
   ends, no write step can target a location of the initial heap. *)
Definition SefWrite (c1 : config) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3 Sigma Sigma' yObj a yArg,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    config_heap c2 = Sigma ->
    config_heap c3 = Sigma' ->
    heap_update Sigma yObj a yArg Sigma' ->
    yObj \notin dom (config_heap c1).

Lemma SefStep_of_write :
  forall c1, SefWrite c1 ->
  forall j c2 c3,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2) ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c3).
Proof.
  intros c1 Hw j c2 c3 Hcl Hnofe Hstep Hsub.
  destruct (red_nonwrite_subheap Hstep)
    as [Hnw | [Sigma [Sigma' [yObj [a [yArg [Heq1 [Heq2 Hup]]]]]]]].
  - apply Hnw. exact Hsub.
  - (* the step is a write *)
    assert (Hy : yObj \notin dom (config_heap c1)).
    { eapply Hw; eauto. }
    intros z v Hz.
    unfold heap_update in Hup. destruct Hup as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    assert (Hne : z <> yObj).
    { intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq.
      exact (@get_some_inv item z v (config_heap c1) Hz). }
    assert (Hz2 : binds z v Sigma).
    { rewrite <- Heq1. exact (Hsub z v Hz). }
    pose proof (Hunch z v Hne Hz2) as Hz3.
    rewrite Heq2. exact Hz3.
Qed.

Lemma no_frame_end_heap_sub : forall c1 c4 k,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (forall j c3, j < k -> ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3) ->
  SefStep c1 ->
  subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl. revert c4 Hcl.
  induction k as [| n IH]; intros c4 Hcl Hnofe Hstep.
  - destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E ->]. intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E _]]]. discriminate E.
  - destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E _]. discriminate E.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E [Hcln Hred]]]].
      injection E as Hnm. subst m.
      assert (Hsub2 : subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2)).
      { apply (IH c2 Hcln).
        intros j c3 Hj. apply (Hnofe j c3); lia. }
      eapply Hstep.
      * exact Hcln.
      * intros c3' Hfe. apply (Hnofe n c3'); lia.
      * exact Hred.
      * exact Hsub2.
Qed.

Lemma SefG_I_reduce :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure c1 k c4 ->
    SefStep c1 ->
    (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl Hstep.
  destruct (classic (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k)) as [Hfe | Hno].
  - left. exact Hfe.
  - right. apply no_frame_end_heap_sub with (k:=k); auto.
    intros j c3 Hj Hfe. apply Hno. exists j, c3. split; assumption.
Qed.

(* A run in which every heap-changing step targets a location outside H. *)
Inductive red_closure_fresh_writes (H : heap) : config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=
| rcfw_refl c :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c 0 c
| rcfw_step c1 c2 c3 n y :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 n c2 ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom H ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 (S n) c3.

Lemma rcfw_preserves :
  forall H c1 k c4,
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c1) ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros H c1 k c4 Hsub Hcl. induction Hcl as [c | c1 c2 c3 n y Hcl IH Hred Hch Hy].
  - exact Hsub.
  - intros z v Hz.
    apply Hch.
    + intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq. exact (@get_some_inv item z v H Hz).
    + apply IH. { exact Hsub. } exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma subheap_unchanged_of_fresh_writes :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure_fresh_writes (config_heap c1) c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl.
  eapply rcfw_preserves. 2: exact Hcl.
  intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Target                                                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Theorem SefG_I :
  forall (typing_mode : Mode) (w1 : var) (m : met_label) (w2 : var)
         (TZv : typ) (c1 : config) (G : ctx) (c4 : config) (k : nat),
  mode_has_sef typing_mode ->
  mode_has_mutability typing_mode ->
  config_trm c1 = trm_call (avar_f w1) m (avar_f w2) ->
  (G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ w1 ∶ typ_rcd (dec_met m typ_nocap TZv typ_top) /\
   G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ w2 ∶ TZv /\
   G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ typ_nocap <: TZv) ->
  (exists T1, ty_config G c1 T1) ->
  c1 ⊣k↦* c4 ->
  (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
  subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping.

Require Import OperationalSemantics ConfigTyping MethodCall.
Require Import HeapUpdate Coq.Arith.Arith.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Structural facts about how a single reduction step affects the heap *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition changes_at_most (S S' : heap) (y : var) : Prop :=
  forall z v, z <> y -> binds z v S -> binds z v S'.

Lemma red_changes_at_most :
  forall c c', red c c' ->
    exists y, changes_at_most (config_heap c) (config_heap c') y.
Proof.
  intros c c' Hred. destruct Hred.
  - (* red_read *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_write *) exists yObj. intros z v Hne Hb.
    unfold heap_update in H. destruct H as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    apply Hunch; assumption.
  - (* red_call *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_apply *) exists wFun. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_fun *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_obj *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_var *) exists x. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_push *) exists (var_gen (\{} : vars)). intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma binds_in_dom : forall (S : heap) z v,
  binds z v S -> z \in dom S.
Proof.
  intros S z v H. exact (@get_some_inv item z v S H).
Qed.

Lemma red_closure_inv : forall c1 k c4,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (k = 0 /\ c4 = c1) \/
  (exists n c2, k = S n /\ red_closure c1 n c2 /\ red c2 c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 k c4 H. destruct H.
  - left. auto.
  - right. exists n, C2. auto.
Qed.

Lemma fresh_fv_config_dom : forall (y:var) (c:config),
  y \notin fv_config c -> y \notin (dom (config_heap c)).
Proof.
  intros y [t s S e Lv] H. simpl in H.
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Ht H].
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Hs H].
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Hheap H].
  simpl in Hheap. apply notin_union_r in Hheap. destruct Hheap as [Hdom _].
  exact Hdom.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_neq : forall (y z:var) (S:heap),
  z \in dom S -> y \notin dom S -> z <> y.
Proof. intros y z S Hz Hy E. subst. apply Hy. assumption. Qed.

Lemma red_nonwrite_subheap : forall (c c':config),
  c ↦ c' ->
  (forall S0, subheap_unchanged S0 (config_heap c) ->
             subheap_unchanged S0 (config_heap c')) \/
  (exists (Sigma Sigma':heap) (yObj:var) (a:fld_label) (yArg:var),
      config_heap c = Sigma /\ config_heap c' = Sigma' /\
      heap_update Sigma yObj a yArg Sigma').
Proof.
  intros c c' Hred. induction Hred.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - right. simpl. exists Sigma, Sigma', yObj, m, yArg. auto.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl.
    intros z itm Hb.
    apply binds_push_neq.
    + apply Hsub; assumption.
    + apply notin_dom_neq with (S:=Sigma).
      * apply get_some_inv with (v:=itm). apply binds_get. apply Hsub; exact Hb.
      * simpl in H. destruct H as [Hy _].
        pose proof (fresh_fv_config_dom
          (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) Hy) as Hd.
        simpl in Hd. exact Hd.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl.
    intros z itm Hb.
    apply binds_push_neq.
    + apply Hsub; assumption.
    + apply notin_dom_neq with (S:=Sigma).
      * apply get_some_inv with (v:=itm). apply binds_get. apply Hsub; exact Hb.
      * simpl in H. destruct H as [Hy _].
        pose proof (fresh_fv_config_dom
          (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) Hy) as Hd.
        simpl in Hd. exact Hd.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
Qed.

(* A step preserves the initial heap provided it is not a write to a
   location of the initial heap. *)
Definition SefStep (c1 : config) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2) ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c3).

(* The single semantic obligation: during a pure call, before its frame
   ends, no write step can target a location of the initial heap. *)
Definition SefWrite (c1 : config) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3 Sigma Sigma' yObj a yArg,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    config_heap c2 = Sigma ->
    config_heap c3 = Sigma' ->
    heap_update Sigma yObj a yArg Sigma' ->
    yObj \notin dom (config_heap c1).

Lemma SefStep_of_write :
  forall c1, SefWrite c1 ->
  forall j c2 c3,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2) ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c3).
Proof.
  intros c1 Hw j c2 c3 Hcl Hnofe Hstep Hsub.
  destruct (red_nonwrite_subheap Hstep)
    as [Hnw | [Sigma [Sigma' [yObj [a [yArg [Heq1 [Heq2 Hup]]]]]]]].
  - apply Hnw. exact Hsub.
  - (* the step is a write *)
    assert (Hy : yObj \notin dom (config_heap c1)).
    { eapply Hw; eauto. }
    intros z v Hz.
    unfold heap_update in Hup. destruct Hup as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    assert (Hne : z <> yObj).
    { intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq.
      exact (@get_some_inv item z v (config_heap c1) Hz). }
    assert (Hz2 : binds z v Sigma).
    { rewrite <- Heq1. exact (Hsub z v Hz). }
    pose proof (Hunch z v Hne Hz2) as Hz3.
    rewrite Heq2. exact Hz3.
Qed.

Lemma no_frame_end_heap_sub : forall c1 c4 k,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (forall j c3, j < k -> ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3) ->
  SefStep c1 ->
  subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl. revert c4 Hcl.
  induction k as [| n IH]; intros c4 Hcl Hnofe Hstep.
  - destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E ->]. intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E _]]]. discriminate E.
  - destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E _]. discriminate E.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E [Hcln Hred]]]].
      injection E as Hnm. subst m.
      assert (Hsub2 : subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2)).
      { apply (IH c2 Hcln).
        - intros j c3 Hj Hfe. apply (Hnofe j c3).
          + lia.
          + exact Hfe.
        - exact Hstep. }
      eapply Hstep.
      * exact Hcln.
      * intros c3' Hfe. apply (Hnofe n c3'); lia.
      * exact Hred.
      * exact Hsub2.
Qed.

Lemma SefG_I_reduce :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure c1 k c4 ->
    SefStep c1 ->
    (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl Hstep.
  destruct (classic (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k)) as [Hfe | Hno].
  - left. exact Hfe.
  - right. apply no_frame_end_heap_sub with (k:=k); auto.
    intros j c3 Hj Hfe. apply Hno. exists j, c3. split; assumption.
Qed.

(* A run in which every heap-changing step targets a location outside H. *)
Inductive red_closure_fresh_writes (H : heap) : config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=
| rcfw_refl c :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c 0 c
| rcfw_step c1 c2 c3 n y :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 n c2 ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom H ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 (S n) c3.

Lemma rcfw_preserves :
  forall H c1 k c4,
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c1) ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros H c1 k c4 Hsub Hcl. induction Hcl as [c | c1 c2 c3 n y Hcl IH Hred Hch Hy].
  - exact Hsub.
  - intros z v Hz.
    apply Hch.
    + intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq. exact (@get_some_inv item z v H Hz).
    + apply IH. { exact Hsub. } exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma subheap_unchanged_of_fresh_writes :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure_fresh_writes (config_heap c1) c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl.
  eapply rcfw_preserves. 2: exact Hcl.
  intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Target                                                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Theorem SefG_I :
  forall (typing_mode : Mode) (w1 : var) (m : met_label) (w2 : var)
         (TZv : typ) (c1 : config) (G : ctx) (c4 : config) (k : nat),
  mode_has_sef typing_mode ->
  mode_has_mutability typing_mode ->
  config_trm c1 = trm_call (avar_f w1) m (avar_f w2) ->
  (G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ w1 ∶ typ_rcd (dec_met m typ_nocap TZv typ_top) /\
   G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ w2 ∶ TZv /\
   G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ typ_nocap <: TZv) ->
  (exists T1, ty_config G c1 T1) ->
  c1 ⊣k↦* c4 ->
  (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
  subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping.

Require Import OperationalSemantics ConfigTyping MethodCall.
Require Import HeapUpdate Coq.Arith.Arith.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Structural facts about how a single reduction step affects the heap *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition changes_at_most (S S' : heap) (y : var) : Prop :=
  forall z v, z <> y -> binds z v S -> binds z v S'.

Lemma red_changes_at_most :
  forall c c', red c c' ->
    exists y, changes_at_most (config_heap c) (config_heap c') y.
Proof.
  intros c c' Hred. destruct Hred.
  - (* red_read *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_write *) exists yObj. intros z v Hne Hb.
    unfold heap_update in H. destruct H as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    apply Hunch; assumption.
  - (* red_call *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_apply *) exists wFun. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_fun *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_obj *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_var *) exists x. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_push *) exists (var_gen (\{} : vars)). intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma binds_in_dom : forall (S : heap) z v,
  binds z v S -> z \in dom S.
Proof.
  intros S z v H. exact (@get_some_inv item z v S H).
Qed.

Lemma red_closure_inv : forall c1 k c4,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (k = 0 /\ c4 = c1) \/
  (exists n c2, k = S n /\ red_closure c1 n c2 /\ red c2 c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 k c4 H. destruct H.
  - left. auto.
  - right. exists n, C2. auto.
Qed.

Lemma fresh_fv_config_dom : forall (y:var) (c:config),
  y \notin fv_config c -> y \notin (dom (config_heap c)).
Proof.
  intros y [t s S e Lv] H. simpl in H.
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Ht H].
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Hs H].
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Hheap H].
  simpl in Hheap. apply notin_union_r in Hheap. destruct Hheap as [Hdom _].
  exact Hdom.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_neq : forall (y z:var) (S:heap),
  z \in dom S -> y \notin dom S -> z <> y.
Proof. intros y z S Hz Hy E. subst. apply Hy. assumption. Qed.

Lemma red_nonwrite_subheap : forall (c c':config),
  c ↦ c' ->
  (forall S0, subheap_unchanged S0 (config_heap c) ->
