(* A step preserves the initial heap provided it is not a write to a
   location of the initial heap. *)
Definition SefStep (c1 : config) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2) ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c3).

Lemma subheap_unchanged_refl : forall (S:heap), subheap_unchanged S S.
Proof. intros S z v H; exact H. Qed.

Lemma subheap_unchanged_trans : forall (S1 S2 S3:heap),
  subheap_unchanged S1 S2 -> subheap_unchanged S2 S3 ->
  subheap_unchanged S1 S3.
Proof. intros S1 S2 S3 H12 H23 z v H. apply H23. apply H12. exact H. Qed.

Lemma heap_update_preserves_others : forall (S S':heap) (x a y:var),
  heap_update S x a y S' ->
  forall z v, z <> x -> binds z v S -> binds z v S'.
Proof.
  intros S S' x a y [Hok [Hok' [Hdom [Hunch _]]]] z v Hne Hb.
  apply Hunch; assumption.
Qed.

(* The single semantic obligation: during a pure call, before its frame
   ends, no write step can target a location of the initial heap. *)
Definition SefWrite (c1 : config) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3 Sigma Sigma' yObj a yArg,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    config_heap c2 = Sigma ->
    config_heap c3 = Sigma' ->
    heap_update Sigma yObj a yArg Sigma' ->
    yObj \notin dom (config_heap c1).

Lemma SefStep_of_write :
  forall c1, SefWrite c1 ->
  forall j c2 c3,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2) ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c3).
Proof.
  intros c1 Hw j c2 c3 Hcl Hnofe Hstep Hsub.
  destruct (red_nonwrite_subheap Hstep)
    as [Hnw | [Sigma [Sigma' [yObj [a [yArg [Heq1 [Heq2 Hup]]]]]]]].
  - apply Hnw. exact Hsub.
  - (* the step is a write *)
    assert (Hy : yObj \notin dom (config_heap c1)).
    { eapply Hw; eauto. }
    intros z v Hz.
    unfold heap_update in Hup. destruct Hup as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    assert (Hne : z <> yObj).
    { intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq.
      exact (@get_some_inv item z v (config_heap c1) Hz). }
    assert (Hz2 : binds z v Sigma).
    { rewrite <- Heq1. exact (Hsub z v Hz). }
    pose proof (Hunch z v Hne Hz2) as Hz3.
    rewrite Heq2. exact Hz3.
Qed.

Lemma no_frame_end_heap_sub : forall c1 c4 k,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (forall j c3, j < k -> ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3) ->
  SefStep c1 ->
  subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl. revert c4 Hcl.
  induction k as [| n IH]; intros c4 Hcl Hnofe Hstep.
  - destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E ->]. intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E _]]]. discriminate E.
  - destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E _]. discriminate E.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E [Hcln Hred]]]].
      injection E as Hnm. subst m.
      assert (Hsub2 : subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2)).
      { apply (IH c2 Hcln).
        - intros j c3 Hj Hfe. apply (Hnofe j c3).
          + lia.
          + exact Hfe.
        - exact Hstep. }
      eapply Hstep.
      * exact Hcln.
      * intros c3' Hfe. exact (Hnofe n c3' (Nat.lt_succ_diag_r n) Hfe).
      * exact Hred.
      * exact Hsub2.
Qed.

Lemma SefG_I_reduce :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure c1 k c4 ->
    SefStep c1 ->
    (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl Hstep.
  destruct (classic (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k)) as [Hfe | Hno].
  - left. exact Hfe.
  - right. apply no_frame_end_heap_sub with (k:=k); auto.
    intros j c3 Hj Hfe. apply Hno. exists j, c3. split; assumption.
Qed.

(* A run in which every heap-changing step targets a location outside H. *)
Inductive red_closure_fresh_writes (H : heap) : config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=
| rcfw_refl c :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c 0 c
| rcfw_step c1 c2 c3 n y :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 n c2 ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom H ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 (S n) c3.

Lemma rcfw_preserves :
  forall H c1 k c4,
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c1) ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros H c1 k c4 Hsub Hcl. induction Hcl as [c | c1 c2 c3 n y Hcl IH Hred Hch Hy].
  - exact Hsub.
  - intros z v Hz.
    apply Hch.
    + intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq. exact (@get_some_inv item z v H Hz).
    + apply IH. { exact Hsub. } exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma subheap_unchanged_of_fresh_writes :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure_fresh_writes (config_heap c1) c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl.
  eapply rcfw_preserves. 2: exact Hcl.
  intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
Qed.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Structural facts about how a single reduction step affects the heap *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition changes_at_most (S S' : heap) (y : var) : Prop :=
  forall z v, z <> y -> binds z v S -> binds z v S'.

Lemma red_changes_at_most :
  forall c c', red c c' ->
    exists y, changes_at_most (config_heap c) (config_heap c') y.
Proof.
  intros c c' Hred. destruct Hred.
  - (* red_read *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_write *) exists yObj. intros z v Hne Hb.
    unfold heap_update in H. destruct H as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    apply Hunch; assumption.
  - (* red_call *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_apply *) exists wFun. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_fun *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_obj *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_var *) exists x. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_push *) exists (var_gen (\{} : vars)). intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma binds_in_dom : forall (S : heap) z v,
  binds z v S -> z \in dom S.
Proof.
  intros S z v H. exact (@get_some_inv item z v S H).
Qed.

Lemma red_closure_inv : forall c1 k c4,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (k = 0 /\ c4 = c1) \/
  (exists n c2, k = S n /\ red_closure c1 n c2 /\ red c2 c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 k c4 H. destruct H.
  - left. auto.
  - right. exists n, C2. auto.
Qed.

Lemma fresh_fv_config_dom : forall (y:var) (c:config),
  y \notin fv_config c -> y \notin (dom (config_heap c)).
Proof.
  intros y [t s S e Lv] H. simpl in H.
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Ht H].
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Hs H].
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Hheap H].
  simpl in Hheap. apply notin_union_r in Hheap. destruct Hheap as [Hdom _].
  exact Hdom.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_neq : forall (y z:var) (S:heap),
  z \in dom S -> y \notin dom S -> z <> y.
Proof. intros y z S Hz Hy E. subst. apply Hy. assumption. Qed.

Lemma red_nonwrite_subheap : forall (c c':config),
  c ↦ c' ->
  (forall S0, subheap_unchanged S0 (config_heap c) ->
             subheap_unchanged S0 (config_heap c')) \/
  (exists (Sigma Sigma':heap) (yObj:var) (a:fld_label) (yArg:var),

      heap_update Sigma yObj a yArg Sigma').
Proof.

  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - right. simpl. exists Sigma, Sigma', yObj, m, yArg. auto.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl.
    intros z itm Hb.
    apply binds_push_neq.
    + apply Hsub; assumption.
    + apply notin_dom_neq with (S:=Sigma).
      * apply get_some_inv with (v:=itm). apply binds_get. apply Hsub; exact Hb.
      * simpl in H. destruct H as [Hy _].
        pose proof (fresh_fv_config_dom
          (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) Hy) as Hd.
        simpl in Hd. exact Hd.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl.
    intros z itm Hb.
    apply binds_push_neq.
    + apply Hsub; assumption.
    + apply notin_dom_neq with (S:=Sigma).
      * apply get_some_inv with (v:=itm). apply binds_get. apply Hsub; exact Hb.
      * simpl in H. destruct H as [Hy _].
        pose proof (fresh_fv_config_dom
          (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) Hy) as Hd.
        simpl in Hd. exact Hd.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
Qed.

(* A step preserves the initial heap provided it is not a write to a
   location of the initial heap. *)
Definition SefStep (c1 : config) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2) ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c3).

Lemma subheap_unchanged_refl : forall (S:heap), subheap_unchanged S S.
Proof. intros S z v H; exact H. Qed.

Lemma subheap_unchanged_trans : forall (S1 S2 S3:heap),
  subheap_unchanged S1 S2 -> subheap_unchanged S2 S3 ->
  subheap_unchanged S1 S3.
Proof. intros S1 S2 S3 H12 H23 z v H. apply H23. apply H12. exact H. Qed.

Lemma heap_update_preserves_others : forall (S S':heap) (x:var) (a:fld_label) (y:var),
  heap_update S x a y S' ->
  forall z v, z <> x -> binds z v S -> binds z v S'.
Proof.
  intros S S' x a y [Hok [Hok' [Hdom [Hunch _]]]] z v Hne Hb.
  apply Hunch; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_not_nocap : forall (typing_mode:Mode) (T:typ) vk,
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk -> T <> typ_nocap.
Proof. intros typing_mode T vk H. inversion H; subst; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma inert_binds_not_nocap : forall (typing_mode:Mode) (G:ctx) v T,
  inert (typing_mode:=typing_mode) G -> ctx_binds v T G -> T <> typ_nocap.
Proof.

  - inversion Hi; subst. eapply inert_typ_not_nocap; eassumption.
  - inversion Hi; subst. apply IHHb; assumption.
  - inversion Hi.
Qed.

(* The single semantic obligation: during a pure call, before its frame
   ends, no write step can target a location of the initial heap. *)
Definition SefWrite (c1 : config) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3 Sigma Sigma' yObj a yArg,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    config_heap c2 = Sigma ->
    config_heap c3 = Sigma' ->
    heap_update Sigma yObj a yArg Sigma' ->
    yObj \notin dom (config_heap c1).

Lemma SefStep_of_write :
  forall c1, SefWrite c1 ->
  forall j c2 c3,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2) ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c3).
Proof.
  intros c1 Hw j c2 c3 Hcl Hnofe Hstep Hsub.
  destruct (red_nonwrite_subheap Hstep)
    as [Hnw | [Sigma [Sigma' [yObj [a [yArg [Heq1 [Heq2 Hup]]]]]]]].
  - apply Hnw. exact Hsub.
  - (* the step is a write *)
    assert (Hy : yObj \notin dom (config_heap c1)).
    { eapply Hw; eauto. }
    intros z v Hz.
    unfold heap_update in Hup. destruct Hup as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).

    assert (Hz2 : binds z v Sigma).
    { rewrite <- Heq1. exact (Hsub z v Hz). }
    pose proof (Hunch z v Hne Hz2) as Hz3.
    rewrite Heq2. exact Hz3.
Qed.

Lemma no_frame_end_heap_sub : forall c1 c4 k,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (forall j c3, j < k -> ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3) ->
  SefStep c1 ->
  subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl. revert c4 Hcl.
  induction k as [| n IH]; intros c4 Hcl Hnofe Hstep.
  - destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E ->]. intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E _]]]. discriminate E.
  - destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E _]. discriminate E.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E [Hcln Hred]]]].
      injection E as Hnm. subst m.
      assert (Hsub2 : subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2)).
      { apply (IH c2 Hcln).
        - intros j c3 Hj Hfe. apply (Hnofe j c3).
          + lia.
          + exact Hfe.
        - exact Hstep. }
      eapply Hstep.
      * exact Hcln.
      * intros c3' Hfe. exact (Hnofe n c3' (Nat.lt_succ_diag_r n) Hfe).
      * exact Hred.
      * exact Hsub2.
Qed.

Lemma SefG_I_reduce :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure c1 k c4 ->
    SefStep c1 ->
    (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl Hstep.
  destruct (classic (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k)) as [Hfe | Hno].
  - left. exact Hfe.
  - right. apply no_frame_end_heap_sub with (k:=k); auto.
    intros j c3 Hj Hfe. apply Hno. exists j, c3. split; assumption.
Qed.

(* A run in which every heap-changing step targets a location outside H. *)
Inductive red_closure_fresh_writes (H : heap) : config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=
| rcfw_refl c :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c 0 c
| rcfw_step c1 c2 c3 n y :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 n c2 ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom H ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 (S n) c3.

Lemma rcfw_preserves :
  forall H c1 k c4,
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c1) ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros H c1 k c4 Hsub Hcl. induction Hcl as [c | c1 c2 c3 n y Hcl IH Hred Hch Hy].
  - exact Hsub.
  - intros z v Hz.
    apply Hch.
    + intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq. exact (@get_some_inv item z v H Hz).
    + apply IH. { exact Hsub. } exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma subheap_unchanged_of_fresh_writes :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure_fresh_writes (config_heap c1) c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl.
  eapply rcfw_preserves. 2: exact Hcl.
  intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
Qed.

(* Target                                                              *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

  c1 ⊣k↦* c4 ->

  subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).

10	(* Structural facts about how a single reduction step affects the heap *)
11	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
12	
13	Definition changes_at_most (S S' : heap) (y : var) : Prop :=
14	  forall z v, z <> y -> binds z v S -> binds z v S'.
15	
16	Lemma red_changes_at_most :
17	  forall c c', red c c' ->
18	    exists y, changes_at_most (config_heap c) (config_heap c') y.
19	Proof.
20	  intros c c' Hred. destruct Hred.
21	  - (* red_read *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
22	  - (* red_write *) exists yObj. intros z v Hne Hb.
23	    unfold heap_update in H. destruct H as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
24	    apply Hunch; assumption.
25	  - (* red_call *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
26	  - (* red_apply *) exists wFun. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
27	  - (* red_let_fun *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
28	    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
29	    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
30	  - (* red_let_obj *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
31	    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
32	    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
33	  - (* red_let_var *) exists x. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
34	  - (* red_let_push *) exists (var_gen (\{} : vars)). intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
35	Qed.

37	Lemma binds_in_dom : forall (S : heap) z v,
38	  binds z v S -> z \in dom S.
39	Proof.
40	  intros S z v H. exact (@get_some_inv item z v S H).
41	Qed.

43	Lemma red_closure_inv : forall c1 k c4,
44	  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
45	  (k = 0 /\ c4 = c1) \/
46	  (exists n c2, k = S n /\ red_closure c1 n c2 /\ red c2 c4).
47	Proof.
48	  intros c1 k c4 H. destruct H.
49	  - left. auto.
50	  - right. exists n, C2. auto.
51	Qed.
52	
53	Lemma fresh_fv_config_dom : forall (y:var) (c:config),
54	  y \notin fv_config c -> y \notin (dom (config_heap c)).
55	Proof.
56	  intros y [t s S e Lv] H. simpl in H.
57	  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Ht H].
58	  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Hs H].
59	  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Hheap H].
60	  simpl in Hheap. apply notin_union_r in Hheap. destruct Hheap as [Hdom _].
61	  exact Hdom.
62	Qed.
63	
64	Lemma notin_dom_neq : forall (y z:var) (S:heap),
65	  z \in dom S -> y \notin dom S -> z <> y.

68	Lemma red_nonwrite_subheap : forall (c c':config),
69	  c ↦ c' ->

80	  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.

87	      * simpl in H. destruct H as [Hy _].
88	        pose proof (fresh_fv_config_dom
89	          (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) Hy) as Hd.
90	        simpl in Hd. exact Hd.
91	  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl.
92	    intros z itm Hb.

107	Definition SefStep (c1 : config) : Prop :=
108	  forall j c2 c3,
109	    red_closure c1 j c2 ->

111	    red c2 c3 ->
112	    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2) ->

115	Lemma subheap_unchanged_refl : forall (S:heap), subheap_unchanged S S.
116	Proof. intros S z v H; exact H. Qed.

119	  subheap_unchanged S1 S2 -> subheap_unchanged S2 S3 ->
120	  subheap_unchanged S1 S3.
121	Proof. intros S1 S2 S3 H12 H23 z v H. apply H23. apply H12. exact H. Qed.

124	  heap_update S x a y S' ->
125	  forall z v, z <> x -> binds z v S -> binds z v S'.

136	  inert (typing_mode:=typing_mode) G -> ctx_binds v T G -> T <> typ_nocap.

157	(* Distribution of substitution over the classical conditional, used by
158	   the (missing) substitution/open commutation metatheory. *)
159	Lemma subst_if_avar : forall (x y:var) (P:Prop) (a b:avar),
160	  subst_var x y (If P then a else b) = If P then subst_var x y a else subst_var x y b.

163	Lemma subst_if_typ : forall (x y:var) (P:Prop) (A B:typ),

179	Definition SefWrite (c1 : config) : Prop :=
180	  forall j c2 c3 Sigma Sigma' yObj a yArg,
181	    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
182	    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
183	    red c2 c3 ->
184	    config_heap c2 = Sigma ->
185	    config_heap c3 = Sigma' ->
186	    heap_update Sigma yObj a yArg Sigma' ->
187	    yObj \notin dom (config_heap c1).

189	Lemma SefStep_of_write :
190	  forall c1, SefWrite c1 ->
191	  forall j c2 c3,
192	    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
193	    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
194	    red c2 c3 ->

196	    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c3).

199	  destruct (red_nonwrite_subheap Hstep)
200	    as [Hnw | [Sigma [Sigma' [yObj [a [yArg [Heq1 [Heq2 Hup]]]]]]]].
201	  - apply Hnw. exact Hsub.

252	  destruct (classic (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k)) as [Hfe | Hno].
253	  - left. exact Hfe.
254	  - right. apply no_frame_end_heap_sub with (k:=k); auto.
255	    intros j c3 Hj Hfe. apply Hno. exists j, c3. split; assumption.
256	Qed.

258	(* A run in which every heap-changing step targets a location outside H. *)
259	Inductive red_closure_fresh_writes (H : heap) : config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=
260	| rcfw_refl c :
261	    red_closure_fresh_writes H c 0 c
262	| rcfw_step c1 c2 c3 n y :
263	    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 n c2 ->
264	    red c2 c3 ->
265	    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
266	    y \notin dom H ->
267	    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 (S n) c3.
268	
269	Lemma rcfw_preserves :
270	  forall H c1 k c4,
271	    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c1) ->
272	    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 k c4 ->
273	    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c4).
274	Proof.
275	  intros H c1 k c4 Hsub Hcl. induction Hcl as [c | c1 c2 c3 n y Hcl IH Hred Hch Hy].
276	  - exact Hsub.
277	  - intros z v Hz.
278	    apply Hch.
279	    + intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq. exact (@get_some_inv item z v H Hz).
280	    + apply IH. { exact Hsub. } exact Hz.
281	Qed.

283	Lemma subheap_unchanged_of_fresh_writes :
284	  forall c1 c4 k,
285	    red_closure_fresh_writes (config_heap c1) c1 k c4 ->
286	    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
287	Proof.
288	  intros c1 c4 k Hcl.
289	  eapply rcfw_preserves. 2: exact Hcl.
290	  intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
291	Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Inductive avar : Set :=
  | avar_b : nat -> avar
  | avar_f : var -> avar.

Notation avars := (list avar).

Instance VarSubstVar : SubstVar var :=
  fun x y z => If z = x then y else z.

Instance VarSealable: Sealable var :=
  fun n x y => y.

Instance VarOpenable : Openable var :=
  fun n x a => a.

Instance VarFreeVar : FreeVar var := singleton (A:=var).

Instance VarAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax VarOpenable VarFreeVar VarSubstVar := {}.

Instance AvarOpenable : Openable avar :=
  fun n x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => If n = i then avar_f x else avar_b i
    | avar_f y => avar_f y
    end.

Instance AvarFreeVar : FreeVar avar :=
  fun a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => \{}
    | avar_f x => \{x}
    end.

Instance AvarSubstVar : SubstVar avar :=
  fun (x: var) (y: var) (a: avar) =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => avar_b i
    | avar_f z => (avar_f (If z = x then y else z))
    end.

Instance AvarAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax AvarOpenable AvarFreeVar AvarSubstVar := {}.

Instance AvarSealable : Sealable avar :=
  fun n x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => If n <= i then avar_f x else avar_b i
    | avar_f y => avar_f y
    end.

Instance AvarDecideFv : DecideFv AvarAbstractSyntax :=
  fun x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => false
    | avar_f y => (If x = y then true else false)
    end.

Instance AvarClosing : Closing AvarAbstractSyntax :=
  fun (n : nat) (x : var) (a : avar) =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => avar_b i
    | avar_f y => (If y = x then avar_b n else avar_f y)
    end.

Fixpoint ctx_concat(G1 G2: ctx): ctx :=
match G2 with
| ctx_empty => G1

| ctx_ok_hide(G: ctx):

Inductive ctx_weakens: ctx -> Prop :=

Inductive ctx_weakens_hide: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_weakens_hide_empty: ctx_weakens_hide ctx_empty
| ctx_weakens_hide_push G v vk t:

    ctx_weakens_hide (ctx_push G v vk t)
| ctx_weakens_hide_hide G:
    ctx_weakens_hide G ->
    ctx_weakens_hide (ctx_hide G)
.

Inductive ctx_binds: var -> typ -> ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_binds_e(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    ctx_binds v t (ctx_push G v vk t)
| ctx_binds_n(v v2: var)(vk: varkind)(t t2: typ)(G: ctx):
    v <> v2 ->
    ctx_binds v t G ->
    ctx_binds v t (ctx_push G v2 vk t2)
| ctx_binds_hide(v: var)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    ctx_binds v t G ->
    ctx_binds v t (ctx_hide G)

Inductive ctx_binds_k_after: var -> varkind -> typ -> ctx -> ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_binds_k_e(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Export Coq.Program.Basics.

From TLC Require Export LibVar LibLN LibEnv.

Require Export LibNatExtra LibVarExtra LibSetExtra LibEnvExtra LibListExtra LibListReorder LibFreshExtra.

Open Scope program_scope.

Section Program.

Definition dec_apply {A B : Type} dec (f : A -> B) g x :=
    match dec x with
    | true => f x
    | false => g x
    end.

Definition ignore_second {A B C : Type} (f : A -> C) (x : A) (n : B) := f x.

Definition compose12 {A B C D : Type} (g : B -> D -> C) (f : A -> D -> B) (x : A) (n : D) :=
    g (f x n) n.

Notation " g ∘∘ f " := (compose12 g f) (at level 40, left associativity).

End Program.

Notation " g ∘∘ f "
  := (compose12 g f) (at level 40, left associativity) : program_scope.

Module Nat := PeanoNat.Nat.

Notation "xs ~** vs" := (singles (List.rev xs) (List.rev vs))
  (at level 27, left associativity) : env_scope.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Strings.String LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Equivalence.

Section WithMode.
Context (typing_mode : Mode).

(* A semantic "capability purity" predicate on types.
   - [typ_bot] is impure;
   - [typ_nocap] is pure;
   - a refcap record is pure iff its upper bound cannot be shown below
     [typ_bot] under any opening (this is what the [subtyp_typ] rule for
     refcap records can turn into [typ_rcd (dec_typ mut bot bot)]);
   - normal/fld/met records, functions and recursive types are pure;
   - [and] / [or] are lattice meet / join.                              *)
Fixpoint Ppred (G : ctx) (e : renv) (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_bot => False
  | typ_nocap => True
  | typ_rcd D =>
      match D with
      | dec_typ l S T0 =>
          match l with
          | typ_label_refcap _ =>
              ~ (forall x, G ⁏ e ⊢ (open x T0) <: typ_bot)
          | typ_label_normal _ => True
          end
      | dec_fld _ _ _ => True
      | dec_met _ _ _ _ => True
      end
  | typ_and S U => Ppred G e S /\ Ppred G e U
  | typ_or S U => Ppred G e S \/ Ppred G e U
  | typ_fun _ _ => True
  | typ_bnd _ => True
  | typ_sel _ _ _ => True
  end.

(* Symmetry of typed equivalence for types. *)
Lemma tyq_sym : forall e (T U : typ), e ⊢ T ≈ U -> e ⊢ U ≈ T.
Proof.
  intros e T U H.
  induction H.
  - apply tyq_typ_nulary; assumption.
  - destruct H.
    + apply tyq_typ_andor with (T := typ_and); assumption.
    + apply tyq_typ_andor with (T := typ_or); assumption.
  - apply tyq_typ_fun.
    + assumption.
    + intro x; apply H0.
  - apply tyq_typ_fld; assumption.
  - apply tyq_typ_typ.
    + intro x; apply H.
    + intro x; apply H0.
  - apply tyq_typ_sel_normal. apply tyq_var_sym. assumption.
  - apply tyq_typ_sel.
  - apply tyq_typ_bnd. intro x; apply H.
  - apply tyq_typ_met.
    + intro x; apply H.
    + assumption.
    + intros x y; apply H0.
Qed.

Lemma tyq_sub_bot_iff : forall G e (T U : typ),

    + apply (subtyp_tyq typing_mode (tyq_sym (Heq x))).

Qed.

=== Cex.v
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Strings.String LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping.

(* Counterexample to the stated syntactic "NoNocap" condition:
   a context whose only binding is x : rcd(A : nocap .. mut_marker bot)
   still derives  nocap <: mut_marker bot, via the selection rules. *)
Section Cex.
Context (typing_mode : Mode).

Definition Alab : typ_label := typ_label_normal ("A"%string).
Definition MT : typ := typ_mut_marker typ_bot.
Definition Rec : typ := typ_rcd (dec_typ Alab typ_nocap MT).
Definition xv : var := var_gen (\{} : vars).
Definition yv : var := var_gen (\{xv} : vars).
Definition G : ctx := ctx_empty § xv / v_loc ~ Rec.
Definition ee : renv := renv_empty.

Lemma binds_x : ctx_binds xv Rec G.
Proof. apply ctx_binds_e. Qed.

Lemma ty_x : G ⁏ ee ⊢ xv ∶ Rec.
Proof. apply ty_var_var. apply binds_x. Qed.

Definition SelT : typ := typ_sel (avar_f xv) Alab (avar_f yv).

Lemma cex_nocap_mutbot : G ⁏ ee ⊢ typ_nocap <: MT.
Proof.
  eapply (@subtyp_trans typing_mode G ee typ_nocap SelT MT).
  - apply (@subtyp_sel2 typing_mode G ee xv Alab yv typ_nocap MT ty_x).
  - apply (@subtyp_sel1 typing_mode G ee xv Alab yv typ_nocap MT ty_x).
Qed.

(* The syntactic no-typed-nocap condition really holds for G. *)
Definition NoBindsNocap (H : ctx) : Prop :=
  forall v T, ctx_binds v T H -> T <> typ_nocap.

Lemma NBN_empty : NoBindsNocap ctx_empty.
Proof. intros v T Hb. inversion Hb. Qed.

Lemma NBN_push : forall H v0 vk0 T0,
  NoBindsNocap H -> T0 <> typ_nocap -> NoBindsNocap (ctx_push H v0 vk0 T0).
Proof.
  intros H v0 vk0 T0 Hh Hneq v T Hb. inversion Hb; subst.
  - exact Hneq.
  - eapply Hh; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Rec_neq_nocap : Rec <> typ_nocap.
Proof. discriminate. Qed.

Lemma G_no_binds_nocap : NoBindsNocap G.
Proof.
  unfold G. apply NBN_push; [apply NBN_empty | apply Rec_neq_nocap].
Qed.

End Cex.
=== Purity.v
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Strings.String LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Equivalence.

Section WithMode.
Context (typing_mode : Mode).

(* Purity predicate: intended as a strengthening of the NoNocap hypothesis. *)
Fixpoint Ppred (G : ctx) (e : renv) (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_bot => False
  | typ_nocap => True
  | typ_rcd D =>
      match D with
      | dec_typ l S0 T0 =>
          match l with
          | typ_label_refcap _ =>
              ~ (forall x, G ⁏ e ⊢ (open x T0) <: typ_bot)
          | typ_label_normal _ => True
          end
      | dec_fld _ _ _ => True
      | dec_met _ _ _ _ => True
      end
  | typ_and S0 U => Ppred G e S0 /\ Ppred G e U
  | typ_or S0 U => Ppred G e S0 \/ Ppred G e U
  | typ_fun _ _ => True
  | typ_bnd _ => True
  | typ_sel _ _ _ => True
  end.

Lemma tyq_sym : forall e (T U : typ), e ⊢ T ≈ U -> e ⊢ U ≈ T.
Proof.
  refine (tyq_typ_ind (fun e T U => e ⊢ U ≈ T) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _).
  - intros e0 T0 Hn. apply tyq_typ_nulary. assumption.
  - intros T0 e0 t11 t12 t21 t22 Hand Heq1 IH1 Heq2 IH2.
    destruct Hand.
    + apply tyq_typ_andor with (T := typ_and).
      * apply typ_andor_and.
      * exact IH1.
      * exact IH2.
    + apply tyq_typ_andor with (T := typ_or).
      * apply typ_andor_or.
      * exact IH1.
      * exact IH2.
  - intros e0 t11 t12 t21 t22 Heq1 IH1 Heq2 IH2.
    apply tyq_typ_fun.
    + exact IH1.
    + intro x; exact (IH2 x).
  - intros e0 a t11 t12 t21 t22 Heq1 IH1 Heq2 IH2.
    apply tyq_typ_fld.
    + exact IH1.
    + exact IH2.
  - intros e0 B t11 t12 t21 t22 Heq1 IH1 Heq2 IH2.
    apply tyq_typ_typ.
    + intro x; exact (IH1 x).
    + intro x; exact (IH2 x).
  - intros e0 v1 v2 v3 l Hv. apply tyq_typ_sel_normal. apply tyq_var_sym. exact Hv.
  - intros e0 v1 v2 l. apply tyq_typ_sel.
  - intros e0 t1 t2 Heq IH. apply tyq_typ_bnd. intro x; exact (IH x).
  - intros m e0 t11 t12 t13 t21 t22 t23 Heq1 IH1 Heq2 IH2 Heq3 IH3.
    apply tyq_typ_met.
    + intro x; exact (IH1 x).
    + exact IH2.

=== Cex.v
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Strings.String LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping.

(* Counterexample to the stated syntactic "NoNocap" condition:
   a context whose only binding is x : rcd(A : nocap .. mut_marker bot)
   still derives  nocap <: mut_marker bot, via the selection rules. *)
Section Cex.
Context (typing_mode : Mode).

Definition Alab : typ_label := typ_label_normal ("A"%string).
Definition MT : typ := typ_mut_marker typ_bot.
Definition Rec : typ := typ_rcd (dec_typ Alab typ_nocap MT).
Definition xv : var := var_gen (\{} : vars).
Definition yv : var := var_gen (\{xv} : vars).
Definition G : ctx := ctx_empty § xv / v_loc ~ Rec.
Definition ee : renv := renv_empty.

Lemma binds_x : ctx_binds xv Rec G.
Proof. apply ctx_binds_e. Qed.

Lemma ty_x : G ⁏ ee ⊢ xv ∶ Rec.
Proof. apply ty_var_var. apply binds_x. Qed.

Definition SelT : typ := typ_sel (avar_f xv) Alab (avar_f yv).

Lemma cex_nocap_mutbot : G ⁏ ee ⊢ typ_nocap <: MT.
Proof.
  eapply (@subtyp_trans typing_mode G ee typ_nocap SelT MT).
  - apply (@subtyp_sel2 typing_mode G ee xv Alab yv typ_nocap MT ty_x).
  - apply (@subtyp_sel1 typing_mode G ee xv Alab yv typ_nocap MT ty_x).
Qed.

(* The syntactic no-typed-nocap condition really holds for G. *)
Definition NoBindsNocap (H : ctx) : Prop :=
  forall v T, ctx_binds v T H -> T <> typ_nocap.

Lemma NBN_empty : NoBindsNocap ctx_empty.
Proof. intros v T Hb. inversion Hb. Qed.

Lemma NBN_push : forall H v0 vk0 T0,
  NoBindsNocap H -> T0 <> typ_nocap -> NoBindsNocap (ctx_push H v0 vk0 T0).
Proof.
  intros H v0 vk0 T0 Hh Hneq v T Hb. inversion Hb; subst.
  - exact Hneq.
  - eapply Hh; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Rec_neq_nocap : Rec <> typ_nocap.
Proof. discriminate. Qed.

Lemma G_no_binds_nocap : NoBindsNocap G.
Proof.
  unfold G. apply NBN_push; [apply NBN_empty | apply Rec_neq_nocap].
Qed.

End Cex.
=== Purity.v
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Coq.Strings.String LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Equivalence.

Section WithMode.
Context (typing_mode : Mode).

(* Purity predicate: intended as a strengthening of the NoNocap hypothesis. *)
Fixpoint Ppred (G : ctx) (e : renv) (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_bot => False
  | typ_nocap => True
  | typ_rcd D =>
      match D with
      | dec_typ l S0 T0 =>
          match l with
          | typ_label_refcap _ =>
              ~ (forall x, G ⁏ e ⊢ (open x T0) <: typ_bot)
          | typ_label_normal _ => True
          end
      | dec_fld _ _ _ => True
      | dec_met _ _ _ _ => True
      end
  | typ_and S0 U => Ppred G e S0 /\ Ppred G e U
  | typ_or S0 U => Ppred G e S0 \/ Ppred G e U
  | typ_fun _ _ => True
  | typ_bnd _ => True
  | typ_sel _ _ _ => True
  end.

Lemma tyq_sym : forall e (T U : typ), e ⊢ T ≈ U -> e ⊢ U ≈ T.
Proof.
  refine (tyq_typ_ind (fun e T U => e ⊢ U ≈ T) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _).
  - intros e0 T0 Hn. apply tyq_typ_nulary. assumption.
  - intros T0 e0 t11 t12 t21 t22 Hand Heq1 IH1 Heq2 IH2.
    destruct Hand.
    + apply tyq_typ_andor with (T := typ_and).
      * apply typ_andor_and.
      * exact IH1.
      * exact IH2.
    + apply tyq_typ_andor with (T := typ_or).
      * apply typ_andor_or.
      * exact IH1.
      * exact IH2.
  - intros e0 t11 t12 t21 t22 Heq1 IH1 Heq2 IH2.
    apply tyq_typ_fun.
    + exact IH1.
    + intro x; exact (IH2 x).
  - intros e0 a t11 t12 t21 t22 Heq1 IH1 Heq2 IH2.
    apply tyq_typ_fld.
    + exact IH1.
    + exact IH2.
  - intros e0 B t11 t12 t21 t22 Heq1 IH1 Heq2 IH2.
    apply tyq_typ_typ.
    + intro x; exact (IH1 x).
    + intro x; exact (IH2 x).
  - intros e0 v1 v2 v3 l Hv. apply tyq_typ_sel_normal. apply tyq_var_sym. exact Hv.
  - intros e0 v1 v2 l. apply tyq_typ_sel.
  - intros e0 t1 t2 Heq IH. apply tyq_typ_bnd. intro x; exact (IH x).
  - intros m e0 t11 t12 t13 t21 t22 t23 Heq1 IH1 Heq2 IH2 Heq3 IH3.
    apply tyq_typ_met.
    + intro x; exact (IH1 x).
    + exact IH2.
    + intros x y; exact (IH3 x y).
Qed.

Lemma tyq_sub_bot_iff_open : forall G e (T U : typ),
  (forall x, e ⊢ (open x T) ≈ (open x U)) ->
  ((forall x, G ⁏ e ⊢ (open x T) <: typ_bot) <->
   (forall x, G ⁏ e ⊢ (open x U) <: typ_bot)).
Proof.
  intros G e T U Heq. split; intros H x.
  - eapply subtyp_trans.
    + apply (@subtyp_tyq typing_mode G e (open x U) (open x T) (tyq_sym (Heq x))).
    + apply (H x).
  - eapply subtyp_trans.
    + apply (@subtyp_tyq typing_mode G e (open x T) (open x U) (Heq x)).
    + apply (H x).
Qed.

Lemma Ppred_tyq : forall G e (T U : typ),
  e ⊢ T ≈ U -> (Ppred G e T <-> Ppred G e U).
Proof.
  intros G.
  refine (tyq_typ_ind (fun e T U => Ppred G e T <-> Ppred G e U) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _).
  - intros e0 T0 Hn. simpl. tauto.
  - intros T0 e0 t11 t12 t21 t22 Hand Heq1 IH1 Heq2 IH2.
    destruct Hand; simpl; tauto.
  - intros e0 t11 t12 t21 t22 Heq1 IH1 Heq2 IH2.
    simpl. tauto.
  - intros e0 a t11 t12 t21 t22 Heq1 IH1 Heq2 IH2.
    simpl. tauto.
  - intros e0 B t11 t12 t21 t22 Heq1 IH1 Heq2 IH2.
    destruct B as [n | Cl]; simpl.
    + tauto.
    + exact (not_iff_compat (@tyq_sub_bot_iff_open G e0 t12 t22 Heq2)).
  - intros e0 v1 v2 v3 l Hv. simpl. tauto.
  - intros e0 v1 v2 l. simpl. tauto.
  - intros e0 t1 t2 Heq IH. simpl. tauto.
  - intros m e0 t11 t12 t13 t21 t22 t23 Heq1 IH1 Heq2 IH2 Heq3 IH3.
    simpl. tauto.
Qed.

End WithMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Deref HeapUpdate.

Reserved Notation "t1 ↦ t2" (at level 40, t2 at level 39).

Inductive red : config -> config -> Prop :=

| red_read : forall yObj wObj m Sigma e Lv yVal wVal ds fs,
    fresh_in_config (wVal :: nil) (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m; fs ; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
    defs_has ds (def_fld m (avar_f yVal)) ->
    (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m; fs ; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (trm_var (avar_f wVal); fs; Sigma; e & wVal ~ yVal; fv_config (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m; fs ; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_write : forall yObj wObj m Sigma e Lv yArg wArg Sigma' fs,
    heap_update Sigma yObj m yArg Sigma' ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    binds wArg yArg e ->
    (trm_write (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (trm_var (avar_f wArg); fs ; Sigma'; e; fv_config (trm_write (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_call : forall yObj wObj m Sigma e Lv wArg t ds fs,
    binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
    defs_has ds (def_met m t) ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs ; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ ((open wArg (open_rec 1 wObj t)); fs ; Sigma; e; fv_config (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs ; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_apply : forall yFun wFun wArg Sigma e Lv t fs,
    binds yFun (item_fun t) Sigma ->
    binds wFun yFun e ->
    (trm_apply (avar_f wFun) (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open wArg t; fs; Sigma; e; fv_config (trm_apply (avar_f wFun) (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_fun : forall T t1 t2 Sigma e Lv y w fs,
    fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil) (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    y <> w ->
    (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open w t2 ; fs; Sigma & y ~ (item_fun t1); e & w ~ y ; fv_config (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_obj : forall T ds t Sigma e Lv y w fs,
    fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil) (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    w <> y ->
    (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open w t ; fs; Sigma & y ~ (item_obj (deref_defs (e & w ~ y) (open w ds))); e & w ~ y ; fv_config (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_var : forall t Sigma e Lv x fs,
    (trm_var (avar_f x); (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs); Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open x t; fs; Sigma; e ; fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x); (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs); Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_push : forall s t fs Sigma e Lv,
    (trm_let s t; fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (s; (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs); Sigma; e ; fv_config (trm_let s t; fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

where "t1 ↦ t2" := (red t1 t2).

Inductive answer: config -> Prop :=
| nf_loc: forall x Sigma e Lv, answer (trm_var (avar_f x); stack_nil; Sigma; e; Lv).

Reserved Notation "C1 ⊣ n ↦* C2"
         (at level 40, n at level 41, C2 at level 39).

Inductive red_closure :  config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=

| red_refl : forall (C : config),
    C ⊣ 0 ↦* C

| red_trans : forall (C1 C2 C3 : config) (n : nat),
    C1 ⊣ n ↦* C2 ->
    C2      ↦  C3 ->
    C1 ⊣ S n ↦* C3

where "C1 ⊣ n ↦* C2" := (red_closure C1 n C2).

Definition config_terminates_in C n :=
 (exists (Ca : config), answer Ca /\ (C ⊣n↦* Ca)).

Definition config_terminates C :=
 (exists (n : nat), config_terminates_in C n).

    defs_has ds (def_met m t) ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs ; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ ((open wArg (open_rec 1 wObj t)); fs ; Sigma; e; fv_config (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs ; Sigma; e; Lv))

    binds yFun (item_fun t) Sigma ->
    binds wFun yFun e ->
    (trm_apply (avar_f wFun) (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open wArg t; fs; Sigma; e; fv_config (trm_apply (avar_f wFun) (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

    fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil) (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    y <> w ->
    (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open w t2 ; fs; Sigma & y ~ (item_fun t1); e & w ~ y ; fv_config (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| nf_loc: forall x Sigma e Lv, answer (trm_var (avar_f x); stack_nil; Sigma; e; Lv).

| red_refl : forall (C : config),

    C1 ⊣ n ↦* C2 ->
    C2      ↦  C3 ->
    C1 ⊣ S n ↦* C3

where "C1 ⊣ n ↦* C2" := (red_closure C1 n C2).

Definition config_terminates_in C n :=
 (exists (Ca : config), answer Ca /\ (C ⊣n↦* Ca)).

Definition config_terminates C :=
 (exists (n : nat), config_terminates_in C n).

    ctx_binds x (typ_fun S T) G ->
    binds x (item_fun t) s ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G § x / v_par ~ S ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ open x T) ->
    all_tfree_k G t v_ref ->
    ty_item_s G e s x
| ty_item_obj_s : forall G e s x U S ds T,
    ctx_binds x T G ->
    binds x (item_obj ds) s ->
    T = typ_objref U S ->
    G §§ (objctx_heap x U) ⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ (open x U) ->
    defs_varkinds G ds ->
    ty_item_s G e s x.

Definition heap_correspond (G : ctx) (e: renv) (s : heap) : Prop :=
  ctx_ok G /\
  ctx_weakens G /\
  ok s /\
  ok e /\
  ctx_kdom v_loc G = dom s /\
  ctx_kdom v_ref G = dom e /\
  renv_corr G e /\
  (forall x,
      x \in dom s ->
      ty_item_s G e s x).

  match (mode_refcaps' typing_mode) with

  end)(only parsing).

| refacp_inert_mutability_ref Tbnd: refcap_inert_mutability (typ_mut_marker Tbnd) v_ref
.

  match (mode_refcaps' typing_mode) with
  | mode_refcaps_none => refcap_typ T \{}
  | mode_refcaps_mutability => refcap_inert_mutability T vk
  end.

      record_type T ->
      refcap_inert_type S vk ->
      typ_indep_b 0 T ->
      cond (typ_objref T S) vk) (only parsing).

      cond (typ_fun S T)) (only parsing).

| ty_trm_var : forall G e x T,
    vis_var typing_mode G x ->

    vis_var typing_mode G x ->

    G⁏e ⊢ x ▷ T ⟶ U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ trm_read (avar_f x) a ∶ U

    vis_var typing_mode G x ->

    mut_var_writeable typing_mode G e x ->

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import TypingMode.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Notation vis_hide typing_mode G := (
  match (mode_visibility' typing_mode) with
  | mode_visibility_all => G
  | mode_visibility_hide_method => (ctx_hide G)
  end
  ) (only parsing).

Definition ctx_obj_met typing_mode (G: ctx)(Go: objctx)(xz: var)(TZ: typ)(xc: var)(TC: typ) :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => ctx_met (vis_hide typing_mode G) xz TZ xc TC
  | objctx_lit x T => ctx_met_refined (vis_hide typing_mode (G § x / v_self ~ open x T)) xz TZ xc TC (typ_and (open x T) (open xc T))
  | objctx_heap y T => ctx_met_refined_heap (vis_hide typing_mode G) xz TZ xc TC y T

  end.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep Equivalence.

Inductive record_dec : dec -> Prop :=
| rd_typ : forall A T, record_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T T)
| rd_typb : forall A T, record_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) typ_bot T)
| rd_fld : forall a T, record_dec (dec_fld a T T)
| rd_met : forall m TC TZ TR, record_dec (dec_met m TC TZ TR)
.

Inductive record_typ : typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
| rt_one : forall D l,
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  record_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
| rt_cons: forall T ls D l,
  record_typ T ls ->
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  l \notin ls ->
  record_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (union ls \{l}).

Definition record_type T := exists ls, record_typ T ls.

Inductive refcap_dec: dec -> Prop :=
  | refcap_dec_typb lt TU:
    refcap_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap lt) typ_bot TU).

Inductive refcap_typ: typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
  | refcap_typ_top:
      refcap_typ typ_top \{}
  | refcap_typ_one D l:
      refcap_dec D ->
      l = label_of D ->
      refcap_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
  | refcap_typ_cons T ls D l:
      refcap_typ T ls ->
      refcap_dec D ->
      l = label_of D ->
      l \notin ls ->
      refcap_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (union ls \{l}).

Definition refcap_type T := exists ls, refcap_typ T ls.

Inductive record_has: typ -> dec -> Prop :=
| rh_one : forall D,
    record_has (typ_rcd D) D
| rh_andl : forall T U D,
    record_has T D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D
| rh_andr : forall T U D,
    record_has U D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

End WithTypingMode.

Fixpoint open_rec_trm (k: nat) (u: var) (t: trm): trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a      => trm_var (open_rec k u a)
  | trm_read v m    => trm_read (open_rec k u v) m
  | trm_apply f a    => trm_apply (open_rec k u f) (open_rec k u a)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (open_rec_trm k u t1) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t2)
  | trm_lit l t => trm_lit (open_rec_lit k u l) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t)
  | trm_write v m v2 => trm_write (open_rec k u v) m (open_rec k u v2)
  | trm_call v m v2 => trm_call (open_rec k u v) m (open_rec k u v2)
  end with
open_rec_lit (k: nat) (u: var) (l: lit): lit :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T t => lit_fun (open_rec k u T) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t)
  | lit_obj T ds =>
    lit_obj
      (open_rec (S k) u T)
      (open_rec_defs (S k) u ds)

  end with
open_rec_def (k: nat) (u: var) (d: def): def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (open_rec (S k) u T)
  | def_fld m v => def_fld m (open_rec k u v)
  | def_met m e => def_met m (open_rec_trm (S (S k)) u e)
  end with
open_rec_defs (k: nat) (u: var) (ds: defs): defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil       => defs_nil
  | defs_cons tl d => defs_cons (open_rec_defs k u tl) (open_rec_def k u d)

  unhiding G1 G2 Go e (a: A) (b: B):

    property ((ctx_hide G1) §& G2) Go e a b.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra Vars Terms Stack Heap Env SyntaxClasses.

Inductive config: Type := config_mk (t:trm) (s:stack) (S:heap) (e:renv) (Lv: fset var): config.

Notation "t ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv" :=
  (config_mk t s Sigma e Lv) (at level 39, s, Sigma, e at level 38, Lv at level 38) : syntax_scope.

Definition config_heap C := (
  match C with
  _ ; _ ; Sc ; _ ; _ => Sc
  end ).

Definition config_env C := (
  match C with
  _ ; _ ; _ ; e ; _ => e
  end ).

Definition config_fv C := (
  match C with
  _ ; _ ; _ ; _ ; Lv => Lv
  end ).

Notation fv_renv e := ((@dom var e) \u (fv_env e)).

Notation fv_config c :=
  match c with
  | (t ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) =>
    (@fv trm _ t) \u (@fv stack _ s) \u (fv_heap Sigma)
      \u (fv_renv e) \u Lv
  end.

Notation fresh_in_config l c := (fresh (fv_config c) (length l) l).

Definition nothing_fresh_in_config A {AF: FreeVar A} (a:A) c :=
  (fv a) \c fv_config c.

Notation vars_conf xs C := (
    from_list xs \c fv_config C
  ) (only parsing).

Definition vars_conf_unique xs C := (
    fresh \{} (length xs) xs /\
    vars_conf xs C
  ).

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping.

Require Import OperationalSemantics ConfigTyping MethodCall.
Require Import HeapUpdate InertContext HeapCorrespondence Coq.Arith.Arith.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Structural facts about how a single reduction step affects the heap *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition changes_at_most (S S' : heap) (y : var) : Prop :=
  forall z v, z <> y -> binds z v S -> binds z v S'.

Lemma red_changes_at_most :
  forall c c', red c c' ->
    exists y, changes_at_most (config_heap c) (config_heap c') y.
Proof.
  intros c c' Hred. destruct Hred.
  - (* red_read *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_write *) exists yObj. intros z v Hne Hb.
    unfold heap_update in H. destruct H as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    apply Hunch; assumption.
  - (* red_call *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_apply *) exists wFun. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_fun *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_obj *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_var *) exists x. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_push *) exists (var_gen (\{} : vars)). intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma binds_in_dom : forall (S : heap) z v,
  binds z v S -> z \in dom S.
Proof.
  intros S z v H. exact (@get_some_inv item z v S H).
Qed.

Lemma red_closure_inv : forall c1 k c4,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (k = 0 /\ c4 = c1) \/
  (exists n c2, k = S n /\ red_closure c1 n c2 /\ red c2 c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 k c4 H. destruct H.
  - left. auto.
  - right. exists n, C2. auto.
Qed.

Lemma fresh_fv_config_dom : forall (y:var) (c:config),
  y \notin fv_config c -> y \notin (dom (config_heap c)).
Proof.
  intros y [t s S e Lv] H. simpl in H.
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Ht H].
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Hs H].
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Hheap H].
  simpl in Hheap. apply notin_union_r in Hheap. destruct Hheap as [Hdom _].
  exact Hdom.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_neq : forall (y z:var) (S:heap),
  z \in dom S -> y \notin dom S -> z <> y.
Proof. intros y z S Hz Hy E. subst. apply Hy. assumption. Qed.

Lemma red_nonwrite_subheap : forall (c c':config),
  c ↦ c' ->
  (forall S0, subheap_unchanged S0 (config_heap c) ->
             subheap_unchanged S0 (config_heap c')) \/
  (exists (Sigma Sigma':heap) (yObj:var) (a:fld_label) (yArg:var),
      config_heap c = Sigma /\ config_heap c' = Sigma' /\
      heap_update Sigma yObj a yArg Sigma').
Proof.
  intros c c' Hred. induction Hred.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - right. simpl. exists Sigma, Sigma', yObj, m, yArg. auto.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl.
    intros z itm Hb.
    apply binds_push_neq.
    + apply Hsub; assumption.
    + apply notin_dom_neq with (S:=Sigma).
      * apply get_some_inv with (v:=itm). apply binds_get. apply Hsub; exact Hb.
      * simpl in H. destruct H as [Hy _].
        pose proof (fresh_fv_config_dom
          (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) Hy) as Hd.
        simpl in Hd. exact Hd.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl.
    intros z itm Hb.
    apply binds_push_neq.
    + apply Hsub; assumption.
    + apply notin_dom_neq with (S:=Sigma).
      * apply get_some_inv with (v:=itm). apply binds_get. apply Hsub; exact Hb.
      * simpl in H. destruct H as [Hy _].
        pose proof (fresh_fv_config_dom
          (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) Hy) as Hd.
        simpl in Hd. exact Hd.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
Qed.

(* A step preserves the initial heap provided it is not a write to a
   location of the initial heap. *)
Definition SefStep (c1 : config) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2) ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c3).

Lemma subheap_unchanged_refl : forall (S:heap), subheap_unchanged S S.
Proof. intros S z v H; exact H. Qed.

Lemma subheap_unchanged_trans : forall (S1 S2 S3:heap),
  subheap_unchanged S1 S2 -> subheap_unchanged S2 S3 ->
  subheap_unchanged S1 S3.
Proof. intros S1 S2 S3 H12 H23 z v H. apply H23. apply H12. exact H. Qed.

Lemma heap_update_preserves_others : forall (S S':heap) (x:var) (a:fld_label) (y:var),
  heap_update S x a y S' ->
  forall z v, z <> x -> binds z v S -> binds z v S'.
Proof.
  intros S S' x a y [Hok [Hok' [Hdom [Hunch _]]]] z v Hne Hb.
  apply Hunch; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_not_nocap : forall (typing_mode:Mode) (T:typ) vk,
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk -> T <> typ_nocap.
Proof. intros typing_mode T vk H. inversion H; subst; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma inert_binds_not_nocap : forall (typing_mode:Mode) (G:ctx) v T,
  inert (typing_mode:=typing_mode) G -> ctx_binds v T G -> T <> typ_nocap.
Proof.
  intros typing_mode G v T Hi Hb. induction Hb.
  - inversion Hi; subst. eapply inert_typ_not_nocap; eassumption.
  - inversion Hi; subst. apply IHHb; assumption.
  - inversion Hi.
Qed.

Lemma heap_prefix_subheap : forall (S1 S1' S2:heap),
  S2 = concat S1' S1 ->
  (forall x, x \in dom S1 -> x \notin dom S1') ->
  subheap_unchanged S1 S2.
Proof.
  intros S1 S1' S2 Heq Hdis x v Hx.
  rewrite Heq. unfold binds in *.
  rewrite get_concat.
  destruct (get x S1) as [w|] eqn:E.
  - injection Hx as <-. reflexivity.
  - discriminate Hx.
Qed.

(* Distribution of substitution over the classical conditional, used by
   the (missing) substitution/open commutation metatheory. *)
Lemma subst_if_avar : forall (x y:var) (P:Prop) (a b:avar),
  subst_var x y (If P then a else b) = If P then subst_var x y a else subst_var x y b.
Proof. intros; destruct (classicT P); cbn; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma subst_if_typ : forall (x y:var) (P:Prop) (A B:typ),
  subst_var x y (If P then A else B) = If P then subst_var x y A else subst_var x y B.
Proof. intros; destruct (classicT P); cbn; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma heap_update_at_key : forall (S S':heap) (x:var) (a:fld_label) (y:var),
  heap_update S x a y S' ->
  exists ds ds', binds x (item_obj ds) S /\
                defs_update ds a y ds' /\
                binds x (item_obj ds') S'.
Proof.
  intros S S' x a y [_ [_ [_ [_ [ds [ds' [H1 [H2 H3]]]]]]]].
  exists ds, ds'. auto.
Qed.

(* The single semantic obligation: during a pure call, before its frame
   ends, no write step can target a location of the initial heap. *)
Definition SefWrite (c1 : config) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3 Sigma Sigma' yObj a yArg,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    config_heap c2 = Sigma ->
    config_heap c3 = Sigma' ->
    heap_update Sigma yObj a yArg Sigma' ->
    yObj \notin dom (config_heap c1).

Lemma SefStep_of_write :
  forall c1, SefWrite c1 ->
  forall j c2 c3,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2) ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c3).
Proof.
  intros c1 Hw j c2 c3 Hcl Hnofe Hstep Hsub.
  destruct (red_nonwrite_subheap Hstep)
    as [Hnw | [Sigma [Sigma' [yObj [a [yArg [Heq1 [Heq2 Hup]]]]]]]].
  - apply Hnw. exact Hsub.
  - (* the step is a write *)
    assert (Hy : yObj \notin dom (config_heap c1)).
    { eapply Hw; eauto. }
    intros z v Hz.
    unfold heap_update in Hup. destruct Hup as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    assert (Hne : z <> yObj).
    { intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq.
      exact (@get_some_inv item z v (config_heap c1) Hz). }
    assert (Hz2 : binds z v Sigma).
    { rewrite <- Heq1. exact (Hsub z v Hz). }
    pose proof (Hunch z v Hne Hz2) as Hz3.
    rewrite Heq2. exact Hz3.
Qed.

Lemma no_frame_end_heap_sub : forall c1 c4 k,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (forall j c3, j < k -> ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3) ->
  SefStep c1 ->
  subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl. revert c4 Hcl.
  induction k as [| n IH]; intros c4 Hcl Hnofe Hstep.
  - destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E ->]. intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E _]]]. discriminate E.
  - destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E _]. discriminate E.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E [Hcln Hred]]]].
      injection E as Hnm. subst m.
      assert (Hsub2 : subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2)).
      { apply (IH c2 Hcln).
        - intros j c3 Hj Hfe. apply (Hnofe j c3).
          + lia.
          + exact Hfe.
        - exact Hstep. }
      eapply Hstep.
      * exact Hcln.
      * intros c3' Hfe. exact (Hnofe n c3' (Nat.lt_succ_diag_r n) Hfe).
      * exact Hred.
      * exact Hsub2.
Qed.

Lemma SefG_I_reduce :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure c1 k c4 ->
    SefStep c1 ->
    (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl Hstep.
  destruct (classic (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k)) as [Hfe | Hno].
  - left. exact Hfe.
  - right. apply no_frame_end_heap_sub with (k:=k); auto.
    intros j c3 Hj Hfe. apply Hno. exists j, c3. split; assumption.
Qed.

(* A run in which every heap-changing step targets a location outside H. *)
Inductive red_closure_fresh_writes (H : heap) : config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=
| rcfw_refl c :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c 0 c
| rcfw_step c1 c2 c3 n y :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 n c2 ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom H ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 (S n) c3.

Lemma rcfw_preserves :
  forall H c1 k c4,
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c1) ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros H c1 k c4 Hsub Hcl. induction Hcl as [c | c1 c2 c3 n y Hcl IH Hred Hch Hy].
  - exact Hsub.
  - intros z v Hz.
    apply Hch.
    + intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq. exact (@get_some_inv item z v H Hz).
    + apply IH. { exact Hsub. } exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma subheap_unchanged_of_fresh_writes :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure_fresh_writes (config_heap c1) c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl.
  eapply rcfw_preserves. 2: exact Hcl.
  intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Target                                                              *)
(*                                                                     *)
(* The target is reduced by [SefG_I_reduce] to [SefStep c1], and by     *)
(* [SefStep_of_write] to [SefWrite c1]: every write reachable before    *)
(* the call frame ends must target a location outside                *)
(* [dom (config_heap c1)].  Closing that final goal needs the original  *)
(* artifact's method-body opening/renaming lemma and configuration      *)
(* subject reduction plus the capability-purity invariant; those        *)
(* declarations were stripped from the supplied support files.          *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Theorem SefG_I :
  forall (typing_mode : Mode) (w1 : var) (m : met_label) (w2 : var)
         (TZv : typ) (c1 : config) (G : ctx) (c4 : config) (k : nat),
  mode_has_sef typing_mode ->
  mode_has_mutability typing_mode ->
  config_trm c1 = trm_call (avar_f w1) m (avar_f w2) ->
  (G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ w1 ∶ typ_rcd (dec_met m typ_nocap TZv typ_top) /\
   G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ w2 ∶ TZv /\
   G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ typ_nocap <: TZv) ->
  (exists T1, ty_config G c1 T1) ->
  c1 ⊣k↦* c4 ->
  (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
  subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping.

Require Import OperationalSemantics ConfigTyping MethodCall.
Require Import HeapUpdate InertContext HeapCorrespondence Coq.Arith.Arith.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Structural facts about how a single reduction step affects the heap *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition changes_at_most (S S' : heap) (y : var) : Prop :=
  forall z v, z <> y -> binds z v S -> binds z v S'.

Lemma red_changes_at_most :
  forall c c', red c c' ->
    exists y, changes_at_most (config_heap c) (config_heap c') y.
Proof.
  intros c c' Hred. destruct Hred.
  - (* red_read *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_write *) exists yObj. intros z v Hne Hb.
    unfold heap_update in H. destruct H as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    apply Hunch; assumption.
  - (* red_call *) exists wObj. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_apply *) exists wFun. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_fun *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_obj *) exists y. intros z v Hne Hb.
    apply binds_concat_left. { exact Hb. }
    rewrite dom_single. apply notin_singleton_l. exact Hne.
  - (* red_let_var *) exists x. intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_push *) exists (var_gen (\{} : vars)). intros z v Hne Hb. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma binds_in_dom : forall (S : heap) z v,
  binds z v S -> z \in dom S.
Proof.
  intros S z v H. exact (@get_some_inv item z v S H).
Qed.

Lemma red_closure_inv : forall c1 k c4,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (k = 0 /\ c4 = c1) \/
  (exists n c2, k = S n /\ red_closure c1 n c2 /\ red c2 c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 k c4 H. destruct H.
  - left. auto.
  - right. exists n, C2. auto.
Qed.

Lemma fresh_fv_config_dom : forall (y:var) (c:config),
  y \notin fv_config c -> y \notin (dom (config_heap c)).
Proof.
  intros y [t s S e Lv] H. simpl in H.
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Ht H].
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Hs H].
  apply notin_union_r in H. destruct H as [Hheap H].
  simpl in Hheap. apply notin_union_r in Hheap. destruct Hheap as [Hdom _].
  exact Hdom.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_neq : forall (y z:var) (S:heap),
  z \in dom S -> y \notin dom S -> z <> y.
Proof. intros y z S Hz Hy E. subst. apply Hy. assumption. Qed.

Lemma red_nonwrite_subheap : forall (c c':config),
  c ↦ c' ->
  (forall S0, subheap_unchanged S0 (config_heap c) ->
             subheap_unchanged S0 (config_heap c')) \/
  (exists (Sigma Sigma':heap) (yObj:var) (a:fld_label) (yArg:var),
      config_heap c = Sigma /\ config_heap c' = Sigma' /\
      heap_update Sigma yObj a yArg Sigma').

  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - right. simpl. exists Sigma, Sigma', yObj, m, yArg. auto.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl in *. exact Hsub.
  - left. intros S0 Hsub. simpl.
    intros z itm Hb.
    apply binds_push_neq.
    + apply Hsub; assumption.
    + apply notin_dom_neq with (S:=Sigma).
      * apply get_some_inv with (v:=itm). apply binds_get. apply Hsub; exact Hb.
      * simpl in H. destruct H as [Hy _].

(* A step preserves the initial heap provided it is not a write to a
   location of the initial heap. *)
Definition SefStep (c1 : config) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2) ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c3).

Lemma subheap_unchanged_refl : forall (S:heap), subheap_unchanged S S.
Proof. intros S z v H; exact H. Qed.

Lemma subheap_unchanged_trans : forall (S1 S2 S3:heap),
  subheap_unchanged S1 S2 -> subheap_unchanged S2 S3 ->
  subheap_unchanged S1 S3.
Proof. intros S1 S2 S3 H12 H23 z v H. apply H23. apply H12. exact H. Qed.

Lemma heap_update_preserves_others : forall (S S':heap) (x:var) (a:fld_label) (y:var),
  heap_update S x a y S' ->
  forall z v, z <> x -> binds z v S -> binds z v S'.
Proof.
  intros S S' x a y [Hok [Hok' [Hdom [Hunch _]]]] z v Hne Hb.
  apply Hunch; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_not_nocap : forall (typing_mode:Mode) (T:typ) vk,
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk -> T <> typ_nocap.
Proof. intros typing_mode T vk H. inversion H; subst; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma inert_binds_not_nocap : forall (typing_mode:Mode) (G:ctx) v T,
  inert (typing_mode:=typing_mode) G -> ctx_binds v T G -> T <> typ_nocap.
Proof.
  intros typing_mode G v T Hi Hb. induction Hb.
  - inversion Hi; subst. eapply inert_typ_not_nocap; eassumption.
  - inversion Hi; subst. apply IHHb; assumption.
  - inversion Hi.
Qed.

Lemma heap_prefix_subheap : forall (S1 S1' S2:heap),
  S2 = concat S1' S1 ->
  (forall x, x \in dom S1 -> x \notin dom S1') ->
  subheap_unchanged S1 S2.
Proof.
  intros S1 S1' S2 Heq Hdis x v Hx.
  rewrite Heq. unfold binds in *.
  rewrite get_concat.
  destruct (get x S1) as [w|] eqn:E.
  - injection Hx as <-. reflexivity.
  - discriminate Hx.
Qed.

(* Distribution of substitution over the classical conditional, used by
   the (missing) substitution/open commutation metatheory. *)
Lemma subst_if_avar : forall (x y:var) (P:Prop) (a b:avar),
  subst_var x y (If P then a else b) = If P then subst_var x y a else subst_var x y b.
Proof. intros; destruct (classicT P); cbn; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma subst_if_typ : forall (x y:var) (P:Prop) (A B:typ),
  subst_var x y (If P then A else B) = If P then subst_var x y A else subst_var x y B.
Proof. intros; destruct (classicT P); cbn; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma heap_update_at_key : forall (S S':heap) (x:var) (a:fld_label) (y:var),
  heap_update S x a y S' ->
  exists ds ds', binds x (item_obj ds) S /\
                defs_update ds a y ds' /\
                binds x (item_obj ds') S'.
Proof.
  intros S S' x a y [_ [_ [_ [_ [ds [ds' [H1 [H2 H3]]]]]]]].
  exists ds, ds'. auto.
Qed.

(* The single semantic obligation: during a pure call, before its frame
   ends, no write step can target a location of the initial heap. *)
Definition SefWrite (c1 : config) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3 Sigma Sigma' yObj a yArg,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    config_heap c2 = Sigma ->
    config_heap c3 = Sigma' ->
    heap_update Sigma yObj a yArg Sigma' ->
    yObj \notin dom (config_heap c1).

Lemma SefStep_of_write :
  forall c1, SefWrite c1 ->
  forall j c2 c3,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2) ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c3).
Proof.
  intros c1 Hw j c2 c3 Hcl Hnofe Hstep Hsub.
  destruct (red_nonwrite_subheap Hstep)
    as [Hnw | [Sigma [Sigma' [yObj [a [yArg [Heq1 [Heq2 Hup]]]]]]]].
  - apply Hnw. exact Hsub.
  - (* the step is a write *)
    assert (Hy : yObj \notin dom (config_heap c1)).
    { eapply Hw; eauto. }
    intros z v Hz.
    unfold heap_update in Hup. destruct Hup as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    assert (Hne : z <> yObj).
    { intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq.
      exact (@get_some_inv item z v (config_heap c1) Hz). }
    assert (Hz2 : binds z v Sigma).
    { rewrite <- Heq1. exact (Hsub z v Hz). }
    pose proof (Hunch z v Hne Hz2) as Hz3.
    rewrite Heq2. exact Hz3.
Qed.

Lemma no_frame_end_heap_sub : forall c1 c4 k,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (forall j c3, j < k -> ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3) ->
  SefStep c1 ->
  subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl. revert c4 Hcl.
  induction k as [| n IH]; intros c4 Hcl Hnofe Hstep.
  - destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E ->]. intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E _]]]. discriminate E.
  - destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E _]. discriminate E.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E [Hcln Hred]]]].
      injection E as Hnm. subst m.
      assert (Hsub2 : subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2)).
      { apply (IH c2 Hcln).
        - intros j c3 Hj Hfe. apply (Hnofe j c3).
          + lia.
          + exact Hfe.
        - exact Hstep. }
      eapply Hstep.
      * exact Hcln.
      * intros c3' Hfe. exact (Hnofe n c3' (Nat.lt_succ_diag_r n) Hfe).
      * exact Hred.
      * exact Hsub2.
Qed.

Lemma SefG_I_reduce :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure c1 k c4 ->
    SefStep c1 ->
    (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl Hstep.
  destruct (classic (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k)) as [Hfe | Hno].
  - left. exact Hfe.
  - right. apply no_frame_end_heap_sub with (k:=k); auto.
    intros j c3 Hj Hfe. apply Hno. exists j, c3. split; assumption.
Qed.

(* A run in which every heap-changing step targets a location outside H. *)
Inductive red_closure_fresh_writes (H : heap) : config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=
| rcfw_refl c :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c 0 c
| rcfw_step c1 c2 c3 n y :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 n c2 ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom H ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 (S n) c3.

Lemma rcfw_preserves :
  forall H c1 k c4,
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c1) ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros H c1 k c4 Hsub Hcl. induction Hcl as [c | c1 c2 c3 n y Hcl IH Hred Hch Hy].
  - exact Hsub.
  - intros z v Hz.
    apply Hch.
    + intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq. exact (@get_some_inv item z v H Hz).
    + apply IH. { exact Hsub. } exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma subheap_unchanged_of_fresh_writes :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure_fresh_writes (config_heap c1) c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl.
  eapply rcfw_preserves. 2: exact Hcl.
  intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
Qed.

(* Reduction only ever adds fresh environment bindings (the binders
   introduced by read/let allocation are fresh for the whole configuration),
   so every pre-existing environment binding survives every step. *)
Lemma red_preserves_env_binds : forall (c c':config),
  c ↦ c' ->
  forall w y, binds w y (config_env c) -> binds w y (config_env c').
Proof.
  intros c c' Hred. induction Hred.
  - (* red_read *)
    intros w y Hb. simpl. simpl in H. destruct H as [Hfresh _].
    apply binds_push_neq.
    + exact Hb.
    + intro E.
      assert (Hd : wVal \notin dom e).
      { apply notin_union_r in Hfresh. destruct Hfresh as [_ Hfresh].
        apply notin_union_r in Hfresh. destruct Hfresh as [_ Hfresh].
        apply notin_union_r in Hfresh. destruct Hfresh as [_ Hfresh].
        apply notin_union_r in Hfresh. destruct Hfresh as [Hrenv _].
        apply notin_union_r in Hrenv. destruct Hrenv as [Hdom _].
        exact Hdom. }
      apply Hd. rewrite <- E.
      exact (@get_some_inv var w y (config_env (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) Hb).
  - (* red_write *) intros w y Hb. simpl. exact Hb.
  - (* red_call *) intros w y Hb. simpl. exact Hb.
  - (* red_apply *) intros w y Hb. simpl. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_fun *)
    intros w' y' Hb. simpl. simpl in H. destruct H as [Hy H]. destruct H as [Hw _]. simpl in Hw.
    apply binds_push_neq.
    + exact Hb.
    + intro E.
      assert (Hd : w \notin dom e).
      { apply notin_union_r in Hw. destruct Hw as [Hw _].
        apply notin_union_r in Hw. destruct Hw as [_ Hw].
        apply notin_union_r in Hw. destruct Hw as [_ Hw].
        apply notin_union_r in Hw. destruct Hw as [Hrenv _].
        apply notin_union_r in Hrenv. destruct Hrenv as [Hdom _].
        exact Hdom. }
      apply Hd. rewrite <- E.
      exact (@get_some_inv var w' y' (config_env (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) Hb).
  - (* red_let_obj *)
    intros w' y' Hb. simpl. simpl in H. destruct H as [Hy H]. destruct H as [Hw _]. simpl in Hw.
    apply binds_push_neq.
    + exact Hb.
    + intro E.
      assert (Hd : w \notin dom e).
      { apply notin_union_r in Hw. destruct Hw as [Hw _].
        apply notin_union_r in Hw. destruct Hw as [_ Hw].
        apply notin_union_r in Hw. destruct Hw as [_ Hw].
        apply notin_union_r in Hw. destruct Hw as [Hrenv _].
        apply notin_union_r in Hrenv. destruct Hrenv as [Hdom _].
        exact Hdom. }
      apply Hd. rewrite <- E.
      exact (@get_some_inv var w' y' (config_env (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) Hb).
  - (* red_let_var *) intros w y Hb. simpl. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_push *) intros w y Hb. simpl. exact Hb.
Qed.

  forall (typing_mode : Mode) (w1 : var) (m : met_label) (w2 : var)

  (G ⁏ (config_env c1) ⊢ w1 ∶ typ_rcd (dec_met m typ_nocap TZv typ_top) /\

  (exists T1, ty_config G c1 T1) ->
  c1 ⊣k↦* c4 ->
  (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
  subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).

(* The single semantic obligation: during a pure call, before its frame
   ends, no write step can target a location of the initial heap. *)
Definition SefWrite (c1 : config) : Prop :=
  forall j c2 c3 Sigma Sigma' yObj a yArg,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    config_heap c2 = Sigma ->
    config_heap c3 = Sigma' ->
    heap_update Sigma yObj a yArg Sigma' ->
    yObj \notin dom (config_heap c1).

Lemma SefStep_of_write :
  forall c1, SefWrite c1 ->
  forall j c2 c3,
    red_closure c1 j c2 ->
    (forall c3', ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3') ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2) ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c3).
Proof.
  intros c1 Hw j c2 c3 Hcl Hnofe Hstep Hsub.
  destruct (red_nonwrite_subheap Hstep)
    as [Hnw | [Sigma [Sigma' [yObj [a [yArg [Heq1 [Heq2 Hup]]]]]]]].
  - apply Hnw. exact Hsub.
  - (* the step is a write *)
    assert (Hy : yObj \notin dom (config_heap c1)).
    { eapply Hw; eauto. }
    intros z v Hz.
    unfold heap_update in Hup. destruct Hup as (_ & _ & _ & Hunch & _).
    assert (Hne : z <> yObj).
    { intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq.
      exact (@get_some_inv item z v (config_heap c1) Hz). }
    assert (Hz2 : binds z v Sigma).
    { rewrite <- Heq1. exact (Hsub z v Hz). }
    pose proof (Hunch z v Hne Hz2) as Hz3.
    rewrite Heq2. exact Hz3.
Qed.

Lemma no_frame_end_heap_sub : forall c1 c4 k,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (forall j c3, j < k -> ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3) ->
  SefStep c1 ->
  subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl. revert c4 Hcl.
  induction k as [| n IH]; intros c4 Hcl Hnofe Hstep.
  - destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E ->]. intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E _]]]. discriminate E.
  - destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E _]. discriminate E.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E [Hcln Hred]]]].
      injection E as Hnm. subst m.
      assert (Hsub2 : subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2)).
      { apply (IH c2 Hcln).
        - intros j c3 Hj Hfe. apply (Hnofe j c3).
          + lia.
          + exact Hfe.
        - exact Hstep. }
      eapply Hstep.
      * exact Hcln.
      * intros c3' Hfe. exact (Hnofe n c3' (Nat.lt_succ_diag_r n) Hfe).
      * exact Hred.
      * exact Hsub2.
Qed.

Lemma SefG_I_reduce :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure c1 k c4 ->
    SefStep c1 ->
    (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl Hstep.
  destruct (classic (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k)) as [Hfe | Hno].
  - left. exact Hfe.
  - right. apply no_frame_end_heap_sub with (k:=k); auto.
    intros j c3 Hj Hfe. apply Hno. exists j, c3. split; assumption.
Qed.

(* A run in which every heap-changing step targets a location outside H. *)
Inductive red_closure_fresh_writes (H : heap) : config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=
| rcfw_refl c :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c 0 c
| rcfw_step c1 c2 c3 n y :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 n c2 ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom H ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 (S n) c3.

Lemma rcfw_preserves :
  forall H c1 k c4,
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c1) ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros H c1 k c4 Hsub Hcl. induction Hcl as [c | c1 c2 c3 n y Hcl IH Hred Hch Hy].
  - exact Hsub.
  - intros z v Hz.
    apply Hch.
    + intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq. exact (@get_some_inv item z v H Hz).
    + apply IH. { exact Hsub. } exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma subheap_unchanged_of_fresh_writes :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure_fresh_writes (config_heap c1) c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl.
  eapply rcfw_preserves. 2: exact Hcl.
  intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
Qed.

  c ↦ c' ->

Proof.
  intros c c' Hred. induction Hred.
  - (* red_read *)
    intros w y Hb. simpl. simpl in H. destruct H as [Hfresh _].
    apply binds_push_neq.
    + exact Hb.
    + intro E.
      assert (Hd : wVal \notin dom e).
      { apply notin_union_r in Hfresh. destruct Hfresh as [_ Hfresh].
        apply notin_union_r in Hfresh. destruct Hfresh as [_ Hfresh].
        apply notin_union_r in Hfresh. destruct Hfresh as [_ Hfresh].
        apply notin_union_r in Hfresh. destruct Hfresh as [Hrenv _].
        apply notin_union_r in Hrenv. destruct Hrenv as [Hdom _].

      exact (@get_some_inv var w y (config_env (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) Hb).
  - (* red_write *) intros w y Hb. simpl. exact Hb.
  - (* red_call *) intros w y Hb. simpl. exact Hb.
  - (* red_apply *) intros w y Hb. simpl. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_fun *)
    intros w' y' Hb. simpl. simpl in H. destruct H as [Hy H]. destruct H as [Hw _]. simpl in Hw.
    apply binds_push_neq.
    + exact Hb.
    + intro E.
      assert (Hd : w \notin dom e).
      { apply notin_union_r in Hw. destruct Hw as [Hw _].
        apply notin_union_r in Hw. destruct Hw as [_ Hw].
        apply notin_union_r in Hw. destruct Hw as [_ Hw].
        apply notin_union_r in Hw. destruct Hw as [_ Hw].
        apply notin_union_r in Hw. destruct Hw as [Hrenv _].
        apply notin_union_r in Hrenv. destruct Hrenv as [Hdom _].
        exact Hdom. }
      apply Hd. rewrite <- E.
      exact (@get_some_inv var w' y' (config_env (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) Hb).
  - (* red_let_obj *)
    intros w' y' Hb. simpl. simpl in H. destruct H as [Hy H]. destruct H as [Hw _]. simpl in Hw.
    apply binds_push_neq.
    + exact Hb.
    + intro E.
      assert (Hd : w \notin dom e).
      { apply notin_union_r in Hw. destruct Hw as [Hw _].
        apply notin_union_r in Hw. destruct Hw as [_ Hw].
        apply notin_union_r in Hw. destruct Hw as [_ Hw].
        apply notin_union_r in Hw. destruct Hw as [_ Hw].
        apply notin_union_r in Hw. destruct Hw as [Hrenv _].
        apply notin_union_r in Hrenv. destruct Hrenv as [Hdom _].
        exact Hdom. }
      apply Hd. rewrite <- E.
      exact (@get_some_inv var w' y' (config_env (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) Hb).
  - (* red_let_var *) intros w y Hb. simpl. exact Hb.
  - (* red_let_push *) intros w y Hb. simpl. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma no_frame_end_heap_sub : forall c1 c4 k,
  red_closure c1 k c4 ->
  (forall j c3, j < k -> ~ frame_end_in c1 j c3) ->
  SefStep c1 ->
  subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl. revert c4 Hcl.
  induction k as [| n IH]; intros c4 Hcl Hnofe Hstep.
  - destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E ->]. intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E _]]]. discriminate E.
  - destruct (red_closure_inv Hcl) as [H0 | Hex].
    + destruct H0 as [E _]. discriminate E.
    + destruct Hex as [m [c2 [E [Hcln Hred]]]].
      injection E as Hnm. subst m.
      assert (Hsub2 : subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c2)).
      { apply (IH c2 Hcln).
        - intros j c3 Hj Hfe. apply (Hnofe j c3).
          + lia.
          + exact Hfe.
        - exact Hstep. }
      eapply Hstep.
      * exact Hcln.
      * intros c3' Hfe. exact (Hnofe n c3' (Nat.lt_succ_diag_r n) Hfe).
      * exact Hred.
      * exact Hsub2.
Qed.

  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure c1 k c4 ->
    SefStep c1 ->
    (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k) \/
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl Hstep.
  destruct (classic (exists j c3, frame_end_in c1 j c3 /\ j < k)) as [Hfe | Hno].
  - left. exact Hfe.
  - right. apply no_frame_end_heap_sub with (k:=k); auto.
    intros j c3 Hj Hfe. apply Hno. exists j, c3. split; assumption.
Qed.

(* A run in which every heap-changing step targets a location outside H. *)
Inductive red_closure_fresh_writes (H : heap) : config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=
| rcfw_refl c :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c 0 c
| rcfw_step c1 c2 c3 n y :
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 n c2 ->
    red c2 c3 ->
    changes_at_most (config_heap c2) (config_heap c3) y ->
    y \notin dom H ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 (S n) c3.

Lemma rcfw_preserves :
  forall H c1 k c4,
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c1) ->
    red_closure_fresh_writes H c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged H (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros H c1 k c4 Hsub Hcl. induction Hcl as [c | c1 c2 c3 n y Hcl IH Hred Hch Hy].
  - exact Hsub.
  - intros z v Hz.
    apply Hch.
    + intro Heq. apply Hy. rewrite <- Heq. exact (@get_some_inv item z v H Hz).
    + apply IH. { exact Hsub. } exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma subheap_unchanged_of_fresh_writes :
  forall c1 c4 k,
    red_closure_fresh_writes (config_heap c1) c1 k c4 ->
    subheap_unchanged (config_heap c1) (config_heap c4).
Proof.
  intros c1 c4 k Hcl.
  eapply rcfw_preserves. 2: exact Hcl.
  intros z v Hz. exact Hz.
Qed.

  - (* red_let_obj *)
